mail.captionEn: Here's your mail... Grrrr, even more popular than me...
mail.caption: 你的信……可恶，居然比我还要受欢迎

main_1.captionEn: Wa ha ha! Yukikaze the Great is invincible!
main_1.caption: HO,HO,HO，雪风大人可是无敌的口牙！

main_2.captionEn: If you beg me like that, I have no choice but to lend you my aid!
main_2.caption: 指挥官，你求我的话也不是不能帮你一下哦~

main_3.captionEn: Eheh~ Hmph. Yukikaze the Great is only giving you the time of day because she's in a good mood!
main_3.caption: Na,Nya……哼，雪风大人心情好，就难得满足一下你

mission.captionEn: How naïve, Commander! You still have tasks left to do!
mission.caption: 还有任务剩下，指挥官，你还嫩啊（鄙视）

mission_complete.captionEn: Let's take a little peek... Wh-what am I doing? N-not peeking, of course... I just wanted to check the rewards in advance!
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励是……干，干什么，我才没想偷看！我只是事先帮你确认一下！

touch_body.captionEn: Phew... that was scary... Huh? I didn't say anything!
touch_body.caption: 呼……吓我一跳（小声）嗯？没什么

touch_head.captionEn: Eep! That scared me... Huh? None of your business!
touch_head.caption: 呼……吓我一跳（小声）嗯？哼，没什么，继续做你的事去吧

touch_special.captionEn: What are... you doing... nngh!? Go die!!
touch_special.caption: 你……竟敢……呜……！去死吧！

wedding.captionEn: Since you asked so earnestly, Yukikaze the Great shall grant you a favor and allow you to carry her! Come on, what are you waiting for? It's a once in a lifetime opportunity!
wedding.caption: 既然这是你发自内心的请求，雪风大人就大发慈悲收下好了，特别允许你把雪风大人抱起来也没关系哦，来吧，你还在等什么，这可是千载难逢的好机会！

complete.captionEn: Woof! Are you sure that barking increases the likelihood of getting a better reward...?
complete.caption: 汪！你确定委托完成时喊一声奖励会更好吗……

home.captionEn: You were only able to return safely because of my luck, so be thankful!
home.caption: 你能平安无事也是多亏了我的幸运，快感谢我吧！

login.captionEn: Heheh~ As long as the lucky Yukikaze is at your side, everything's going to be smooth sailing this year!
login.caption: 哼哼，有幸运的雪风大人在，指挥官当然整年都会一帆风顺了！

mail.captionEn: Here's your mail... Grrrr, even more popular than me...
mail.caption: 你的信……可恶，居然比我还要受欢迎

main_1.captionEn: Is it snowing?! Hooray! Now I can play in the... A-ahem! Commander, why don't we go enjoy the scenery together?
main_1.caption: 外面好像下雪了！？一起出去玩雪…咳咳、要一起去看看雪吗，指挥官？

main_2.captionEn: That Chang Chun girl gave me some special-looking firecrackers. They look pretty neat, so can we set them off right now? Ehh?! I can't...?
main_2.caption: 长春给了我这个，说是特制的鞭炮，很好玩的，嘿嘿，要不要在这里放一个试试啊！欸？不行吗……

main_3.captionEn: Happy New Year! In the Dragon Empery, it doesn't count as a new year 'til this time rolls around! Of course Yukikaze the Wise would know that~♪
main_3.caption: 新年好！博学的雪风大人知道，东煌是这个时期才算过新年的！

mission.captionEn: Hmm... Let's finish the work first, then play later.
mission.caption: 唔…还是把该做的事情做完再来享受节日氛围吧…

mission_complete.captionEn: Let's take a little peek... Wh-what am I doing? N-not peeking, of course... I just wanted to check the rewards in advance!
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励是……干，干什么，我才没想偷看！我只是事先帮你确认一下！

touch_body.captionEn: Ehh?! Y-You're going to give me New Year's money?!
touch_body.caption: 嗯？难道是要给我压岁钱吗！？

touch_head.captionEn: Eep! That scared me... Huh? None of your business!
touch_head.caption: 呼……吓我一跳（小声）嗯？哼，没什么，继续做你的事去吧

touch_special.caption: 成，成熟的雪风大人早就习，习惯这些了！唔，唔……

wedding.captionEn: Since you asked so earnestly, Yukikaze the Great shall grant you a favor and allow you to carry her! Come on, what are you waiting for? It's a once in a lifetime opportunity!
wedding.caption: 既然这是你发自内心的请求，雪风大人就大发慈悲收下好了，特别允许你把雪风大人抱起来也没关系哦，来吧，你还在等什么，这可是千载难逢的好机会！

complete.captionEn: Commander, a commission's been completed~ I'll go check if they found anything neato♪
complete.caption: 指挥官，委托完成啦，我去问问她们有没有找到什么有趣的东西~

home.captionEn: Commander, did you bring anything for me?
home.caption: 指挥官，有帮我带点心吗？

login.captionEn: Commander, are you ready? Then we're off to the next stop~
login.caption: 指挥官，准备好了吗，让我们向着下一家店出发吧～

mail.captionEn: Commander, you've got new mail! ... Huh? No, I didn't bring it with me. I'm just saying you should go get it~
mail.caption: 指挥官，新邮件！……嗯？我只是提醒你去拿，没拿来过哦

main_1.captionEn: Commander, you can give me puppy-dog eyes all you want, but I won't share my ice cream... F-fine, just one lick, got it?
main_1.caption: 指挥官，就算你这么盯着我，冰淇淋也不会……唔，好吧，就只能舔一口哦，真的哦？

main_2.captionEn: My twin-gun turrets are also on vacation today! Gotta work hard and play hard!
main_2.caption: 路路通和连装炮今天都在休息！该玩的时候要好好放松啦～

main_3.captionEn: Uhh, I don't think I'll bring the puppy with me next time... He's way too jumpy and almost even fell off the scooter once...
main_3.caption: 唔，下次不带这个小家伙出来了…它真的很爱动欸，有一次还直接从车上跳了下去……

mission.captionEn: Okay, let's see what rewards we got today!
mission.caption: 好嘞，让我来看看今天的任务都有什么奖励吧！

mission_complete.captionEn: Ooh! I found something nice amongst the rewards♪
mission_complete.caption: 喔！任务奖励里发现了好东西~

touch_body.captionEn: Oh, you finally noticed, Commander! That's right, I put my hair up just for today's ride! This is your only chance to see it like this.
touch_body.caption: 哦，指挥官终于注意到了吗！没错，今天的发型是兜风特战版！只有现在能看到哦？

touch_special.captionEn: I can't believe you. You almost made me drop my ice cream!
touch_special.caption: 真是的，人家冰淇淋都差点被你弄掉了啦！

wedding.captionEn: So, you wanna chain Surcouf to your side with this ring? Jeez, aren't you greedy~ But, since it's you... I might be fine with it♪
wedding.caption: 指挥官要用戒指把絮库夫绑在身边吗？真是贪心呢~不过是指挥官的话，好像～我也不讨厌呢~

complete.captionEn: Commander, a commission's been completed~ I'll go check if they found anything neato♪
complete.caption: 指挥官，委托完成啦，我去问问她们有没有找到什么有趣的东西~

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Comma– Whuah! Geesh, that last wave was huge! You could've warned me that it was coming! Hmph!
home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官——哇啊！？怎么突然来了个大浪！真是的，指挥官看到了就提醒我一下嘛…

login.captionEn: Hey, Commander, done anything fun lately? I wanna know!
login.caption: 指挥官，最近都遇到了什么好玩的事？都和我说说嘛！

mail.captionEn: Commander, you've got new mail! ... Huh? No, I didn't bring it with me. I'm just saying you should go get it~
mail.caption: 指挥官，新邮件！……嗯？我只是提醒你去拿，没拿来过哦

main_1.captionEn: Hey, Commander! Just lie on your back and I'll cover you with sand~
main_1.caption: 指挥官，快躺下快躺下！我要用沙子把你埋起来！

main_2.captionEn: Go get the camera, Commander! I wanna take a photo of this.
main_2.caption: 其实我包包里还装防水相机哦，指挥官，来拍张合影吧！

main_3.captionEn: Passepartout, could you get me some sunscreen? Oh, and Commander, would you mind rubbing it on for me?
main_3.caption: 指挥官，能帮我抹下防晒霜吗~？

mission.captionEn: Okay, let's see what rewards we got today!
mission.caption: 好嘞，让我来看看今天的任务都有什么奖励吧！

mission_complete.captionEn: Ooh! I found something nice amongst the rewards♪
mission_complete.caption: 喔！任务奖励里发现了好东西~

touch_body.captionEn: You're head over heels for my gorgeous body, aren't you? Heheh, stare all you want, because I don't mind♡
touch_body.caption: 被我的身材魅惑得神魂颠倒了吗？哼哼，想看的话就尽情地看吧，我不会介意的！

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, if you wanna fondle 'em, just say so first~
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，想碰的话，要好好跟我说才行哦？

wedding.captionEn: So, you wanna chain Surcouf to your side with this ring? Jeez, aren't you greedy~ But, since it's you... I might be fine with it♪
wedding.caption: 指挥官要用戒指把絮库夫绑在身边吗？真是贪心呢~不过是指挥官的话，好像～我也不讨厌呢~

complete.captionEn: Commander, a commission's been completed~ I'll go check if they found anything neato♪
complete.caption: 指挥官，委托完成啦，我去问问她们有没有找到什么有趣的东西~

home.captionEn: Welcome back, Comma– Whuah! Geesh, that last wave was huge! You could've warned me that it was coming! Hmph!
home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官——哇啊！？怎么突然来了个大浪！真是的，指挥官看到了就提醒我一下嘛…

login.captionEn: Hey, Commander, done anything fun lately? I wanna know!
login.caption: 指挥官，最近都遇到了什么好玩的事？都和我说说嘛！

mail.captionEn: Commander, you've got new mail! ... Huh? No, I didn't bring it with me. I'm just saying you should go get it~
mail.caption: 指挥官，新邮件！……嗯？我只是提醒你去拿，没拿来过哦

main_1.captionEn: Hey, Commander! Just lie on your back and I'll cover you with sand~
main_1.caption: 指挥官，快躺下快躺下！我要用沙子把你埋起来！

main_2.captionEn: Go get the camera, Commander! I wanna take a photo of this.
main_2.caption: 其实我包包里还装防水相机哦，指挥官，来拍张合影吧！

main_3.captionEn: Passepartout, could you get me some sunscreen? Oh, and Commander, would you mind rubbing it on for me?
main_3.caption: 指挥官，能帮我抹下防晒霜吗~？

mission.captionEn: Okay, let's see what rewards we got today!
mission.caption: 好嘞，让我来看看今天的任务都有什么奖励吧！

mission_complete.captionEn: Ooh! I found something nice amongst the rewards♪
mission_complete.caption: 喔！任务奖励里发现了好东西~

touch_body.captionEn: You're head over heels for my gorgeous body, aren't you? Heheh, stare all you want, because I don't mind♡
touch_body.caption: 被我的身材魅惑得神魂颠倒了吗？哼哼，想看的话就尽情地看吧，我不会介意的！

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, if you wanna fondle 'em, just say so first~
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，想碰的话，要好好跟我说才行哦？

wedding.captionEn: So, you wanna chain Surcouf to your side with this ring? Jeez, aren't you greedy~ But, since it's you... I might be fine with it♪
wedding.caption: 指挥官要用戒指把絮库夫绑在身边吗？真是贪心呢~不过是指挥官的话，好像～我也不讨厌呢~

complete.captionEn: Hyeep?! ...Oh, that was just the commission fleet coming back? Thank you very much...
complete.caption: 呀？！…委，委托组回来了吗？谢谢…

home.captionEn: I'm a bad girl, aren't I? For wearing this to try to get Commander to notice me... A-actually, p-please don't look at me after all! *whimpers*...
home.caption: 肯定是雅努斯不好，想让指挥官来看穿成这样的自己……果、果然还是不要看！呜呜呜……

login.captionEn: I'll be just fine, I can handle going out alone on Halloween night... C-Commander, I'm sorry! I need your help after all...
login.caption: 雅努斯，没事的，不就是万圣节一个人出来玩……指、指挥官对不起！还是救救我吧……

mail.captionEn: Commander, your mail is here! ...Phew, I'm glad I was able to deliver it to you promptly!
mail.caption: 指挥官，有你的信件！……太好了顺利传达到了！

main_1.captionEn: C-Commander, it's not your fault. I wasn't watching where I was going... No, I'm sure it was because I was too jumpy and ended up spooking the kitty...
main_1.caption: 不，不是指挥官的错哦？都是因为我不小心…不，肯定是因为我害怕结果吓到了猫咪所以…

main_2.captionEn: All my friends around the port are dressing up for Halloween, huh... By the way, what is this supposed to be a costume of? It has cat ears, but bat wings...
main_2.caption: 港区的同伴们都穿着万圣节的装扮呢…说起来我的装扮是什么来着…？有猫耳朵，还有蝙蝠的翅膀…

main_3.captionEn: Commander, are you not scared of Halloween? Well, when I think about it a bit more... I'm the only one who's scared of Halloween, aren't I? Oh no, I'm sorry for bringing up weird things...
main_3.caption: 指挥官不会害怕万圣节吗……？想想也是呢……对不起我又在说奇怪的话了…！怎么办，如果只有我一个人害怕的话…呜呜……

mission.captionEn: Commander, there's new mission here! Err, umm... I hope you can come back sooner... S-sorry!
mission.caption: 指挥官，有新任务！那，那个…希望你能早点回来…不好意思…！

mission_complete.captionEn: Wow, you're already done with your work? How impressive... I-it was only possible because of me...? Th-thank you! I'm glad I was able to be of help!
mission_complete.caption: 不愧是指挥官，这么快就完成了任务……欸，我也有功劳吗？嗯，嗯！能帮上您就好！

touch_body.captionEn: Don't you worry, Janus, there's nothing to be afraid of... Jervis and the Commander are here!
touch_body.caption: 没事的雅努斯，没什么好怕的，还有贾维斯和指挥官在呢……！

touch_head.captionEn: That feels so nice... Pweh?! S-so sorry! I was completely distracted by something else just now...
touch_head.caption: 好舒服……欸？对，对不起！刚刚走神了……

touch_special.captionEn: *whimpers*... I-is this my punishment for being a burden...?
touch_special.caption: 呜呜……是，是我做错了什么必须要受到惩罚吗……

wedding.captionEn: Huh? The two of us, oathbound? ...C-Commander, I never realized you... Oh, it's nothing! I'm so glad! I'll never stop working hard so that I can be of use to you, Commander!
wedding.caption: 欸！？誓约……也就是说，指挥官对我也……没，没什么！我，我现在很开心！我一定会更加努力，为了帮上指挥官——不，为了能与指挥官相称而努力一生的！

complete.captionEn: The girls have come back from their commissions. It almost feels like I'm not the only one being worked to the bone by you.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了。指挥官看上去可不像是能随便驱使我的人呢。

home.captionEn: Thank you for your continued efforts. Um... Wh-why are you looking at me so expectantly?
home.caption: 辛苦了。嗯…为，为什么用期待的眼光看着我？

login.captionEn: I-it's about time we went on a... date, isn't it, Commander?
login.caption: 那，就开始…约会…吧？指挥官…？

mail.captionEn: Here's a letter for you. When are you going to read it?
mail.caption: 有你的信哦。什么时候看？

main_1.captionEn: I-I don't mind if you sit here! Today, you have special permission to be next to me!
main_1.caption: 可…可以坐旁边的哦！今天特别允许你坐在我身边！

main_2.captionEn: Heheh, I will gladly let you carry my things! Where should we go next? Or...do you need a minute to rest?
main_2.caption: 呵呵，包也给你拎！接下来想去哪里？还是有点累了所以…想休息？

main_3.captionEn: (Things have been so awkward for a while now... I have to scoot a little bit closer...) B-Bwuh?! Did you hear that?!
main_3.caption: （从刚才开始一直在紧张…要再拉近点距离才行…）诶？！刚才说的都听到了吗？！

mission.captionEn: Why don't we forget about all the missions for a day? Come and be bad with me!
mission.caption: 今天就别管任务了吧？和我一起，当个坏孩子吧♡

mission_complete.captionEn: Here are your rewards. Allow me to hold your things for you.
mission_complete.caption: 是任务报酬。来，包还是我来拿吧。

touch_body.captionEn: I-is this a massage?
touch_body.caption: 按、按摩…？

touch_head.captionEn: Y-you little...
touch_head.caption: 笨，笨蛋…

touch_special.captionEn: ...Hwaah?!
touch_special.caption: ……呀！？

wedding.captionEn: Wow... So this is the fabled promise ring?! N-no way, the Commander really confessed to me...??? W-wait, don't hang your head, I'm not turning you down, really! I truly love you, from the bottom of my heart! Commander, I love you, so, so much~!
wedding.caption: 咦……这是誓约戒指吗？！怎，怎么这样，易北被指挥官告白了……不，不能消沉！我不会拒绝的！才不会拒绝呢！易北也最喜欢指挥官了！最喜欢了ー！！

complete.captionEn: Milord, the comm... Um, whatever these are called. Yes, they're done now.
complete.caption: 主上，委托……唔，是叫这个吗？总之完成了

home.captionEn: The snow is coming down outside... Milord, let me get an extra sweater for you.
home.caption: 外面在下雪呢……主上，我给您再添一件毛衣吧

login.captionEn: Milord, shall we go outside together?
login.caption: 主上，要一起外出吗？

mail.captionEn: Milord, your mail... Huh? You'd like me to read it? B-but that's embarrassing...
mail.caption: 主上，你的信件…诶？念给你听？那种害羞的事情…

main_1.captionEn: Achoo! ...I'm cute when I sneeze? D- don't make fun of me...
main_1.caption: 阿嚏！……打喷嚏的样子很可爱？请、请不要笑话我了……

main_2.captionEn: This is... real snow... beautiful...
main_2.caption: 这就是真正的雪……真漂亮啊

main_3.captionEn: Aren't there some big festivals in the wintertime? I guess you could say... I'm a little interested... only a little!
main_3.caption: 冬天会有很热闹的祭典吗？……稍微……有些感兴趣

mission.captionEn: We seem to have new missions. Would you like Ibuki to accompany you?
mission.caption: 有任务…需要我也一同出击吗？

mission_complete.captionEn: Milord, there's a big pile of stuff over there... Um, are those the rewards then?
mission_complete.caption: 主上，那边好像堆了好多东西？喔，那就是奖励吗？

touch_body.captionEn: Is there someplace you'd like to go, Milord? Of course I'll accompany you.
touch_body.caption: 主上……有想去的地方吗？我会陪您一起去的

touch_special.captionEn: Um, Milord, your hands are cold...
touch_special.caption: 主、主上，手好冷……

wedding.captionEn: I never knew that having my feelings be reciprocated could be so overwhelmingly joyful... Milord, p-please don't look at me... I'm so happy that... my face must look strange...
wedding.caption: 我过去从不知道，心意得到回应，是一件这么幸福的事情…请不要看我，主上…我现在的表情一定很奇怪…

complete.captionEn: The subjects tasked with a commission have returned. Go at once and see if they brought me a tribute!
complete.caption: 去委托的臣子们回来了，快去看看有没有给本王带来有趣的贡品！

home.captionEn: Nothing beats Edinburgh's hand-brewed black tea! Wouldn't you agree, my servant?
home.caption: 果然爱丁堡泡的红茶很好喝呢！仆从你也这么觉得吧？

login.captionEn: Despicable, to have me wait on you for so long!
login.caption: 可恶~居然让我等你这么久

mail.captionEn: I shall check the mail in your stead, my servant! ...Hmm, I wonder what this says...
mail.caption: 就由我代替仆从确认邮件好了！…嗯，上面写了些什么呢…

main_1.captionEn: Warspite, what's taking you so long? ...What do you mean you can't move around easily in a skirt?!
main_1.caption: 厌战，太慢了！…因为穿了裙子行动不方便？你这是在说什么啊？

main_2.captionEn: Being a maid is no easier than carrying out public duties... So come help me already, you lowly servant!
main_2.caption: 女仆的工作，还有公务，都很辛苦呢…快帮我一下啊仆从！

main_3.captionEn: Bel, come clean up around the office! Heheh, any job that someone as noble as me carries out becomes a noble endeavor in turn!
main_3.caption: 贝法，办公室的打扫就拜托你了！哼哼，高贵的我做的工作也得足够高贵才行！

mission.captionEn: Hurry up and take care of the missions, you lowly servant!
mission.caption: 仆从，快点去完成你的任务！

mission_complete.captionEn: Excellent, the rewards are here! Warspite, take these over to my servant!
mission_complete.caption: 是报酬啊！厌战，给我送到仆从那边去吧！

touch_body.captionEn: Please do not touch our noble body so casually
touch_body.caption: 不要随便碰本王高贵的身体！

touch_special.captionEn: Do you also do this to the girls in the Maid Team...?
touch_special.caption: 仆从，你该不会对女仆队的其他人也做了这样的事吧…

wedding.captionEn: Finally you have arrived before me. Foolish servant! Just how long did you intend to make me wait?! ...But I acknowledge your endeavors. Come here, I am giving you permission to take my hand! Yes! From now on I will always be with you!
wedding.caption: 终于把它送到了本王的手里，你这蠢货，让本王等了多久啊！……不过看在你这么努力的份上，过来，准许你牵起本王的手，从今往后，本王会陪着你的

complete.captionEn: The expedition fleet is back. Don't forget to reward all our hardworking friends.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了。别忘了犒劳每一位奔波的伙伴哦。

home.captionEn: Nngh~ My legs sure are sore... Oh, Commander, you're back. Say... would you mind helping me out a little?
home.caption: 嗯~腿有些酸了呢…啊，指挥官，你回来啦，那个…能帮帮我吗…？

login.captionEn: An old saying goes, "it's better to be lucky than it is to be punctual." Since you've come at quite the fortuitous moment, why not come sit next to me and enjoy the show? As for what's going on over here, don't sweat the small details~♪
login.caption: 俗话说，来得早不如来得巧。既然您来了，不如就在旁边坐会吧？不必在意这边的状况~

mail.captionEn: Got some mail for you, Commander, but it's not easy for me to move right now. I'll just leave it on the table for you.
mail.caption: 指挥官，有您的信件。恕我行动不便，给您就近放在桌子上了。

main_1.captionEn: What's the matter, Chao Ho? Still haven't been able to get your stuff back? ...I tricked you? What could you possibly be talking about?
main_1.caption: 肇和？怎么了，还没有抓到它吗？……恶作剧？你在说什么呀，我怎么听不懂。

main_2.captionEn: We're almost completely out of ink for our Spring Festival couplets. Commander, mind helping me grind up the inkstick? I'm a bit busy right now, but I'll make a cup of tea for you later.
main_2.caption: 写春联用的墨水见底了。指挥官，能拜托您帮忙磨一点吗？我现在有点不方便，之后我会给您泡一杯茶的。

main_3.captionEn: The goods Akashi sent over sure are convenient. There's the mechanical errand-running Manjuus, the automatic fireworks launchers, and the lion dancers as well... I'm sure Fu Shun and her gals would have an absolute blast with these.
main_3.caption: 明石送的小道具真是方便。除了跑腿用的特制机器啾啾外，好像还有能放烟花的，表演舞狮的……抚顺她们应该会喜欢吧。

mission.captionEn: Commander, we've got new missions. If Chao Ho was here, I'm sure she'd be nagging you to kingdom come. Hehe~
mission.caption: 指挥官，有新的任务哦。，这个时候如果是肇和的话，应该会像老妈子一样催着你干活吧？

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Now, if I could just enjoy a meal, soak in the bath, and then get into bed... that would be the life. Hehe~
mission_complete.caption: 任务结束。接下来先填饱肚子，泡个舒舒服服的热水澡，然后睡觉！如果真的能这么悠哉就好了。

touch_body.captionEn: You also want to try playing a prank on Chao Ho? Sure, but don't go too overboard~
touch_body.caption: 你也想试试捉弄姐姐的感觉吗？当然可以，不过要轻点~

touch_head.captionEn: If you mess up my hair, I'll have you style it for me for a week starting tomorrow, you hear?
touch_head.caption: 要是弄乱头发，可就要罚指挥官帮我梳一个星期的头发哦？

touch_special.captionEn: Commander, are you sure you want to do this with Chao Ho watching? I never knew you had kinks like that...
touch_special.caption: 指挥官，肇和就在旁边哦？没想到你还有这种特殊癖好啊……

wedding.captionEn: Ink does not fade with the passage of time... I wrote my feelings down with the hope that they also may never fade. I now offer these words to you, along with myself.
wedding.caption: 岁月倥偬，唯有白纸黑字能够成为时光的见证。这是我一笔一墨写下的情笺，现在，我将它，还有我自己，全部托付给您了。

complete.captionEn: A commission's been completed. Oh well, nothing too important to our sleepy bird here.
complete.caption: 委托，完成了……不过，对懒惰的指……鸟儿来说不那么重要呢，嗯。

home.captionEn: Back at long last. Whew... You have more stamina than any person has any right to.
home.caption: 终于回来了。指挥官，你还真是精力旺盛欸……

login.captionEn: Hm? Did you give up on being the early bird? ...Me? I'm the spring worm that sleeps in.
login.caption: ……嗯？指挥官，是不想做早起的鸟儿了么？……我？我不一样哦。我今天扮演的是在早春打盹的虫子，嗯。

mail.captionEn: There's a Lunar New Year card with your name on it, Commander.
mail.caption: 有你的春节问候邮件，指挥官。

main_1.captionEn: Whew... Lunar New Year's a nice holiday. You can just lie down and someone will feed you... Hm? They won't?
main_1.caption: 嗯，真是个美好的节日，只需要躺着享受，自然有人投喂……嗯？不是这样的么？

main_2.captionEn: Looks like Theseus is into the hustle and bustle of the season. Though, I guess I'm the same when it comes down to it... *yaaawn*...
main_2.caption: 忒修斯，好像很享受春节热闹的样子。其实我也一样……在享受节日这件事上。哈啊……（哈欠）

main_3.captionEn: A cannon to inaugurate the new year with? That's a neat idea... Crap, now I'm interested...
main_3.caption: 贺岁大炮……？真是独特的构想呢……糟糕，有点感兴趣了…

mission.captionEn: What kind of lazy cat are you, just lounging around all day instead of doing missions?
mission.caption: 指挥官原来是不愿意执行任务的懒惰虫吗？

mission_complete.captionEn: Those mission rewards will expire if you don't claim them. Maybe.
mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，再不收，任务奖励就要过期了。

touch_body.captionEn: ...Do you wanna lie down with me? Knock yourself out. Like they say, Lunar New Year is a holiday for resting.
touch_body.caption: ……想一起躺会？没问题。春节，就是来睡懒觉的节日呢……

touch_head.captionEn: ...Oh. Now it's your responsibility to comb my hair.
touch_head.caption: ……唔，指挥官，负起责任给我梳头哦。

touch_special.captionEn: ...Baozi... or rice cakes? C-Commander... *blushes*
touch_special.caption: ……包子还是年糕？指挥官，你这人啊……

wedding.captionEn: Obviously I don't hate you, Commander. How could I, when I adore talking to you and being patted on the head? L-look, I'm trying to say... I love you. I mean it...
wedding.caption: 其实，我并不讨厌指挥官的…指挥官总是愿意和我说话，愿意摸摸我的头…我其实…最喜欢指挥官了。嗯…

complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. I can't wait to hear their stories, heehee.
complete.caption: 委托组回来了呢。殷切期待她们的旅途见闻呢。呵呵。

home.captionEn: Commander~ Welcome home~♥ I see, so this is what makes you happy? It seems I still have much to learn... Heehee.
home.caption: 指挥官大人～欢迎回港～♥原来如此，这样子会更让您感到高兴吗？看来云仙还有许多不懂的事情呢……呵呵。

login.captionEn: Commander~ Heheh, come sit over here with me. It may be... a little cramped, but it's enough space for two, isn't it?
login.caption: 指挥官大人～呵呵，可以的话来我身边坐坐吧？嗯……虽然稍微有些狭窄，但两人挤挤的话也是可以的哦。

mail.captionEn: It seems there are letters waiting for you. It's okay. You may enjoy your break first and read it later.
mail.caption: 来信了呢。无需在意。好好休息后再确认便是。

main_1.captionEn: Would you like to join me, Commander? Soak your feet and feel heaven and earth's energy through the land, sea, and ocean breeze...
main_1.caption: 指挥官大人也要来试试吗？只需把脚浸于水中，海洋与大地，以及海风传递而来的天地灵气便会吸纳融汇于身——

main_2.captionEn: There are some underwater hot springs nearby. How about you and I visit them later? They're quite close—it's just two days if we swim.
main_2.caption: 说起来这附近有海洋温泉呢。可以的话，之后一起去泡泡如何？……游过去的话两天左右就能到，还挺近的吧？

main_3.captionEn: Commander, when you go on vacation, you should have fun. Yes, it's a rare opportunity to... move your body a little, don't you think?
main_3.caption: 指挥官大人，都出门游玩了，就更应该尽情享受才是。对吧，像这样活动身体——不是很难得的机会吗？

mission.captionEn: You have a backlog of missions. Heehee, I understand. It's only human to procrastinate until right before your deadline.
mission.caption: 任务似乎有所滞留呢。呵呵，无妨。若等到最后关头才动手，那也是人之常情。

mission_complete.captionEn: You have some unchecked mission rewards. Heehee, don't worry. It's nice to watch them build up, isn't it?
mission_complete.caption: 似乎有未领取的任务报酬呢。呵呵，无妨。就放那里也罢。

touch_body.captionEn: This feeling of liberation... I'd love to feel more of this place's energy with my bare skin... Oh, I can't?
touch_body.caption: 这般周身无拘无束之感……还想再更直接地感受这里的灵气……不行吗？

touch_head.captionEn: Hmm, I'm not too sure about this...
touch_head.caption: 哎呀，这可真是……

touch_special.captionEn: You'd even do that out here...? Heehee♥
touch_special.caption: 不用换个地方吗……？呵呵♥

wedding.captionEn: I'm deeply honored by your proposal. While I don't feel deserving, I graciously accept... Heehee, it seems I'll have to train to be a bride, won't I, Commander?
wedding.caption: 您提出的誓约，令我感到光荣至极。小女子不才，还望多多关照。——呵呵，看来我需要进行特别修行了呢，对吧？指挥官大人？

complete.captionEn: It’s about time! Please put aside your work, and check on the results of your commissions.
complete.caption: 时间到了，工作先放一放，去检查委托成果吧

home.captionEn: We still have so much to review about the previous battle...
home.caption: 刚才的战斗还有许多要检讨的地方呢……

login.captionEn: There's still quite a lot to be done today. No procrastinating!
login.caption: 今天还有好多事情要做呢，可不要偷懒哦

mail.captionEn: There’s mail for you, Commander. You sure are popular.
mail.caption: 有你的信，指挥官意外地挺受欢迎嘛

main_1.captionEn: Don’t worry, Commander. The fact that you care about me is enough.
main_1.caption: 不用担心，我的话，指挥官有这份心就够了

main_2.captionEn: I wonder if there’s something I can do for you, Commander. You seem tired lately, so maybe a massage would be good?
main_2.caption: 给指挥官准备什么点心好呢……最近好像也挺累的，稍微给那个人按摩一下吧……

main_3.captionEn: See, Commander? You can do it if you set your mind to it!
main_3.caption: 嗯嗯，指挥官只要用心的话还是办得到的呢

mission.captionEn: Completing missions is a great way to hone your skills. Don't ever forget that!
mission.caption: 完成任务是熟练技巧的好途径哦，不要忘了

mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, the mission rewards have arrived.
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励发放了喔

touch_body.captionEn: If you’re free, why not help with some paperwork?
touch_body.caption: 有这个时间多处理些公文如何？

touch_head.captionEn: I’m not the kind of girl who you can fool with just a few headpats. Get back to work, Commander.
touch_head.caption: 我可不是那种被摸摸头就可以蒙混过去的女孩子哦，指挥官，请好好工作

touch_special.captionEn: This isn’t something a commander should be doing...
touch_special.caption: 这可不是指挥官应有的行为哦

wedding.captionEn: This is the proof that Commander acknowledges me... Understood. From now on, I shall stay by your side and work hard to ensure that your life is happy and upstanding.
wedding.caption: 这就是指挥官对我的认可……我明白了，我Z23从今往后也会一直陪在指挥官你的身边，为你能够正确又愉快的生活努力的

complete.captionEn: It’s about time! Please put aside your work, and check on the results of your commissions.
complete.caption: 时间到了，工作先放一放，去检查委托成果吧

home.captionEn: We still have so much to review about the previous battle...
home.caption: 刚才的战斗还有许多要检讨的地方呢……

login.captionEn: There's still quite a lot to be done today. No procrastinating!
login.caption: 今天还有好多事情要做呢，可不要偷懒哦

mail.captionEn: There’s mail for you, Commander. You sure are popular.
mail.caption: 有你的信，指挥官意外地挺受欢迎嘛

main_1.captionEn: Don’t worry, Commander. The fact that you care about me is enough.
main_1.caption: 不用担心，我的话，指挥官有这份心就够了

main_2.captionEn: I wonder if there’s something I can do for you, Commander. You seem tired lately, so maybe a massage would be good?
main_2.caption: 给指挥官准备什么点心好呢……最近好像也挺累的，稍微给那个人按摩一下吧……

main_3.captionEn: See, Commander? You can do it if you set your mind to it!
main_3.caption: 嗯嗯，指挥官只要用心的话还是办得到的呢

mission.captionEn: Completing missions is a great way to hone your skills. Don't ever forget that!
mission.caption: 完成任务是熟练技巧的好途径哦，不要忘了

mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, the mission rewards have arrived.
mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励发放了喔

touch_body.captionEn: If you’re free, why not help with some paperwork?
touch_body.caption: 有这个时间多处理些公文如何？

touch_head.captionEn: I’m not the kind of girl who you can fool with just a few headpats. Get back to work, Commander.
touch_head.caption: 我可不是那种被摸摸头就可以蒙混过去的女孩子哦，指挥官，请好好工作

touch_special.captionEn: This isn’t something a commander should be doing...
touch_special.caption: 这可不是指挥官应有的行为哦

wedding.captionEn: This is the proof that Commander acknowledges me... Understood. From now on, I shall stay by your side and work hard to ensure that your life is happy and upstanding.
wedding.caption: 这就是指挥官对我的认可……我明白了，我Z23从今往后也会一直陪在指挥官你的身边，为你能够正确又愉快的生活努力的

complete.captionEn: Waiting at the harbor for dispatched ships to return... is something I’ve ever experienced before.
complete.caption: 在港口等待外出执行委托的舰船归来……这也是我来到这里前未曾拥有过的体验

home.captionEn: Have you prepared yourself? Then let us proceed to our next battlefield. This battle shall thusly be dubbed: "Soaking in the Shallows!"
home.caption: 准备好了吗？那就前往下一个战场吧，名为「海水浴场」的战场——

login.captionEn: The midsummer seaside is full of the unknown... Let's go explore it together!
login.caption: 盛夏的海边，充满了未知与谜团…一起去探索吧！

mail.captionEn: Receiving mail is proof of the expectations and trust that people have in you.
mail.caption: 有新邮件是被人期待与信赖的证明

main_1.captionEn: The hot summer and the refreshing ice... what a wonderful contradiction.
main_1.caption: 酷暑与冰，真是妙不可言的一对矛盾。

main_2.captionEn: Trust your instincts and your courage. They will guide you forward.
main_2.caption: 相信你心中的直觉与勇气吧，它会指引你前进的。

main_3.captionEn: No matter how many times, I will always believe in your words. I can always trust that you will guide me down the right path.
main_3.caption: 无论多少次，我都会相信你的话。只要是你，一定指引我走向正确道路的吧。

mission.captionEn: Unknown beings and new acquaintances... let us sally forth to meet them!
mission.caption: 前去邂逅未知与相遇吧！

mission_complete.captionEn: Freedom and fortune only favor the hardworking.
mission_complete.caption: 自由与命运只垂青每天努力的人

touch_body.captionEn: I truly do exist, and am needed by everyone...
touch_body.caption: 我确实的存在着，被大家需要着……

touch_special.captionEn: Why... is there hesitation in your eyes?
touch_special.caption: 为何…你的双眼正诉说着犹豫？

wedding.captionEn: My beloved, I have long awaited this day. What name have you decided to bestow upon me?
wedding.caption: 我挚爱的人啊，我已经期待这一天很久了，你为我准备了怎样的名字？

complete.captionEn: Waiting at the harbor for dispatched ships to return... is something I’ve ever experienced before.
complete.caption: 在港口等待外出执行委托的舰船归来……这也是我来到这里前未曾拥有过的体验

home.captionEn: Steel yourselves for this upcoming battle! Intense fights await, at our next sports meet!
home.caption: 新的战斗已经迫在眉睫，做好准备吧，迎接名为“运动会”的紧张战斗——

login.captionEn: This world is so different that from what I was expecting. How interesting!
login.caption: 这个世界和我料想的大不相同，真有趣！

mail.captionEn: Receiving mail is proof of the expectations and trust that people have in you.
mail.caption: 有新邮件是被人期待与信赖的证明

main_1.captionEn: To compete with others and prove your worth, through different means than fighting battles... To be crowned "champion," 'tis a great feeling.
main_1.caption: 与他人竞争，通过战斗之外的方式证明自己，夺取“冠军”……这样的感觉，很奇妙

main_2.captionEn: Even in this little academy, there are so many things to do and see...
main_2.caption: 光是在小小的学园中，就还有这么多我未曾经历与体验的事物…

main_3.captionEn: Whether your sweat is falling on the track, or your words are encouraging others, all of this is an unforgettable experience.
main_3.caption: 无论是在赛道上挥洒汗水，还是在赛道旁为她人加油，都是令人难忘的体验

mission.captionEn: Unknown beings and new acquaintances... let us sally forth to meet them!
mission.caption: 前去邂逅未知与相遇吧！

mission_complete.captionEn: Freedom and fortune only favor the hardworking.
mission_complete.caption: 自由与命运只垂青每天努力的人

touch_body.captionEn: Just a small piece of paper... can create such a profound tie between people... this "scavenger hunt" is more interesting than I thought.
touch_body.caption: 仅凭小小的纸条，就能与她人产生不一样的联系…「借物竞赛」，比想象中的更加有趣

touch_special.captionEn: Where are your fingers... Is there really anything worth exploring right there?
touch_special.caption: 这里…有什么值得探索的事物吗？

wedding.captionEn: My beloved, I have long awaited this day. What name have you decided to bestow upon me?
wedding.caption: 我挚爱的人啊，我已经期待这一天很久了，你为我准备了怎样的名字？

complete.captionEn: A commission fleet has returned to port. I wish for them to see me as I am now, as a beloved idol.
complete.caption: 委托的舰船回港了。作为受人崇拜的偶像，向她们展示自己的存在吧

home.captionEn: The stage is yet another battlefield, where wars are fought not with steel and fire, but with our charm and earnest desire.
home.caption: 此处亦是战场，是名为“偶像”的存在赌上一切战斗的，唤作“舞台”的战场。

login.captionEn: As long as your eyes are fixed upon me; Upon this stage I shall sing bravely.
login.caption: 只要你注视着，我就有在舞台之上一直唱下去的勇气。

mail.captionEn: Receiving mail is proof of the expectations and trust that people have in you.
mail.caption: 有新邮件是被人期待与信赖的证明

main_1.captionEn: The star-lit stage is another world of its own, an ajar door to the unknown that now beckons me...
main_1.caption: 光芒照耀下的舞台，是一方独立的世界，未知的世界之门，正在向我打开……

main_2.captionEn: My dear friend, there is no reason to worry about me. All of this was made possible by Z23, Z35, Graf Spee, Admiral Hipper... We are all connected by the bonds of the Iron Blood.
main_2.caption: 吾友，无须为我担心。这一切皆是Z23和Z35、斯佩和希佩尔，以及我等铁血全员之羁绊所创造之物

main_3.captionEn: Take heed of where the other performers and your audience are looking? ...I see. I understand why such a thing is important, but can you explain to me why it is called the "Evil Eye?"
main_3.caption: 望向同台上演出者与台下之观众们的视线…原来如此，确实很重要，其被称为“魔眼”的原因也一块告诉我吧

mission.captionEn: Unknown beings and new acquaintances... let us sally forth to meet them!
mission.caption: 前去邂逅未知与相遇吧！

mission_complete.captionEn: Freedom and fortune only favor the hardworking.
mission_complete.caption: 自由与命运只垂青每天努力的人

touch_body.captionEn: My singing voice... is proof of my existence.
touch_body.caption: 这“歌声”，便是此刻的我存在于此的证明。

touch_special.captionEn: If your desire is righteous, then why do your hands tremble?
touch_special.caption: 如果你的渴求是正确的，那你的手为何在颤抖？

wedding.captionEn: My beloved, I have long awaited this day. What name have you decided to bestow upon me?
wedding.caption: 我挚爱的人啊，我已经期待这一天很久了，你为我准备了怎样的名字？

complete.captionEn: Commander, you must profusely thank all these girls for ensuring the safe delivery of these supplies.
complete.caption: 能将这么多物资安全运到，真的很了不起呢…要好好慰劳她们哦，指挥官

home.captionEn: Legs straight, calves stretched– Ah, welcome back, Commander. I suppose you can tell I've been teaching the others to swim. Would you like me to teach you as well?
home.caption: 打水的时候腿部自然伸直，脚面要绷直——…啊，欢迎回来。如你所见，我正在教她们游泳呢，指挥官想要接受我的指·导吗~？哈哈

login.captionEn: Commander, please be careful swimming in the deep end, okay?
login.caption: 指挥官，如果想去深水区游泳的话，还请稍微注意安全哦？

mail.captionEn: Commander? The mail is here. If you don't get to it soon, I could always read it out loud for you? I wonder if there are any love letters, hehehe...
mail.caption: 指挥官，邮件已经送到了。再不收的话，我就要替您大声念出来了哦？也许会是哪个孩子的“情书”也说不定呢~？

main_1.captionEn: Hey, no horseplay in the pool!
main_1.caption: （哔哔——）那边的小朋友们，泳池里不能做刚刚那样的危险动作哦！

main_2.captionEn: I really like swimming, but the submarines and destroyers are always faster... Why is that, Commander...?
main_2.caption: 唔…虽然我很喜欢游泳，不过速度总是比不过潜艇和驱逐们呢…指挥官，你知道为什么吗~？

main_3.captionEn: Speed is one thing, but I'm quite confident in my stamina. How about it, Commander? Want to try me?
main_3.caption: 虽然速度不敢说，不过对于耐力我可是很有自信的哦？指挥官想要和我比比吗~？

mission.captionEn: Is this mission giving you trouble? Here, let me take a look.
mission.caption: 嗯？遇到困难的任务了吗？让我帮你看看吧。

mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! My my, that's quite a big reward there, isn't it? Well done, Commander~
mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了！奖励很丰厚呢，指挥官值得表扬啊，好孩子好孩子~

touch_body.captionEn: Your eyes are wandering. Hehe, what's on your mind? You can tell me.
touch_body.caption: 眼睛在看着哪里呢？嘻嘻~有什么想法的话，不妨都告诉我吧。

touch_special.captionEn: Really now, Commander? I understand your eagerness, but there's a time and place, no?
touch_special.caption: 真是的~指挥官？就算再怎么心急，也要看看周围的环境吧？

wedding.captionEn: You really think you can bind me to you with nothing but a cheap little ring? This isn't nearly enough~ ... Hehe, don't give me that face... Haha, I'm only joking~ Don't worry, Commander. I'll be with you forever.
wedding.caption: 用这么一枚小小的戒指，就想把扎拉永远地留在身边…你是不是想得太简单了点…？——啊哈哈，指挥官这样的表情，真是百看不厌呢~开玩笑的~就算没有这个，我也不会轻易离开你的身边的，安心吧——

complete.captionEn: The commission fleet's back? Y-yeah, we did send one out earlier, huh... Wh-what, I didn't forget about that!
complete.caption: 委托队回来了？好像是有这么一回事…我，我可没有忘记哦？

home.captionEn: Ugh, my back and legs are all sore... Commander, hang in there a bit longer for my sake, alright? I'm done for... I need to rest first...
home.caption: 呜，腰和腿都好酸……指挥官，你再努力一会！我不行了，我先休息一下……

login.captionEn: Almost got it... Huh? Commander, what are you doing here all of a sudden? Hey, get back here, you dumb bird! Now look what you did! It got away because of you! Ughhh, why is this even happening?!
login.caption: 就差一点了……等下，指挥官，你怎么突然来了！啊，又给它跑掉了！……我也没有怪你啦！哎，怎么会这样……

mail.captionEn: Why's there a letter addressed to you in a place like this? Did you misplace it or something?
mail.caption: 为什么这里会有指挥官你的信件……是不小心落下的吗？

main_1.captionEn: Ying! Swei! I know you're behind all this, so get these little guys to knock it off already!
main_1.caption: 应！瑞！我知道是你搞的鬼，快让这小家伙停下来！

main_2.captionEn: Commander, um... Can you try to make things less awkward? You know, the two of us hiding under a table like this, umm... might cause some serious misunderstandings...
main_2.caption: 指挥官，那个……说点什么缓解下尴尬吧？两个人趴在桌子底下，会，会招来奇怪的误解的……

main_3.captionEn: I wonder how the decorations for the other parts of the port are coming along... Huh? You've already taken care of everything? W-wow, you're pretty reliable, huh...
main_3.caption: 不知道港区里其它地方装饰得怎样了……欸，你说你都已经安排好了？你还挺可靠的嘛！

mission.captionEn: We've got new missions! Hurry up and take a look! Otherwise, Ying Swei is going to complain about me nagging again!
mission.caption: 有新的任务！赶紧去看看啦！免得应瑞又说我像个老妈子一这催你那催你…

mission_complete.captionEn: That mission was a piece of cake! ...W-well, I suppose your efforts helped!
mission_complete.caption: 这些简单的任务，对我不过是小菜一碟啦~啊啊当然也有指挥官的功劳在里面！

touch_body.captionEn: I, I didn't touch you on purpose, okay? I'm sorry! It's all because this little bugger here made me do it...
touch_body.caption: 我，我不是故意要碰到你的，对不起！都怪这小家伙和应瑞……

touch_head.captionEn: Ahhhh!! You're gonna mess it up, so stop touching already!
touch_head.caption: 别摸了别摸了，头发要被你摸炸了啦！

touch_special.captionEn: Y-y-y-y-y-you pervert! I can't believe you'd take advantage of another person's misery like this...!
touch_special.caption: 你你你你这乘人之危的坏家伙！呜呜……

wedding.captionEn: At a time like this, I'm supposed to say "may we hold hands and hope to live forever with one another" or something like that, right... Ahh, I can't remember this stuff! A-anyway, you have to take good care of me from now on! Got it?!
wedding.caption: 那个……“执子之手，与子偕老”…是这个时候说的对吧？还，还有什么这个时候能引用上的啊……啊啊啊算了想不到了！！总之，指挥官，从今你以后你要好好对我负责！记住了吗！

main_2.caption: 身为Lucky Lou，我对推算运势很拿手哦
main_2.captionEn: I am Lucky Lou. I may not look like it, but I actually have experience with fortune-telling.

home.caption: 如果这次徒劳而返，那么下次定能有所斩获，咦……这是谁对我说的来着？
home.captionEn: Always remember: "the feud chair is unpredictable"… Hmm, I heard that from someone, but who…?

main_3.caption: 哇，果然还是有点冷啊，指挥官，再靠近我一点，帮我暖暖手吧~
main_3.captionEn: Brr... It's actually a bit cold... Commander, could you come a little closer and... share your body heat with me?

main_1.caption: 如果出击的时候也能带着这把椅子就好了……海伦娜，能帮我改造下舰装吗？
main_1.captionEn: How I wish I could bring this chair with me on sorties... Helena, could you help upgrade my rigging?

complete.caption: 嗯……OK，就穿这套衣服前往港口吧
complete.captionEn: Hmm... Okay, I'll go greet the returning commission team with these clothes.

wedding.caption: 咦，怎么突然要送我礼物？嘿嘿，原来是这个啊……那么，指挥官，能帮我戴上吗~
wedding.captionEn: Oh dear, why are you giving me a present all of a sudden... Ah, I see, it's one of these... Okay, could I ask you to put it on my finger for me, Commander?

touch_special.caption: 欸，这里的穿法不对？真的吗（怀疑）？
touch_special.captionEn: Oh, do you mean I've put it on wrong? Have I really...?

mail.caption: 新的邮件？一定是捷报吧！
mail.captionEn: New mail? It must be good news!

mission.caption: 嘿嘿，指挥官，请做好与惊喜邂逅的准备哟
mission.captionEn: Hey, Commander, you should prepare yourself for a real surprise.

touch_body.caption: 碰触我运气就会变好？好像没有这种传闻呢
touch_body.captionEn: You get good luck if you touch me? I've never heard of that before.

mission_complete.caption: 嘻嘻，指挥官真是爱撒娇呢……那么，就稍微让你枕一会好了~
mission_complete.captionEn: Hehe... You're so spoiled, Commander... Okay, before you go and collect those rewards, you can stay here for a while and rest if you want.

login.caption: 指挥官，好运是不会长久眷顾一人的……所以，趁着运势尚佳，去大干一场吧！
login.captionEn: Luck never stays with one person for too long, Commander. We should make the best use of it while we still have it.

complete.caption: 委托组的大家回来了！作为正义的一方得去迎接大家才行！
complete.captionEn: Commission team just got back. You know what that means: we gotta give 'em a true kung-fu hero welcome!

login.caption: 喝！哈！…呼……指挥官？你是来参观的吗？哈哈，先不说我这身，明石准备的这套布景还是挺厉害的吧？
login.captionEn: Hoo! Hi-yaaah! Whew... 'sup, Commander? Came to watch? Cool, cool. Never mind me though, check out this ballin' backdrop Akashi hooked me up with!

main_1.caption: 居然能做出那么厉害的功夫动作，平海和宁海还真是厉害…
main_1.captionEn: Have you seen Ning and Ping's mad acrobatic skills? The stuff they can do legit blows my mind...

main_2.caption: 喝啊啊啊！好！气势出来了！唔？哇哇哇收到新消息了！
main_2.captionEn: Hi-yaaah! Oh yeah, frickin' nailed it! Aw, hang on, Juustagram DM just came in!

main_3.caption: “必杀！旋风腿！闪电五连鞭！”…啊，好疼！…唔，我的运动神经要做这么高难度的动作还是不太行啊…
main_3.captionEn: "My final move! Spinning Bird: Thunder Whip!" ...Ow, ow, ow! Lesson learned: this move's too advanced for my lacking motor skills...

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成！在拍下个镜头之前把奖励给领了吧！
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission donezo! Got another scene coming up, so we'd better go get those rewards now.

touch_body.caption: 嗯嗯~很舒服~…做这些武打动作还是挺累人的呢…
touch_body.captionEn: Ooh, that's good... Your muscles get real stiff after so much action.

touch_head.caption: 虽然包子头算是约定俗成，不过还是会想换点别的发型试试呢。
touch_head.captionEn: I know hairbuns are cliché, but I wanted to change up my style, y'know?

touch_special.caption: 哼哼，想尝尝这种的厉害吗？
touch_special.captionEn: Heheh, you really wanna taste my kung-fu fury that badly?

mail.caption: 指挥官，你的信。不是什么重要内容的话，我就帮你回了吧！
mail.captionEn: Got a letter for you here. If it's nothing important, I could read it for ya.

mission.caption: 有任务把你难住了？让我看看我能不能帮上些什么。
mission.captionEn: Are these missions tough stuff? Hmm... Maybe I'll take a look, see if there's anything I can help with.

wedding.caption: 那，指挥官，请你闭上眼睛。为什么？欸，就听我一回嘛，反正我又不会忽悠你的，对吧？嘻嘻~要把接下来的感觉，牢牢刻印在心里哦！
wedding.captionEn: Okay, now keep your eyes closed, Commander. "Why"? Come on, I'm not gonna mess with you, so just relax and do it~ I wanna remember this feeling every morning I wake up for the rest of my life♪

home.caption: 呼…啊，指挥官是不是想偷懒了？嘿嘿，没问题啦，有秘书舰一起在的话反正也不会有人发现的~
home.captionEn: Phew... Hey, Commander, you're thinking about skippin' work, aren't you? Hah, I'm fine with that. It'll just be you and me taking a short break, nobody'll notice.

home.caption: 指挥官，你总算回来了，轮盘游戏我已经玩腻了~！来陪我玩些更刺激的吧……大家都在看？那就让她们看好了，嘻嘻……
home.captionEn: Commandeeer, you're finally back~ Hahaha, I'm tired of roulette. Let's do something more fun... What? Everyone can see us? Let them watch~ Heehee♪

login.caption: 指挥官，来点果汁？还是烟熏麦芽饮料？还是喝点别的……解渴的方式有很多种，对吧~？
login.captionEn: Would you like some juice, Commander? A smoked malt? Don't worry... There are plenty of ways to quench your thirst.

main_1.caption: 喜欢这条裙子吗？手抓住这里，只要轻轻一扯，就会掉下来哦。
main_1.captionEn: Isn't this dress just lovely? See, if I grab here and pull... Heehee, it comes right off.

main_2.caption: 指挥官……或者应该称呼你为“传说中的赏金猎人”？嗯？这个称呼让你这么有感觉吗？
main_2.captionEn: Commander... Oh, should I call you "legendary bounty hunter"? Really? That gets you more in the mood, doesn't it?

main_3.caption: 来跟我赌一把吗？赢了的人可以为所欲为哦~♡~？
main_3.captionEn: How's about a wager? Whoever wins gets to do whatever they want to the loser. For example... Bang♥

main_4.caption: 指挥官，你要的果汁……哎呀~一不小心打翻在身上了……你还要喝吗♡~？
main_4.captionEn: Here's the juice you ordered. ...Oh, I spilled a little on me. Still want a taste of it...?

touch_body.caption: 看来你更喜欢我穿裙子呢，呵呵~
touch_body.captionEn: You like seeing me in this dress, don't you? Heehee♪

touch_head.caption: 凌乱一些的发型会让你更有感觉吗？
touch_head.captionEn: Do you like it more when my hair's a little disheveled?

touch_special.caption: 来赌一把吧，赢了，才能更进一步哦~
touch_special.captionEn: Let's gamble on it. If you win, I'll let you take the next step♪

complete.caption: 嗯？是委托组回来了哦，怎么办，要我停下来吗~？呵呵~
complete.captionEn: Hm? The commission team is back? Should we cut things short for now, then? Heehee♪

mission.caption: 赶紧做完这些无趣的任务吧，待会我让你看个有趣的东西……
mission.captionEn: Go do your lame missions, okay? I'll show you something fun later.

mission_complete.caption: 我对任务完成的奖励没什么兴趣哦……我更好奇指挥官会给我什么奖励呢？
mission_complete.captionEn: I'm not really interested in mission rewards. What I AM interested in is the reward you'll give me, though♪

mail.caption: 指挥官，你的信……啊，没什么，我只是在想，如果把字写在身体上……
mail.captionEn: Commander, mail for you. Ah... No, nothing. I was just wondering if I should write something on my skin for you, instead of on paper...

wedding.caption: 哎呀~要把这个送给我吗~？指挥官，你应该明白这意味着什么吧？以后你必须满足我的一切欲望，再也不能逃开了哦♡~
wedding.captionEn: Aww, is this for me? You understand what this means, don't you? Heehee, this means you'll never get to escape. You'll have to keep satisfying my lust forever and ever♥

home.caption: Honey准时到达！哼哼~我的鼓励果然很管用吧！
home.captionEn: You're right on time, my honey! Hehe♪ Guess my cheers worked like a charm, after all.

login.caption: 我在这里哦Honey——嘿嘿，这个位置最棒了哦，既能第一时间捕捉到你，又可以吹到凉凉的空调，超舒服的啦~
login.captionEn: Over here, honey! Hehe, this is the best seat in the house! I've got the AC at my back, and I can still see you as soon as you arrive! Ah, perfection.

main_1.caption: Honey你看那条赛道，在阳光下闪闪发光的，像不像一条冠军之路呢~
main_1.captionEn: Look at the track, honey! It's sparkling in the sun like a glorious road to victory!

main_2.caption: 我在车载冰箱里放了些新口味冰淇淋哦，Honey快来尝尝吧！
main_2.captionEn: I put some new ice cream flavors in your car's freezer! Give 'em a try, honey!

main_3.caption: 比赛结束之后想和Honey一起去兜风啊~这次换我载着Honey吧？放心，保证让你体验到最最最心跳加速的安全驾驶哦♪
main_3.captionEn: After the race, let's go on a nice drive together. It's my turn to take the wheel! I promise you it'll be both exciting and super-safe!

touch_body.caption: 准备出发了吗？那就让我再为Honey送上鼓励之吻吧~
touch_body.captionEn: Ready to drive? Then let me send you off with one last kiss!

touch_head.caption: 怎么啦，想要更多亲亲嘛？啊哈哈，果然是这样吧~♡
touch_head.captionEn: What's the matter? Want more kisses? Haha, I thought so♡

touch_special.caption: 真是的，虽然后备箱里是很宽敞没错啦……///
touch_special.captionEn: Geez, honey... I know the trunk is spacious, but c'mon...

complete.caption: 委托队已经在港口了。走吧，你的慰问对她们来说便是最大的鼓励哦~嘻嘻♪
complete.captionEn: Your commission fleet's back. Are your words of praise not the best reward you can give them? Hehe~♪

main_4.caption: 这件事……指挥官说的也有道理呢…那么接下来听听我的方案吧？
main_4.captionEn: About that matter... I must admit that you have a point, Commander. How about taking my suggestion next time though?

main_5.caption: 航空母舰的时代啊……那可不好说。既然航空母舰会发展，谁又说得清战列舰会有什么变化呢~
main_5.captionEn: It's now the age of carriers? ...Dunno about that. If carriers are able to evolve, what's to say that battleships can't also evolve?

mail.caption: 有新的邮件哦。哈哈，果然你很期待有人来信嘛～
mail.captionEn: You've got new mail. Heh, dont'cha just love the anticipation~?

mission_complete.caption: 既然重要的任务已经完成了，不如就休息一下吧？凡事都分下轻重缓急，会比较轻松哦？
mission_complete.captionEn: Since we already got the hard stuff out of the way, why not take a little break? It's gonna be pretty easy to prioritize whatever is left~

main_6.caption: 白鹰的“Big J”，最大最强的“Black Dragon”就是我啦！……唔，是不是有点太浮夸了？
main_6.captionEn: They call me Big J or the Black Dragon of the Eagle Union! ...What, got a problem with talking myself up a bit?

mission.caption: 你接下了这个新任务吗？好，让我们一起解决掉吧。
mission.captionEn: Did you already accept this mission? Sounds good, let's take care of it together.

wedding.caption: 你的想法，已经全部传达给我了。如果指挥官不嫌弃的话我当然也没问题哦~？既然如此，我也要再向指挥官告白一次才对吧？嘻嘻，这才叫彼此都要多多为了对方着想嘛♡
wedding.captionEn: Commander, I can already hear everything you're thinking. As long as you're fine with it, I don't have any objections~ After all, I still owe you a proper confession, don't I? Hehe, don'tcha think that's what mutual love is supposed to look like?

home.caption: 雨后的林间散发着清新的气息，令人心情舒畅。指挥官，一会我们一起去散步吧？
home.captionEn: The smell of a freshly rained-on forest is so refreshing and relaxing. Say, Commander, how about we take a little walk together?

login.caption: 偶尔在林间泡一下温泉，感觉身体和精神都放松了不少……欸？糟糕……绳子、散开了……！？
login.captionEn: There's something so relaxing about a nice hot spring bath in the woods once in a while... Hm? Oh, man... My top came undone?!

main_1.caption: 听说橙子的香气能缓解晕眩，这样清新的味道让人感到很安心。欸，原来是指挥官准备的吗……谢谢你。
main_1.captionEn: They say the smell of oranges can cure dizziness. It's soothing, that's for sure. Oh, you brought me some? Thanks.

main_2.caption: 指挥官，水池里还算凉爽，我的体温现在正常了不少。只是这里还有点热……不如拿花洒降降温吧。
main_2.captionEn: Commander, I've cooled down a bit, and the water's just right. Still a little hot... Maybe I'll take a shower to chill out a little more.

main_3.caption: 小心，花洒的水压有点——指、指挥官？！哈哈……这下你和我一样，都湿漉漉的了。
main_3.captionEn: Be careful. The water pressure in the shower is – C-Commander?! Haha... You're soaked!

touch_body.caption: 我身上已经染上橙子的味道了？呵呵，指挥官也要来一些么？
touch_body.captionEn: I smell like oranges? Heheh, want one?

touch_special.caption: 指挥官~！好、好像……又升温了……
touch_special.captionEn: I-is it just me, or is it getting hot in here...?

complete.caption: 我一直在战场上所以明白后勤有多重要，指挥官，去迎接那些在幕后努力的姐妹们吧
complete.captionEn: I've been on the battlefield for a long time, so I know about the importance of logistics. Commander, let's greet the girls who work hard behind the scenes.

mission.caption: 指挥官，还有任务没有完成，赶快出发吧
mission.captionEn: Commander, your missions are not yet completed. Hurry up and set off!

mail.caption: 指挥官，有新邮件
mail.captionEn: Commander, it's a new mail.

mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，奖励收到了
mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, the rewards are here.

wedding.caption: 我曾横跨无数战场，也迎接过无数别离，我的身上承载着无数的夙愿与意志。指挥官做好承担这一切的准备了吗？——是吗…那就一起走下去吧，直到生命的尽头
wedding.captionEn: I carry with me the hopes and wills of the countless battlefields and goodbyes that I have experienced. Commander, are you prepared to shoulder them all? …I see. Then let us walk together until the end of our lives.

complete.caption: 参与委托的大家好像回来了呢，指挥官先去迎接她们吧~等您回来的时候，一定会让您喝到最完美的特调！
complete.captionEn: The commission team is here. Why don't you go see them first? I'll have the perfect drink waiting when you get back.

home.caption: 指挥官~你回来了，能帮我拿一下你手边的杯子吗？特调好了，现在就可以品尝了，这个味道你一定会喜欢的~
home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commandeeer~ Hehe, could you get that cup there? It's a cocktail for you. Drink it – I think you'll like it!

login.caption: 指挥官，特调需要指定吗？还是说……更期待我准备的惊喜口味呢？
login.captionEn: Commander, about that special cocktail... Do you have any requests? Or would you prefer... a surprise flavor?

mail.caption: 指挥官，好像有新的邮件哦？唔……我现在这身衣服，去拿邮件的话会吓到大家吧……
mail.captionEn: Commander, new mail just came in. Ah... Everyone might be surprised if they see me picking it up in this outfit...

main_1.caption: 唔……这里没有，那里也没有……我之前把雪克壶放到哪里了呢……？
main_1.captionEn: Hmm... Not over there, not over here... Where in the world did I put that shaker?

main_2.caption: ……这身衣服显得我，好像有点过于积极了。不过，既然指挥官喜欢的话……倒也不算坏。
main_2.captionEn: Does this getup make me look a little too bold? As long as you like it... I-I'm fine with that...

main_3.caption: 摇酒也很需要技巧哦……呵呵，别担心，这种事情我还是能应付的哦~
main_3.captionEn: Shaking drinks takes a certain level of skill. Hehe, don't worry. I might not look it, but I'm very capable!

main_4.caption: 听说在特调里加入柠檬汁，可以增加口感层次呢，我也试试吧~……呀，汁水没溅到指挥官吧……！
main_4.captionEn: I heard that adding lemon juice can enhance the mouthfeel of a cocktail. I'll try... Eep?! Commander, are you okay?!

mission.caption: 指挥官，在我找到雪克壶之前，先把剩下的任务完成吧？
mission.captionEn: How about you work on your leftover missions while I search for that darn shaker?

mission_complete.caption: 要庆祝任务完成吗？那就多试几杯特调吧~
mission_complete.captionEn: Wanna celebrate another mission well done? Then I'd better make some more cocktails!

touch_body.caption: 真是的，别在这种时候恶作剧呢~
touch_body.captionEn: Geez, now isn't the time to tease~

touch_special.caption: 指挥官也太心急了吧……///
touch_special.captionEn: Oh, Commander... You're so greedy... *blush*

main_5.caption: 就和我们不是仅为战斗而存在一样，指挥官也不是仅为工作而存在。如果进展不顺的话，就转换下心情，让大脑休息下吧。
main_5.captionEn: Just as how we are not here only to fight, Commander, you are not here only to work. If you're not making progress, take a break and come back refreshed later.

touch_head.caption: 我也像小孩子一样撒娇试试…？
touch_head.captionEn: Maybe I should try getting you to pamper me like a little child~?

wedding.caption: 我发誓，约克城之名所背负的自由与和平，约克城所希望的幸福的每一天，约克城真挚的爱意……全部以这双唇的温暖，赠予您——
wedding.captionEn: I swear upon the freedom and peace borne within the name of Yorktown, upon the life of happiness that I so desire, and upon my pure love... That the warmth of my lips now belongs to you–

home.caption: 嗯？正好这个时候回来了吗……指挥官，请把清洁布递给我吧~
home.captionEn: Oh? You're just in time... Commander, would you please hand me that cloth?

login.caption: 我好像发现扮演女仆的乐趣所在了……只是做好自己的事情，就能让指挥官也感到舒心，这样不是很好吗~
login.captionEn: I think I'm starting to understand the joys of being a maid. Just doing my job well makes you more comfortable. Isn't that wonderful?

main_1.caption: 呼~很快就好了哦，指挥官等下休息的时候想做些什么呢？至于在哪里休息……当然是回我怀里♪
main_1.captionEn: Phew... I'm almost done here. How do you plan to relax, Commander? Of course, I expect you'll be resting in my arms.

main_2.caption: 咦？指挥官先别动哦，衣领上好像沾到灰尘了……呵呵，注意细节应该也是女仆的必修课吧？
main_2.captionEn: Oh? Commander, stay still. There's dust on your collar... Hehe, isn't it a maid's duty to pay attention to the little details?

main_3.caption: 平时似乎总和你说“交给我吧”之类的话，没想到也有一起手忙脚乱的时候……这种新鲜感，好像也不坏呢呵呵~
main_3.captionEn: I'm always telling you to leave things to me, but I didn't think we'd be this busy... It's kind of refreshing, honestly.

main_4.caption: 偶尔像这样转换身份，和你一起体验这样的情形……也很有趣呢呵呵~不过这样的事情，必须是“我们”一起完成哦？
main_4.captionEn: It's fun to change roles together once in a while, isn't it? Hehe... Yeah! It has to be both of us, together!

touch_body.caption: 唔……这身装束……果然需要兼顾许多细节呢？
touch_body.captionEn: Mm... I really need to be careful when I'm dressed like this, huh?

touch_head.caption: 发丝粘在脸颊上了吗？呵呵，稍微有些出汗了呢~
touch_head.captionEn: Mm... Is my hair sticking to you? Hehe, I might be a little bit sweaty.

touch_special.caption: 这种事情，对于正在努力维持装扮身份的我来说……真是相当狡猾呢~
touch_special.captionEn: Geez, I'm trying really hard to play the part... You're not making it any easier~

mail.caption: 新邮件来了哦~呵呵，希望这里没有混入谁的恶作剧呢~
mail.captionEn: You've got mail! Hehe, I hope there aren't any surprises inside!

complete.caption: 指挥官，委托舰队回来了，我去清点一下她们的成果哦~
complete.captionEn: Commander, the commission team is back. I'll go check on their results!

wedding.caption: 我知道哦，指挥官为了这一刻肯定花了不少心思吧？呵呵，你还是老样子。我的心意也从未改变——在接下来的时间与空间、历史与未来中……我们永远在一起。
wedding.captionEn: I understand, Commander – you put a lot of thought behind this moment, right? Hehe, you're the same as ever. My feelings are the same, too. No matter when, no matter where, we'll always be together.

mission_complete.caption: 呼……任务全部完成。我预约了温泉，一会一起去放松一下吧？
mission_complete.captionEn: Phew... The missions are all done and dusted. I booked us a private trip to the hot spring, if you'd like a little change of pace.

mission.caption: 这一部分任务分给你……这一部分任务交给我……嗯~分工合作，效率加倍~
mission.captionEn: That mission is yours, this one is mine... There. Dividing the labor makes us twice as efficient!

home.caption: Welcome back~今天捕获的阳光、海风，以及你的笑容，都是我新开企划的视频素材哦~当然还是私人收藏版！
home.captionEn: Welcome back! Today's vlog is all about the sun's rays, sea breeze, and your smile. Of course, it'll be for my private collection.

login.caption: Hi~指挥官！风正好、音乐正好、心情正好~我们就在这里一起享受质量满分的阳光吧！
login.captionEn: Hey there, Commander! The breeze is just right, the music is pumping, and the mood is perfect! Come join me in the glorious sunshine!

main_1.caption: 喔哦！质量最高的阳光马上就要洒在我们身上了~引擎开始发烫，指挥官，你的心跳预热好了吗？
main_1.captionEn: Aw, yeah! The perfect sunlight is about to shine down on us! The engine's warmed up – what about your heart, Commander?

main_2.caption: 指挥官……如果现在突然加速，你一定会抓住我的吧？那就立刻证明给我看吧！3、2、1——go！
main_2.captionEn: Commander... If I accelerated right now, would you hold on tight? Then prove it! Three, two, one... Go!

main_3.caption: 疾驰！加速！只要太阳还未落下，我们的今天就永远不会结束！
main_3.captionEn: Full speed ahead! As long as the sun is still in the sky, our day will never end!

mission.caption: 有新的任务？立刻搞定它！奖励是——自由的海边兜风之旅~
mission.captionEn: New missions? Go knock 'em out! Your reward will be... a nice drive down the coastline!

touch_body.caption: 看来今日的阳光，把我晒得相当可口呢~
touch_body.captionEn: My tan's looking just right, huh?

touch_head.caption: 帮我把墨镜拿下来~？呵呵~啾♡！
touch_head.captionEn: Can you move my sunglasses for me? Heheh, mwah!

touch_special.caption: 嗯……指挥官你这样……超速了哦……
touch_special.captionEn: Mm... Commander, that's a speed violation♡

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成！奖励是——接下来和我一起去玩，拍摄双人游玩Vlog！
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! What's your reward? Getting to hang out with me and take travel vids, of course!

complete.caption: 噔噔——！委托队满载而归！快，看看有没有收获绝佳的视频素材！
complete.captionEn: Tadaaa! The commission team returns with tons of loot! Let's see if they brought back some good footage, too!

mail.caption: 听到提示音了~是你的邮件送达了，还是我有新的订阅呢？！
mail.captionEn: I heard a notification ding! Was that new mail for you, or did I get another new subscription?

wedding.caption: 就让镜头来见证吧！属于我们的自由而幸福的时光，就从此刻开始了。指挥官，请和我一起，为这部名为「未来」的Vlog——按下永恒的录制键吧。▷
wedding.captionEn: The camera's going to see all of this! From now on, you and I are going to live a life of freedom and happiness! Hit that record button, Commander... and let's capture the vlog titled "Our Future."

home.caption: 指挥官辛苦了……坐在这里休息一下吧，绝佳的营养补充我已经准备好了，可以慢慢喝呢。
home.captionEn: Good work today, Commander~ Sit down here. The ultimate nutrients await, so drink up♪

login.caption: 指挥官回来得正好，来，到我这里来~现在牛奶的温度刚刚好。
login.captionEn: Commander, you're back just in time. Come on in! My milk is at the perfect temperature now.

main_1.caption: 牛奶里加了助眠的蜂蜜哦~在我怀里好好睡一会儿吧……我会一直这样抱着你的~
main_1.captionEn: I added calming honey to your milk to help you sleep~ Take a nice little nap in my arms... I'll hold you all the way through.

main_2.caption: 体温的交融可以让营养快速转化~欸？说谎吗？呵呵，只是想让你试试我的体温~
main_2.captionEn: Physical affection can help you take in nutrients faster... Hmm? You don't think that's true? Heehee, I just wanted you to feel my body heat.

main_3.caption: 指挥官~这样的温度、这样的柔软、这样的体验，会让你感到舒服和安心吗？
main_3.captionEn: Commander~ If I do... this... do my softness and body heat feel nice and relaxing?

touch_body.caption: 指挥官~想要试试更高阶的营养课程吗？
touch_body.captionEn: Commander~ Wanna try an even more amazing nutritional plan I've been cooking up?

touch_head.caption: 嗯？呵呵呵……乖乖~想摸多久都行哦~
touch_head.captionEn: Mm? Hehehe... For being such a good Commander, you can touch all you like~

touch_special.caption: 哈……指挥官不会想要补充营养了吧~
touch_special.captionEn: Mmm... Are you in the mood for extra nutrients today?

mail.caption: 指挥官，在去查看邮件之前，先把这杯补充精力的果蔬汁喝完吧，是你喜欢的口味。
mail.captionEn: Before you check your mail, drink this vegetable juice to recover your energy. It's your favorite flavor!

complete.caption: 指挥官，委托队的同伴回来了哦~看到大家平安返航，比什么都重要呢~
complete.captionEn: Commander, I hear the girls who went on commission came back~ It's great to know that they're safe.

mission.caption: 指挥官~任务固然重要，但充沛的精力才是基础哦~来，先喝完这杯特制的能量牛奶……然后再去完成任务吧~
mission.captionEn: Commander~ Missions are important, but keeping yourself energized is just as essential. Drink this special energizing milk I made... THEN you can go take care of those missions!

mission_complete.caption: 指挥官~累了吧？来，这是我特制的牛奶布丁！适当补充营养可是很重要的哦~
mission_complete.captionEn: Are you tired, Commander? Hehe, time to have some of my special milk pudding! Nothing is more important than ample nutrition~

wedding.caption: 指挥官，原本我只想用牛奶的温度与营养，将你从疲惫中打捞。但不知不觉间，这份滋养的职责已升华为一生的羁绊……而我，也深深珍视着从你那里收获的……这份名为爱的养分。
wedding.captionEn: At first, I just wanted to soothe you with the warmth and nutrients of milk... But at some point, my feelings turned into a lifelong bond. Heehee... You've given me a nutrient, too, Commander – the one called love.

home.caption: 再赖会儿床吧~我去给你准备早餐，烤面包和牛奶可以么？嗯……不过烤面包机昨天好像被我弄坏了……
home.captionEn: Stay in bed for a while~ I'll go make breakfast. Will milk and toast do? Oh... Right, I broke the toaster yesterday...

login.caption: 你醒了~？……问我为什么不叫醒你？因为指挥官睡着的样子很可爱，忍不住看入迷了~？
login.captionEn: Are you awake? ...Why didn't I wake you? Hmm... Because you looked too cute in your sleep. How could I take my eyes away?♪

main_1.caption: 我去给你倒杯水吧……怎么了？这么舍不得我么？嗯……那就等会再去拿水吧~
main_1.captionEn: I'll get you a glass of water. ...Is something wrong? Oh, you don't want me to leave? Hmm... Okay, the water can wait~

main_2.caption: 这套睡衣指挥官还喜欢么？之后要不要亲自帮我挑选一套~？
main_2.captionEn: Do you like my sleepwear? Heehee, how about you pick for me next time?

main_3.caption: 要把帘子拉上？是阳光太刺眼了么？……担心有人？不用担心，外面只有繁盛的植被，不会有人过来的。
main_3.captionEn: You wanna close the curtain? Is the sun too bright? ...You're worried people will see? It's okay; we're surrounded by greenery. Nobody knows a thing♪

mission.caption: 指挥官，有新的任务了哦，看来不能赖床了呢……或者试试看在床上办公呢？
mission.captionEn: Commander, you have new missions. We can't lie around for much longer... Oh! Can you work from bed?

touch_body.caption: 想再靠近一些么？来吧，枕头也分你一半哦~
touch_body.captionEn: You want to get closer? Be my guest~ I'll share half my pillows!

touch_head.caption: 让我也再睡会儿？好，那我就再陪你睡会儿。
touch_head.captionEn: Do you want me to stay, too? I'd be happy to sleep with you for a while longer♪

touch_special.caption: ……嗯？还想继续么？看来已经完全打起精神了~？
touch_special.captionEn: Hm? You want to go another round? Geez, did you really recover so fast?♡

complete.caption: 指挥官，委托舰队的孩子们都回来了，快去迎接她们吧，她们肯定也很想你。
complete.captionEn: Commander, the girls who went out on commission are back. Go see them, okay? I'm sure they all miss you.

mail.caption: 指挥官，你有新的邮件……让我直接念给你听？唔……应该是这样打开吧……嗯？怎、怎么邮件不见了……
mail.captionEn: Commander, there's new mail... You want me to read it to you? Umm, this is how you open the menu, right... H-huh? Where'd the mail go?

mission_complete.caption: 辛苦了，指挥官，剩下的收尾工作就交给我吧，你早点休息。
mission_complete.captionEn: Good work, Commander. Leave the rest of the work to me while you unwind.

wedding.caption: 再靠近我一些吧，指挥官，我想更近一些地看着你的笑脸，感受你的温度……再将这人生最重要的时刻永远铭记。
wedding.captionEn: Commander, come closer for me... I want to see your smile and feel your warmth, so that I can remember the most important day of my life forever...

complete.caption: 委托小队？简单来说，你是想先去迎接大家再来救关岛对吧？No problem♪
complete.captionEn: The commission team? So you're saying you'll help me AFTER you've gone and greeted them, right? No problem♪

home.caption: 欢迎回来指挥官！哎呀呀腿都麻了——拜托啦，快来救救被困的关岛吧~要是能顺带帮我按摩一下就更好了~！
home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander! My feet are getting kinda numb here... Be a darling and come help me! Getting a little massage would be sweet, too!

login.caption: 这里是忍者关岛，现在正潜入指挥官的房间——哇啊啊啊！？特、特意定制的衣服被卡住了……！？
login.captionEn: This is kunoichi Guam, sneaking right into the Commander's room and– Aaahhh! M-my custom-made outfit got caught on something!

main_1.caption: 先自己想办法？指挥官你这话是认真的吗？这种事，就算是多才多艺的关岛也做不到啊——！
main_1.captionEn: "Try figuring it out on my own first"? Look, Commander, I may be multitalented, but even I have limits on what I can and can't do!

main_2.caption: 美少女忍者关岛，此时正面临空前绝后的大危机——指挥官一定会就这么审问我……这种时候果然还是老实交代会更好吗？那么……指挥官打算怎么“惩罚”贸然出现的我呢，哎嘿嘿♪
main_2.captionEn: The beautiful kunoichi Guam's in a real pickle! Now the Commander's gonna interrogate her! ...You reckon I should just play it straight in this case? Alright, then how are you gonna punish me for showing up out of nowhere, huh? Heehee♪

main_3.caption: Chill，It's fine！虽然从各个角度来说都算是完全暴露了，但只要节目效果拉满就没有任何问题了！……对吧？
main_3.captionEn: Chill, it's fine! Sure, some inappropriate parts might be showing, but it's all good as long as we have fun... right?

touch_body.caption: 哇啊，衣服……！这、这种画面可不能剪进节目里哦！！
touch_body.captionEn: Oh, no, my clothes... Hey, you can't show this on TV!

touch_special.caption: 啊哈哈♡看来正如期待那般，要变成色色的展开啦？！
touch_special.captionEn: Ahaha♡ Are we heading in a sexy direction after all?

mail.caption: 有・你・的・信！检查这些也相当不容易呢……
mail.captionEn: Letter for you! Gotta say, this one was a pretty hard read.

mission.caption: 任务开始！赶紧出发吧！我会在这里宣传指挥官的出色表现！
mission.captionEn: Mission commencing! Now get going! I'll stay here and report on your performance!

main_5.caption: 艺人就是要多才多艺才行☆要什么都会才能让指挥官和伙伴们多依赖我♪
main_5.captionEn: A presenter's gotta be multiskilled! 'Cause if I can do anything, people entrust me with more things!

mission_complete.caption: 任务结束！比我完成日常训练还要快，不愧是指挥官——♪
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! Wow, you got that done quicker than I could finish my daily lessons♪

touch_head.caption: 欸嘿嘿，欸嘿嘿嘿嘿♪
touch_head.captionEn: Heehee, heeheeheehee♪

wedding.caption: 这、这是！？从指挥官这里得到的特别奖励……指挥官，我可以拿出来炫耀吗？就算你说不行，我还是想要展示出来～因为这是只属于我的特别奖励……（害羞）
wedding.captionEn: Whoa, what?! You just gave me an extraordinary gift... You mind if I go flaunt this to everybody? I wanna show it off even if you say no! 'Cause this gift is mine and mine only, and it's something special... *blushes*

main_4.caption: 指挥官～♪啊哈哈，有反应了！那我们就一起偷个懒吧，毕竟你刚刚分心了哟♪
main_4.captionEn: Commaaandeeer! Ahahah! Got your attention! C'mon, let's blow this joint~ You've lost your focus now anyway!

home.caption: 欢迎回来，清洁时间到了哦~之后也让我帮指挥官放松一下吧~
home.captionEn: Welcome back. It's time we got you cleaned up. This time, I'll be the one doing it to you.

login.caption: 指挥官想从哪里开始呢~放心，无论哪里都可以哦，我会好好地……宠着你的~
login.captionEn: I do wonder what part of me you'll clean first. Yes, start with whatever you like. You're mine to spoil right now, after all.

main_1.caption: 指挥官会偏爱什么样的自然香气呢，是熟透的果香，还是幽静森林？……我这款沐浴露的味道就很舒服吗？喜欢的话，就再贴近一些吧~
main_1.captionEn: What sorts of aroma do you like? The fragrance of ripe fruit? The smell of a quiet forest? ...The scent of my body soap? Well, then why don't you come closer?

main_2.caption: 呵呵，身上已经都是泡沫了……指挥官真是坏心眼呢~
main_2.captionEn: Oh dear, I'm all covered in bubbles... You didn't have to go THAT far, Commander.

main_3.caption: 已经清洁到这里了吗，看起来快结束了呢~我不会乱动的，请你放心~……嗯，指挥官很棒呢~
main_3.captionEn: This spot next. We should be nearly done. Don't worry, I'll hold still. Heehee – you're so well-mannered, Commander.

main_4.caption: ……如果这时候藤蔓有在身边，指挥官大概会被牢牢缠住吧~
main_4.captionEn: ...If there were any vines here, I'm sure they'd constrict you right up.

touch_body.caption: 指挥官，这里也要拜托你好好清洁一下了哦~
touch_body.captionEn: Commander, could you clean this spot for me?

touch_head.caption: 明明说好是我来宠着你才对……嗯~是……很舒服~
touch_head.captionEn: Well, if you wish to do it this way... Ahh... Yes, that feels lovely.

touch_special.caption: 嗯……呼……指挥官，是坏孩子呢……要怎么惩罚你才好呢……
touch_special.captionEn: Ahh... Ohh... Naughty-naughty, Commander. What should I do with you?

complete.caption: 这么快就完成了？委托队的大家已经回来了~指挥官，一起去看看她们吧~
complete.captionEn: What's this? The commission team has come back. Come with me and we'll go see them, Commander.

mail.caption: 邮件里有什么有趣的东西吗？记得和我分享哦，指挥官~
mail.captionEn: Did you receive a new letter? Tell me what it's about later.

mission.caption: 指挥官，你该去完成任务了呢。要是太累了，记得回来找我哦~
mission.captionEn: Commander, it's time to do some missions. If you're too tired, come here and I'll look after you.

mission_complete.caption: 真厉害，快来抱抱~指挥官喜欢这种奖励方式吗？
mission_complete.captionEn: My, you're incredible! Come here for a hug. Heehee – is this the kind of reward you prefer?

wedding.caption: 在自然的祝福声中，我们已经不知不觉地步入了爱的秘境……与你相依的时光，就像藤蔓缠绕上了阳光，我心中的爱意也只增不减……指挥官，请握住我的手，让我们聆听着自然的歌谣，在未来的每一天里……继续，携手同行吧~
wedding.captionEn: It seems we've walked into the hidden realm of love whilst blessed by nature... My time spent with you is like a vine in the nourishing sunlight, and our love grows and grows more with time... Take my hand, Commander, and let us listen to the song of nature as we walk into tomorrow.

home.caption: 老师，回来了……安克雷奇，馋了……想喝，牛奶……
home.captionEn: Teacher, welcome back... Anchorage wants milk now... Can we have milk?

login.caption: 老师……也睡不着……？喝牛奶么……？跟安克雷奇……一起！
login.captionEn: You can't sleep either...? Want milk? Drink it... with Anchorage!

mail.caption: 看不清……安克雷奇，去开灯！
mail.captionEn: Can't see... Anchorage will turn on the lights!

main_1.caption: 牛奶……老师喜欢……什么味道……！安克雷奇，草莓味……喜欢！
main_1.captionEn: Teacher... What milk flavor do you like? Anchorage likes... Strawberry!

main_2.caption: 衣服……滑下去了！提上来……又滑下去了……！嘿嘿~
main_2.captionEn: Anchorage's clothes fell...! I pulled them up... and they fell again! Hehe...

main_3.caption: 待会，要刷牙？安克雷奇……会记住的……嗯！
main_3.captionEn: Brush my teeth after...? Anchorage will remember... Yeah!

main_4.caption: 备忘纸条……安克雷奇写的……！贴在冰箱上……就不会忘记……老师说的话！
main_4.captionEn: Anchorage wrote a note! It's on the... re-fridge-erator... So I won't forget what Teacher told me!

touch_body.caption: 去沙发上……喝牛奶……会比较好？嘿嘿~
touch_body.captionEn: Can Anchorage... drink it on the couch? Hehe!

touch_head.caption: 嗯……喝完牛奶……安克雷奇，会好好，睡觉的……！
touch_head.captionEn: Yeah... After I finish the milk... Anchorage will go beddy-bye!

touch_special.caption: 唔……？老师……摸摸？衣服很大……可以伸进来摸摸……？
touch_special.captionEn: Hm? Teacher... Wanna touch? My clothes are big... You can reach in if you want...

mission.caption: 任务…没完成？安克雷奇，想帮忙…嗯！
mission.captionEn: "Mission... incomplete?" Anchorage wants to help...!

complete.caption: 委托…？大家…是去了哪里？安克雷奇，想知道…可以吗？
complete.captionEn: "Commissions"...? Where is everyone...? Anchorage wants to know... Is that okay?

mission_complete.caption: 任务…完成了？老师…好厉害！
mission_complete.captionEn: "Mission... complete?" Teacher, that's great!

wedding.caption: 在一起的…约定…？那，拉勾！…戒指？…要帮我戴上？嗯！…嘿，戴好了！安克雷奇…也做了一个…老师，戴上…嗯！
wedding.captionEn: A promise...? Pinky promise! ...A "ring"? You'll put it on my finger? Yay! Anchorage also made a ring! Teacher, gimme your hand!

home.caption: 指、指挥官！您终于回来啦……！雅努斯本来想贴在玻璃上找您的身影……但果然还是太高了，呜呜……
home.captionEn: Y-you're finally back, Commander! Um, I was thinking about going out and looking for you... then I got too scared...

login.caption: 指挥官，雅努斯还是不敢……不敢自己下水……能不能麻烦您，为我注入一些勇气呢……？
login.captionEn: Commander, I-I... I'm too scared to go in by myself! C-could you please share some of your courage with me?!

main_1.caption: 涂防晒霜的话，果然还是解开比较好吧……雅、雅努斯不是这个意思！只是觉得解开更方便……这么说也不对///……！
main_1.captionEn: I should probably untie this part to get the sunscreen on, shouldn't I? W-wait, I don't mean it like THAT! Just that it would be easier without these strings in the way... Oh, gosh!

main_2.caption: 呀？！风、风好大……再这样下去泳衣就要、就要飞——呜呜，指挥官，请帮我拉一下……
main_2.captionEn: Hyeep, the wind! What if my swimsuit blows away...? Ahh, Commander, I need you to pull this part tight for me!

main_3.caption: 风景……真的很不错？……指、指挥官，可以……把你看到的景色，讲给雅努斯听吗？
main_3.captionEn: You like the view...? C-could you please tell me which view you're talking about?

touch_body.caption: 防晒霜，都抹均匀了呢……谢谢指挥官，这样就可以放心游泳啦~
touch_body.captionEn: The sunscreen is nice and even now... Thank you, Commander! Heehee, I can finally swim without worrying!

touch_head.caption: 指挥官是在安慰雅努斯吗……？嗯！雅努斯振作起来啦！
touch_head.captionEn: Are you trying to encourage me? Th-thank you! I feel more confident now!

touch_special.caption: ……那、那个，能像这样紧紧抱住指挥官的话……雅努斯一点也不害怕哦！
touch_special.captionEn: Ah, umm! Y-you know, when I hold you like this... I don't feel scared anymore!

complete.caption: 委托队回来了……请，请让我一起去迎接！……呜，要不还是算了……
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned... P-please allow me to come with you! ...Well, actually, it's fine if you don't...

mission.caption: 指挥官，任，任务……对、对不起！我不是故意在这个时候提的！
mission.captionEn: Commander, um, about the mission... S-sorry! I wasn't trying to specifically bring that up right now!

mission_complete.caption: 不愧是指挥官，这么快就完成了任务……欸，我也有功劳吗？嗯，嗯！能帮上您就好！
mission_complete.captionEn: Wow, you're already done with your work? How impressive... I-it was only possible because of me...? Th-thank you! I'm glad I was able to be of help!

mail.caption: 指挥官，有你的信件！……太好了顺利传达到了！
mail.captionEn: Commander, your mail is here! ...Phew, I'm glad I was able to deliver it to you promptly!

wedding.caption: 欸！？誓约……也就是说，指挥官对我也……没，没什么！我，我现在很开心！我一定会更加努力，为了帮上指挥官——不，为了能与指挥官相称而努力一生的！
wedding.captionEn: Huh? The two of us, oathbound? ...C-Commander, I never realized you... Oh, it's nothing! I'm so glad! I'll never stop working hard so that I can be of use to you, Commander!

home.caption: （指挥官果然来了，跟我总结的行为习惯差不多……）指挥官，真巧，没想到会在这里遇见您。
home.captionEn: (The Commander's here. Everything's according to plan so far...) Fancy meeting you here, Commander! What a coincidence...

login.caption: 指挥官，您也是出来透透气的么？（这样的说法未免太无聊了……）
login.captionEn: Umm... Did you come for a breath of fresh air, too? (Oh no, am I being too boring?)

main_1.caption: 海风很舒服，不是么？
main_1.captionEn: Mmm... The sea breeze is wonderful, don't you think?

main_2.caption: 今晚果然是个晴天呢，星星很美，如计划中一样……咳、我是说如天气预报播报的一样。（差点说漏嘴了……刚刚的解释是不是太生硬了……）
main_2.captionEn: A cloudless night full of stars, just as I... Ahem. Just as the weather forecast said. (I hope the Commander didn't notice that slip of the tongue...)

main_3.caption: 饮料要试试看么？我没喝过的……喝过也没关系么？
main_3.captionEn: Would you like to try my drink? I haven't put my lips on it yet... It would be okay if I did?

main_4.caption: 躺在这上面还蛮舒服的，指挥官要试试看么？
main_4.captionEn: Phew... Lying down here is so comfortable. Want to join me...?

mission.caption: 指挥官，有新的任务，我陪您一起处理吧……等处理完了，我们……再一起回来。
mission.captionEn: Since you have new missions to do, why don't we take care of them together? Then we can come back together, and...

touch_body.caption: 是喜欢这种款式的衣服么？（确认了，果然指挥官的泳装偏好是这个……）
touch_body.captionEn: Do you like it when girls dress like this? (Yeah, this should be exactly what the Commander likes...)

touch_head.caption: 您的手，就像海风一般……轻柔。（是不是有些太肉麻了……）
touch_head.captionEn: Your hand is as gentle as the sea breeze... (This might be too corny.)

touch_special.caption: ……！是不是在泳池里会比较好……？（我在说什么啊///……）
touch_special.captionEn: Eep?! Th-this might be easier... in the pool... (What am I saying right now?!)

mail.caption: 指挥官，有您的信件。
mail.captionEn: I brought your mail.

complete.caption: 委托队回来了，我随您过去清点物资。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned, Commander. Allow me to check the goods with you.

mission_complete.caption: 辛苦了，指挥官，这是任务报酬。
mission_complete.captionEn: Well done, Commander. Your mission rewards are right this way.

wedding.caption: 比起言语，我更想用行动证明……我会一直在您身边，以此剑，守护您。
wedding.captionEn: Okay... I want to explain my feelings with actions rather than words. From now on, I'll be ever by your side, protecting you with this very sword.

complete.caption: 这是这次的清单……对不起，掉下去了！我这就把它捞上来！
complete.captionEn: The commission list... Oh, I'm sorry, it was on the floor! I'll pick it up right now!

home.caption: 呜……丝带打结了，没办法在此刻迎接您是天狼星的失职……请主人惩罚我这个笨拙的女仆吧……
home.captionEn: Aah, my ribbon's tangled... honourable Master, umm, I must apologize for not being able to properly greet you... Please punish your stupid, clumsy maid!

login.caption: 欢迎回来，为了缓解主人的疲劳，天狼星这就为您献上练习许久的舞蹈。
login.captionEn: Welcome back, honourable Master. I've put many hours into this dance, and now, I hope it will soothe your fatigue!

mail.caption: 要用这样的姿势把信给主人……为了骄傲的主人，天狼星能做到！
mail.captionEn: Giving you mail while I'm in this state... Oh, don't worry! For you, honourable Master, I'll do it right!

main_1.caption: 像天狼星这样笨拙的女仆能散发出今天的光彩，全部都是因为我骄傲的主人，是因为您在天狼星身边。
main_1.captionEn: You are the only reason this clumsy maid can shine, my honourable Master. Because you've never left my side...

main_2.caption: 本来天狼星也想帮忙准备餐食……但天狼星在那里好像只会添麻烦，所以……
main_2.captionEn: I wanted to help make dinner, but I wonder if I'd only get in everyone's way, so...

main_3.caption: 这套衣服是为了我骄傲的主人特别准备的。为了让您能有更好的游园体验，天狼星也会全力以赴的！
main_3.captionEn: I made this outfit especially for you to see. Yes, I want to do everything I can to make your stay in this park as fun as possible!

touch_body.caption: 主人的体温……我会全部记在心里的，所以请更多地触碰我吧，我骄傲的主人！
touch_body.captionEn: Your warmth... I swear, I'll engrave it deep into my heart. Touch me more, my honourable Master!

touch_head.caption: 您喜欢我头上的耳朵吗，我骄傲的主人？
touch_head.captionEn: Have you taken a liking to my bunny ears, my honourable Master?

touch_special.caption: 主人在这里也……天狼星已经准备好了！欸？您不是这个意思吗……
touch_special.captionEn: Even now... I'm ready, my honourable Master! Oh? That's not why you were touching me...?

mission.caption: 这点任务算不上什么，对吧？我骄傲的主人
mission.captionEn: A mission of this magnitude is inconsequential. Isn't that correct, my honourable Master?

mission_complete.caption: 主人，任务的报酬已经送达了
mission_complete.captionEn: My honourable Master, the mission rewards have arrived.

wedding.caption: 居然能得到主人的誓约…现在，请允许我闭上双眼，品尝您的温暖，我骄傲的…主人
wedding.captionEn: Oh, the bliss of getting to make this wondrous vow... Please, close your eyes for this unseemly maid and permit her to feel your warmth... My honourable Master...

complete.caption: 委托队返回了？那我允许你暂时离开去迎接。
complete.captionEn: So the commission team is back. I'll allow you to step away for a while, then.

home.caption: 回来了吗？阳光会不会有些刺眼？来我身边坐一会如何？
home.captionEn: You've returned. Can't handle the sun? Then consider sitting next to me for a while.

login.caption: 哦？被这样慵懒的氛围吸引了吗？嗯……其实我也是，感觉变得……稍微不像平时的自己了。
login.captionEn: What's this? Have you been charmed by the lazy lion? That makes two of us. I feel... a little different from my usual self, somehow.

main_1.caption: 防晒工作必须严格执行，指挥官，接下来就由你来帮我补涂防晒油吧。
main_1.captionEn: One needs to protect against sunburns. Commander, could you reapply the suntan lotion right here?

main_2.caption: 在这样舒适慵懒的氛围之下，试着露出更多柔软的一面……是不是更能拉近两个人的关系呢？
main_2.captionEn: When the mood is comfortable and relaxed, the lion shows its soft side. Will it bring us closer together, I wonder?

main_3.caption: 为了感谢你帮我涂防晒……我来喂你一块水果怎么样？当然，你没有拒绝的权力。
main_3.captionEn: This is thanks for applying the suntan lotion on me. Open your mouth and I will feed you this fruit. Naturally, refusal is not an option♪

main_4.caption: 你选的饮料味道很不错嘛……那要不要尝尝看我这杯？怎么，难道用同一根吸管你会害羞？
main_4.captionEn: That's quite the delectable drink you chose. Care to try mine? You're not too embarrassed to use the same straw, are you?

mission.caption: 即使是休假，也不能放任任务堆积……不过，现在还可以再享受一会，我会晚些协助你处理。
mission.captionEn: You cannot let the missions pile up while on vacation... No, actually, stay here. I'll help you after we've had our fun.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成得不错，你还想要其他奖励么？比如——这次又想我喂你吃点什么？
mission_complete.captionEn: Exemplary work with those missions. Do you want an additional reward? For instance... Ah, what do you wish to be fed this time?

touch_body.caption: 嗯？是在确认防晒油有没有涂匀吗？
touch_body.captionEn: What? Are you checking where I applied the suntan lotion?

touch_head.caption: 既然这里只有我们……就满足你吧。
touch_head.captionEn: Since it's only us here... I'll allow you to satisfy yourself.

touch_special.caption: 呵呵……这是想主动出击了吗？
touch_special.captionEn: Heh... Making a bold move, are you?

mail.caption: 有新的邮件，我确认过了，没有任何威胁。
mail.captionEn: There is a new letter. I've confirmed it poses no threat.

wedding.caption: 既然如此，从今以后你就完完全全是我的人了。记住，你现在可是我最重要的所有物……我不会让任何人抢走你的。至于我珍藏的可爱狮子收藏品们……或许也可以考虑邀请你欣赏？
wedding.captionEn: This occasion marks you fully becoming the lion's property. Yes, you are my property, and no one will take you from me. Now, about my collection of adorable lions... I'll let you see them, if you wish to.

home.caption: 外面的怪物很危险，她们都只会欺负你，只有我才是真心对你好，理解吗？
home.captionEn: The monsters out there are dangerous. All they do is hurt you. I'm the only one that really cares about you... You got that?

login.caption: ——你终于注意到我了吗？呵呵，那就回答我一个问题吧……我，漂亮吗？
login.captionEn: Finally noticed my presence? Heheh, then let me ask you something... Am I pretty?

main_1.caption: 剪刀？那种危险的东西，不会出现在我的领地里。而且，想做那种事情的话，用指甲就能做到。
main_1.captionEn: Scissors? Such dangerous things have no place in my territory. Besides, my nails are more than sharp enough.

main_2.caption: 人一旦陷入逼仄的阴影之中，欲望就会变得格外诚实——就连那些见不得光的渴望，也会在沉默里慢慢胀开。
main_2.captionEn: When cornered by shadow, people become true to their desires... A side of yourself you'd normally never let out begins to seep to the surface...

main_3.caption: 指挥官——我漂亮吗？你、你说漂亮？按照设定，我应该惩罚你才对，但……这次算了，我很受用。
main_3.captionEn: Am I pretty, Commander? ...Y-you think so? Hmm. I was meant to attack you here, but... I'll let you go for now, since you've entertained me.

main_4.caption: 喜欢在我的领地里，和我玩捉迷藏吗？……嗯？竟然拿这种狮子玩偶来哄我……胆子不小，但不算笨♪
main_4.captionEn: Do you like playing hide-and-seek in my territory? ...Hmm? To think you'd try to win me over with a plushie... You're brave – and smart, too.

touch_body.caption: 嗯……我知道你脑子里在想什么……
touch_body.captionEn: Hmm... I know exactly what you're thinking right now.

touch_head.caption: ……哦？你看起来完全不害怕呢。
touch_head.captionEn: Hmm? You don't look afraid at all.

touch_special.caption: 怎么，现在后悔已经来不及了哦？你已经在想象了吧，被这嘴唇亲吻的滋味……
touch_special.captionEn: What's the matter? You know it's too late for regrets. Why, I'm sure you're imagining how it would feel to be kissed by these lips...
