mail.caption: 有新的邮件，我确认过了，没有任何威胁。
mail.captionEn: There is a new letter. I've confirmed it poses no threat.

wedding.caption: 既然如此，从今以后你就完完全全是我的人了。记住，你现在可是我最重要的所有物……我不会让任何人抢走你的。至于我珍藏的可爱狮子收藏品们……或许也可以考虑邀请你欣赏？
wedding.captionEn: This occasion marks you fully becoming the lion's property. Yes, you are my property, and no one will take you from me. Now, about my collection of adorable lions... I'll let you see them, if you wish to.

complete.caption: 委托队回来了，亲自去迎接是我们的职责所在，走吧。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned. The duty of receiving them falls upon us. Come.

mission.caption: 还有任务没完成？身为港区的领导者，怎么能让任务堆积如山？不过放心，我会帮你。
mission.captionEn: You've yet to finish your missions? It disappoints me to see this port's leader be so neglectful. Fear not, though – I will assist you.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成的不错，记得你的奖励。还有，要挺起胸膛接受。
mission_complete.captionEn: You're progressing well on these missions. Do remember to claim your rewards, head held high as you do.

home.caption: 指挥官，您回来了……我一直在这里努力训练，没有临阵脱逃哦！
home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander... Um, I managed to carry out my training... without running away!

login.caption: 指挥官，我正在为今天的训练做心理准备……啊呜，真是让人害羞……
login.captionEn: Commander, I'm still trying to work up the courage to show myself to you... Aaah, this is so embarrassing...

main_1.caption: 「秉承皇家之荣光，吾辈当正身清心……」……但阳光暖洋洋的好舒服……不对不对！我不是来享受的呀……！
main_1.captionEn: "With the glory and tradition of the Royal Navy at my back, I stand proud, my heart pure..." The sun is so warm on my skin... Ah?! No, I did not come here to sunbathe, of course...!

main_2.caption: 呜……背后的带子好像松了……好在意……但又不敢去确认……
main_2.captionEn: Aaah... The string on my back is coming loose... It bothers me, but I cannot afford to check...

main_3.caption: 训练结束的时候，您能顺路送我回去吗……？我、我怕赶不上门禁……
main_3.captionEn: Commander, once we finish training, could you walk me back to my quarters? I'm worried about curfew...

touch_body.caption: 请、请您再触碰一次吧……这样对训练，也有帮助……
touch_body.captionEn: T-touch me...one more time... That should make for good training...

touch_head.caption: 唔……总感觉自己像是被夸奖的小动物，好害羞……但……呵呵……
touch_head.captionEn: Mm... When you praise me, I feel as bashful as a little pet... But... Nnn...

touch_special.caption: 这、这也是修行的一环吗？呜……请您……验证我的决心……///
touch_special.captionEn: I-is this part of my training, too? Mm... Very well... Behold my... resolve...

complete.caption: 委托组回来了。和舰载机一样，送出去的伙伴们要好好接回来才行。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned. Just like carrier-borne craft, you have to welcome the girls back after you've sent them away!

mail.caption: 来信了哦。信封……嗯，用剪刀剪开比较好对吧…？
mail.captionEn: A letter's arrived. As for the envelope... Umm, should I just cut it open with scissors?

mission.caption: 有关任务的通知来了。还不需要确认吗…？
mission.captionEn: We have word of a mission. Are you sure we shouldn't take a look at it...?

mission_complete.caption: 任务结束了？呼…那就好。
mission_complete.captionEn: Is the mission complete? Phew... That's great to hear.

wedding.caption: 以皇家的传统和荣光起誓。空母百眼巨人，今后会为了我们的幸福，全心全意地努力——指挥官，能……牵起百眼巨人的手吗？
wedding.captionEn: I swear on the tradition and glory of the Royal Navy that I, aircraft carrier Argus, will always work my hardest for our mutual happiness. Commander... Would you hold my hand, please?

home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。累了的话……要不要光辉利用学到的技巧给您拍拍背呢？
home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. If you're tired... I could rub your back for you?

login.caption: 贵安，指挥官……呵呵，您来得正好呢，稍作准备后就来一起练习吧？
login.captionEn: Greetings, Commander... Heehee, your timing is impeccable. When you're ready, won't you come practice with me?

main_1.caption: 冲好奶粉后，要滴几滴在手背上试试温度。我已经试过了哦，现在应该很适合入口哦？指挥官~
main_1.captionEn: When you're making milk from powder, it's important to drip a few drops on your hand to check the temperature. It doesn't feel hot, so I think it's ready for drinking. Here you go, Commander~

main_2.caption: 指挥官，我们要不要试试……“抱在怀里唱歌”这一节的内容……？光辉在唱歌这件事还是很有自信的呢。
main_2.captionEn: Commander, could I try... holding you in my arms while I sing a lullaby? Heehee, I fancy myself a decent singer♪

main_3.caption: 嗯？您其实是特地来这里找我的吗？这样充满温柔的光辉也很棒……？
main_3.captionEn: Hm? You came here just to find me? Because you think I have a "lovely motherliness" to me...?

mission.caption: 指挥官，也不能太沉迷于陪我练习哦？还有任务没完成吧？
mission.captionEn: Commander, try not to get too focused on your practice. You should still have missions to complete.

touch_head.caption: 呼……呵呵~指挥官，看来您也学会了书上的技巧呢。
touch_head.captionEn: Phew... Heehee, you learned how to do it just like the book says, Commander.

touch_special.caption: 指、指挥官……这也是练习的一部分吗？
touch_special.captionEn: C-Commander... Do you want to practice this, too...?

complete.caption: 光辉将沿路播洒，照亮世间的阴霾~♫嗯？姐妹们回来了呢
complete.captionEn: The light shall disperses the fog of darkness. Oh? The girls are back!

mail.caption: 指挥官，有您的信件，需要帮您看看吗？
mail.captionEn: Here's your mail, Commander! Should I open it for you?

mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，奖励可别忘了呢
mission_complete.captionEn: Don't forget to collect your rewards, Commander!

touch_body.caption: 仿佛……得到了指挥官的肯定一样，让我觉得安心呢
touch_body.captionEn: It's as though... I've received your recognition, Commander. I feel so relieved.

wedding.caption: 虽说光应该均分给每一个人，不过指挥官的话，多拿一些去也没关系哦，因为从指挥官那里也获得了重要的东西呢~
wedding.captionEn: Even though light should be shared equally among us all, it's fine for you to have a bit more. After all, I've received something important from the Commander as well.

home.caption: 哈——！怎么样……归来的指挥官有被光辉吓到吗？特意练了好久呢~指挥官一定有心跳加速的感觉吧？
home.captionEn: Boo! How did you like that? Did I get you? That took quite a lot of practice, and I'm sure I made your heart flutter~

login.caption: 猜·猜·我·是·谁~猜错的话……就要罚您，陪我在这里玩上一整晚了哦~
login.captionEn: Guess who~? Heheh, get it wrong... and I'll have to keep you all night as punishment~

main_1.caption: 这么晚了还不回去睡觉，可不是好孩子的作息哦。是想等我一起？呵呵，指挥官真是一点也不害怕呢~
main_1.captionEn: Good kids don't stay up late, you know? You were waiting for me, you say? Heehee. Why, you don't seem very scared at all~

main_2.caption: 刚才，墙角的阴影里好像……有什么在飘？呵呵，不会是把真的幽灵引来了吧？
main_2.captionEn: You saw something flying over in the corner? Heehee, it might have been a real ghost~♪

main_3.caption: 指挥官？已经睡着了啊……毫无防备的样子呢……这可是夜袭的好机会呢~
main_3.captionEn: Commander? Are you asleep? Heehee, such an adorable face... Why, I want to just gobble you up♪

touch_body.caption: 指挥官，要来玩捉迷藏吗~
touch_body.captionEn: Commander, would you care for a spot of hide-and-seek?

touch_head.caption: 夜袭的时候，要稍稍伪装一下才好呢~
touch_head.captionEn: A little camouflage is what you need for a night raid.

touch_special.caption: 指挥官不会真的被吓到了吧~光辉就在这里，绝对不会离开您呢。
touch_special.captionEn: Did I really take you by surprise? Worry not, I'll stay by your side forever. Nothing will keep us apart.

complete.caption: 光辉将沿路播洒，照亮世间的阴霾~♫嗯？姐妹们回来了呢
complete.captionEn: The light shall disperses the fog of darkness. Oh? The girls are back!

mail.caption: 指挥官，有您的信件，需要帮您看看吗？
mail.captionEn: Here's your mail, Commander! Should I open it for you?

mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，奖励可别忘了呢
mission_complete.captionEn: Don't forget to collect your rewards, Commander!

wedding.caption: 虽说光应该均分给每一个人，不过指挥官的话，多拿一些去也没关系哦，因为从指挥官那里也获得了重要的东西呢~
wedding.captionEn: Even though light should be shared equally among us all, it's fine for you to have a bit more. After all, I've received something important from the Commander as well.

mission.caption: 指挥官，任务没完成可是不好的呐~
mission.captionEn: Commander, it's no good to leave missions unfinished.

complete.caption: 委托组已经回来了呢。嗯～这下可以稍微活动一下了…
complete.captionEn: Our commission team is back. Mmm~ This is a good opportunity to stretch our legs...

home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。剩下的事就交给可畏来“优雅地”处理吧？呵呵呵♪
home.captionEn: Welcome home. I will elegantly take care of the rest for you, okay? Heehee♪

login.caption: 欢迎光临，指挥官。来，和可畏一起庆祝这个盛大的节日吧？呵呵呵♪
login.captionEn: Welcome, Commander. Come and celebrate the big day with me. Heehee♪

mail.caption: 给指挥官的邮件在这里，哦♪
mail.captionEn: Your mail? Right here, of course!

main_1.caption: “像个皇家淑女一样，优雅而华丽”——哼哼♪指挥官，刚才在看可畏看到入迷了对吧？
main_1.captionEn: "Elegant and gorgeous, like a Royal lady." Hehe♪ Commander, you were just taken by the sight of me, weren't you?

main_2.caption: 要不要一起去会场？穿着这身打扮只有一个人走那么远的路，可畏也绝对会累死的呢…
main_2.captionEn: Shall we go to the venue together? I'm sure to get tired if I'm left to walk alone in this dress...

main_3.caption: (从刚才开始一直在看我呢…到底是哪里那么吸引人呢？腿？胸？欸，还是……？）
main_3.captionEn: (The Commander's been staring for a while... What part of me is so attention-grabbing? My legs? My chest? Hmm...)

mission.caption: 如果要在任务和可畏之间选择的话…那、那当然是选可畏啊！？
mission.captionEn: If you had to choose between me and your missions... y-you WOULD choose me, right?!

mission_complete.caption: 指挥官哥哥，任务奖励已经送到喵♪
mission_complete.captionEn: Big Brother, your mission rewards are riiight here, nya♪

touch_body.caption: 为了不弄脏礼服…请小心一点哦！///
touch_body.captionEn: Be careful not to stain the dress, please!

touch_head.caption: 指、指挥官也…很努力呢？///
touch_head.captionEn: C-Commander... I see you're doing your best, too.

touch_special.caption: 指、指挥官和可畏已经是这种关系呢…///
touch_special.captionEn: Th-this is how our relationship is now, after all...

wedding.caption: 从今往后，可畏会将毕生之爱奉献给我的指挥官，喜怒哀乐，酸甜苦辣……因为很长，所以以下省略！指挥官，到你了，虽然有点长，不过指挥官可不许像我一样省略哦~
wedding.captionEn: I, Formidable, hereby dedicate my life to the love of my Commander, through good times and bad, rich times and poor... This is quite long, so I'll omit the rest~ Now then, Commander, it's your turn. I know it's a long vow but you are not to skip a single word ♪

home.caption: 指挥官看起来有些疲惫呢？不如就这样靠过来吧~这个位置……比任何枕头都柔软哦~
home.captionEn: You look awfully tired... Why don't you come lean on me? I bet you I'm softer than any pillow.

login.caption: 这杯佳酿……就是我对您的祝福哦~指挥官愿意与我交杯共饮吗~？
login.captionEn: Such a fine drink... is my blessing for you. May I propose a toast to our union?

main_1.caption: 唔……不小心，撒出来了……弄得一片狼藉呢。能请您，帮我清理一下吗~？
main_1.captionEn: Oh, my... I spilled it. I'm such a mess now♥ Commander, can you clean me up?

main_2.caption: 这个发簪，据说是东煌最近颇受青睐的款式……像这样与往常不同的我，能否让您……产生新的情欲呢？呵呵~
main_2.captionEn: This hairpin is all the rage in the Dragon Empery. Does this different side of me awaken anything in you? Heehee.

main_3.caption: 指挥官的眼神有些迷离了呢，这就喝醉了吗~正好，我提前准备了适合醒酒的茶水……咦？还没喝下去，您就清醒了……？
main_3.captionEn: Your eyes look a little hazy. Are you drunk already? I made tea to help us sober up... Hmm? Wait, you sobered up already?

touch_body.caption: 唔，您的手，有沾到酒香吗？
touch_body.captionEn: Mm... Do I smell like wine now?

touch_head.caption: 呣——从我这里品尝到的美酒，是不是更美味呢？呵呵~
touch_head.captionEn: Mm... Phew. Wine tastes better when you drink from here, doesn't it? Heehee.

touch_special.caption: 唔~有些胀胀的……哎呀，您要帮我纾解吗？那您可要，好好引导我的欲望哦~♡
touch_special.captionEn: Mmnh... I'm starting to go numb... Oh, you'll relieve it for me? Well, I hope you'll take good care of me♥

complete.caption: 负责委托的同伴们都平安返航了。您第一时间的问候，是对她们最好的嘉奖哦。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has come back. You arriving on scene quickly to thank them is the best reward they could ask for.

mail.caption: 有给您的信件。不要忘了别人对你的期待，以及对这份期待的回应哦。
mail.captionEn: There's a letter for you. Remember, people have high hopes for you, and you're not one to disappoint.

main_5.caption: 头脑不大清醒？那么这样如何——撒上小山一般多的超辣调料的皇家料理——要不要来试试？（舔舔
main_5.captionEn: Brain fog, you say? I may have just the cure – Royal Navy cuisine, enhanced with tongue-sizzling spice. Care for a taste?

main_4.caption: 看来是发起呆了呢。迷茫的指挥官就由我来引导你做一些杀时间的事吧。来吧，看这里~
main_4.captionEn: Trouble concentrating, Commander? Let's get you back on track with a rousing distraction. Go on, take a look~♥

mission.caption: 对繁琐而重复的任务感到疲倦了？呵呵。看到指挥官这么勤奋的工作至今，我还以为是乐在其中呢。
mission.captionEn: Are you tired of performing your neverending duty? Heehee. Here I thought you enjoyed it, considering how unswerving your commitment is.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了么？希望这次的报酬能给这平淡的日常带来一点难得的惊喜。
mission_complete.captionEn: A mission's been completed, has it? Heehee. May this bounty bring you joy one doesn't find every day.

wedding.caption: 还有所拘谨吗？呵呵~没关系，人的理性之箍毕竟不是那么简单就能拿下来的。既然如此……闭上眼睛，放松身体，好好听我的话，什么也不用想。我会给予您永恒而甜蜜的印记——
wedding.captionEn: You still deny yourself? Heehee, I understand. The shackles of inhibition are hard to break. Just close your eyes, relax, and empty your mind as I've taught you. I'm going to give you a mark of pleasure that will never go away♥

home.caption: 辛苦了指挥官～要不要和我一起上车休息会儿？座椅真的很舒服哦，我刚刚亲自验证过了。
home.captionEn: Nice work, Commander. Would you like to rest with me in the car? I can...vouch for how comfortable the seats are.

login.caption: 哈欠——阳光正好，微风不燥，正是适合在副驾休息……咳，适合领航的好天气。指挥官，我们赶紧出发吧？
login.captionEn: *Yawn*. The sunlight and wind feel so nice. It's perfect weather for relaxing in the passenger seat... Ahem, for navigating, I mean. Let's get going, Commander.

main_1.caption: 路书？当然准备好了，我已经全部记在脑子里了哦。只是现在需要先闭目养神一下，才能更清晰地回忆起来……
main_1.captionEn: The course data? Firmly in my head, of course. Oh, but I need to close my eyes and relax to remember it clearly...

main_2.caption: 光是站着，我的体力就要耗尽了，更不用说还拿着这么重的饮料……喏~给你留了不少，还冰着呢。
main_2.captionEn: Just standing saps all my energy, and I have to hold this on top of that...? Here, your ice-cold drink. I only drank a little of it.

main_3.caption: 之后的比赛，请务必开稳一些。震动太剧烈的话，我会休息不好……不对，是忍受不了呢……
main_3.captionEn: Could you drive the rest of the course a bit more carefully? All this jumping about is making it hard to rela – I mean, to hold back...

touch_body.caption: 指挥官……就这样把我抱到车上吧？毕竟我连打开车门的力气都没有了……
touch_body.captionEn: Commander... would you carry me to the car? I don't even have the strength left to open the door...

touch_head.caption: 指挥官真好，愿意帮我整理头发……
touch_head.captionEn: How kind of you to tidy up my hair...

touch_special.caption: 还、还要继续的话，我很难保证等下不会走神哦……
touch_special.captionEn: C-carry on and...I might not be able to keep my focus later...

complete.caption: 委托组回来了哦，嗯，快去看看吧，我会在这里等着你回来的。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned. I shall await your return, so you should go greet them soon.

mail.caption: 新的邮件？难道是放假通知…嗯？不可能吗？
mail.captionEn: New mail? Are we being told to go on vacation? Huh, what do you mean that's not possible?

mission_complete.caption: 任务顺利完成了！干得不错，指挥官。
mission_complete.captionEn: That's another mission taken care of! Hehe, you're pretty good at this, Commander.

mission.caption: 新的任务啊…指挥官经验这么丰富，解决它们应该是小意思吧~
mission.captionEn: New missions, huh... Should be no problem at all for someone as experienced as you, right?

wedding.caption: 誓约的仪式啊…感觉好麻烦的样子…唔，我可不是对指挥官有什么不满哦？就算没有仪式什么的，我对你也……看你都让我说了些什么羞耻的话啊！回去了回去了…
wedding.captionEn: An oath ceremony? That sounds like something that could turn into a real pain in the ass... I'm not saying there's anything wrong with you, Commander. I mean, a ceremony is just for show, so it shouldn't matter if... Wh-why are you making me say something so embarrassing anyway?! Anyway, we're done here, so I'll be heading back!

complete.caption: 不管委托结果如何，现在是慰劳大家的时候...吗。嗯，我明白。
complete.captionEn: We must congratulate the team's efforts, regardless of how the commission went... Yes, I understand.

home.caption: 回来了吗。想必是尽情享受大海了吧？...我？也不是一直在这里干等着...应该不算...
home.captionEn: You've returned. Have you enjoyed the beach to its fullest? ...Me? I've done more than just sit here and wait for you. I think so, at least...

login.caption: 服装终究只是装饰，但注重体面是皇家的作风......呐。你最好给我一个非得穿成这样的理由。
login.captionEn: While clothes are just a flourish, we are told to dress appropriately back home... I'd love to hear a reason for why I must wear this.

main_1.caption: 享受大海的方式人人不同...你平时都在做什么？我实在想象不出你会和谁这样静静待着...
main_1.captionEn: I know everyone enjoys the beach in their own way, but how do you typically do it? I can't imagine you always sit and stare at people like this...

main_2.caption: 就算是游戏，君主一旦参与竞争就会较劲起来？...虽然不想承认，指挥官，但你说得对
main_2.captionEn: You say I take competitions all too seriously, even informal games between friends? I hate to admit it, but... you're right.

main_3.caption: 日晒越来越强了...呼。指挥官，你没事吧？要我去拿些降温的东西来吗？
main_3.captionEn: The sunshine is getting stronger. Whew... Are you alright, Commander? Should I bring you a cold beverage?

mission.caption: 现在不是追求“最优”的时候。先完成任务，享受大海吧。
mission.captionEn: This is no time to fuss over being the most excellent. Complete your missions so we may enjoy the beach.

mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励到了。狮她们应该也会很高兴吧。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission rewards have arrived. Now we can all better enjoy the beach, can we not?

touch_body.caption: 防晒霜...？啊，嗯。帮大忙了...
touch_body.captionEn: Suntan lotion? Oh, right. Appreciated...

touch_special.caption: 你是在享受大海，还是在看我......不，没什么///
touch_special.captionEn: Is it the beach you're enjoying, or is it me you're... No, forget it.

mail.caption: 是关于战争的邮件，指挥官，请检阅
mail.captionEn: You've received mail regarding the war. You would do best to check it.

wedding.caption: 我很幸福喔，即使这个世界不再需要我，你也会需要我，这对我已经足够了……指挥官，或许我是为了与你相爱，才来到这里的吧
wedding.captionEn: Even if the world no longer needs me, you will always need me. That is more than enough for me... Hahah, perhaps I was materialised with the sole purpose of meeting you. Even if so... I am happy.

complete.caption: 委托组回来了？说不定带回了柴郡给亲爱的准备的礼物呢~
complete.captionEn: The commission team is back? I hope they brought the souvenirs I ordered for you!

home.caption: 亲爱的，欢迎回来！想要柴郡给亲爱的跳支兔子舞吗？还是想让柴郡给你表演魔术呢~
home.captionEn: Way to go, Owner! Do you wanna see me do a little hopping dance? Or maybe a magic trick instead?

login.caption: 亲~爱~的~！嘿嘿，快让我抱抱~软乎乎软乎乎~现在的柴郡抱起来怎么样呀？是不是比平时还要舒服？
login.captionEn: Owneeer! Squeee! Cuddle! Fluff! Sniff! Hey, how does it feel to hug me? I bet it feels even better than usual!

mail.caption: 柴郡用魔术把邮件藏进纸牌里了~嘿嘿~开玩笑啦。
mail.captionEn: I used a magic trick to hide your letter inside this card! Ahaha, I'm just joking with you!

main_1.caption: 亲爱的，参加了这么久的宴会很累了吧？要躺到柴郡身边吗？还是要躺在柴郡腿上呢？
main_1.captionEn: Are you tired after the party, Owner? You should lie down next to me! And rest your head on my thighs!

main_2.caption: 亲爱的，看好啦！柴郡要给你表演一个厉害的大魔术！锵锵~变出了一个更爱你的柴郡哦~
main_2.captionEn: Watch closely, Owner! I'm going to perform a stunning magic trick! Tadah! I made a Cheshire appear, and she really loves her Owner!

main_3.caption: 亲爱的，其实现在魔术师柴郡有一个可以让你看到柴郡对你的爱有多少的魔术哦~嘿咻……嗯~亲爱的看到了吗？是最高值哦！
main_3.captionEn: Here comes a trick that reveals how much I love you! Abracadabra... Did you see that? It said I love you as much as physically possible!

main_4.caption: 亲爱的~要不要试试把手伸进柴郡的帽子里试试？什么？软软的？一定是藏在里面的“兔子”吧~嘿嘿~
main_4.captionEn: Owner, stick your hand in my hat! Hm? You feel something soft inside? I'm sure that's just the rabbit in my hat♡

mission.caption: 亲爱的~还有任务没完成哦，有什么需要大魔术师柴郡帮忙的吗？
mission.captionEn: Owner, you still have missions to do! Are there any that Cheshire the Magician can help with?

mission_complete.caption: 领取完任务奖励之后，亲爱的要和柴郡一起去看烟花吗~
mission_complete.captionEn: After you've claimed those mission rewards, do you wanna go watch the fireworks with me?

touch_body.caption: 呀~亲爱的好坏，嗯？怎么突然害羞啦，一定是迷上柴郡了对不对~
touch_body.captionEn: Owneeer! Hm? Why are you blushing all of a sudden? Has that spark inside you rekindled, hmm?

touch_head.caption: 亲爱的，一直摸头会把帽子弄掉啦，不如试试摸其它地方？
touch_head.captionEn: Owner, my hat's gonna fall off if you keep headpatting me! There are other places you can touch me, you know!

touch_special.caption: 亲·爱·的~柴郡可是看出你的小小坏心思了，不过可以哦~
touch_special.captionEn: Oh, Owner. I know exactly what's going through your head! And I'm perfectly fine with it♡

wedding.caption: 既然亲爱的都这么表现出对柴郡的重视了，嘻嘻~那作为回报，接下来，我要说一百遍“我喜欢你”！我要开始啦，你可要听清楚了！在听完之前，哪里也不许去哦！亲爱的~
wedding.captionEn: Now that you've made it clear how precious I am to you, I need to respond by saying, "I love you, Owner!" a hundred times or more! Starting right now! Stay right where you are until I'm finished! Here we go! I love you, Owner!!!

complete.caption: 只要我们走得够远，总会到达能收获满满物资的地方哦~
complete.captionEn: If we go far enough, I know we'll find a place bursting with supplies!

home.caption: 还是被我的童话书迷宫吸引了嘛，亲爱的~嘿嘿，随我一起来吧，我还有好多有趣的“魔法”想和亲爱的分享呢！
home.captionEn: Are you addicted to my fairytale maze, Owner? Hehe, come with me. I've got all kinds of fun, magical things to show you!

login.caption: 翻页~再翻一页吧亲爱的~啊！就是这页！嘿嘿，柴郡猫的童话书迷宫闪亮登场啦，亲爱的喜欢吗！
login.captionEn: Turn the page, Owner! One more time~ Oh, there it is! Hehehe, the Cheshire Cat's fairytale maze takes the stage! Do you like it, Owner?

main_1.caption: 亲爱的~猜猜我从里面捞出了什么？是可以让人变大变小的魔药，还是……嘻嘻别担心，柴郡不会乱用的~♪
main_1.captionEn: Owner~ Guess what I just fished out of my mirror! Maybe it's a magic potion that turns you big or small? ...Hehe, don't worry. I won't use it for anything weird♪

main_2.caption: 呜哇！吓到了吗？但我的尾巴已经缠住你了哦~要是像这样晃晃尾巴尖的话……你有没有很痒呢~
main_2.captionEn: Whoa! Did I scare you? While you were surprised, I wrapped my tail around you! Now, if I wiggle the tip of it... does it tickle?

main_3.caption: 亲爱的，来和我玩捉迷藏吧~柴郡会一直待在能看到你的地方哦~你走到哪里，我就会藏到哪里~
main_3.captionEn: Owner, play hide and seek with me! I'll always be somewhere I can see you~ Wherever you go, I'll follow.

touch_body.caption: 嗯哼？亲爱的是在确认我有没有偷偷消失吗？蹭蹭~柴郡就在你身边哦！
touch_body.captionEn: Meow? Are you checking if I'm still here? *nuzzle*... I'm always right by your side, Owner~

touch_head.caption: 呼~用这种手段诱惑我可是行……行得通的~再多摸一会吧~
touch_head.captionEn: Meooow~ You think you'll get away with using these tactics to seduce me? Well... Y-you will! Pet me more~

touch_special.caption: 喵~好想用尾巴紧紧紧紧缠住亲爱的……♡
touch_special.captionEn: Mmmeow~ I want to wrap my tail all around you, Owner...

wedding.caption: 既然亲爱的都这么表现出对柴郡的重视了，嘻嘻~那作为回报，接下来，我要说一百遍“我喜欢你”！我要开始啦，你可要听清楚了！在听完之前，哪里也不许去哦！亲爱的~
wedding.captionEn: Now that you've made it clear how precious I am to you, I need to respond by saying, "I love you, Owner!" a hundred times or more! Starting right now! Stay right where you are until I'm finished! Here we go! I love you, Owner!!!

mail.caption: 有你的信件哦！是啥内容呢？让我也看看嘛~
mail.captionEn: The mail's here! I wanna see what's inside! Pretty pleaseeee?

mission.caption: 没有什么任务是能难倒亲爱的和我两个人的！
mission.captionEn: There's no mission we can't accomplish with our combined pawers, Owner!

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成啦！这些任务对我们来说会不会简单了点？
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! Don't you think these tasks are a little too easy for us?

home.caption: 作战辛苦了，请躺下，让普利茅斯为您做个全身的特别健康检查吧。
home.captionEn: Well done on your mission. I'll perform a special full-body physical for you now, so please lie down.

login.caption: 指挥官大人，今天的检查要开始了哦。不知道普利茅斯特意换上的这身装扮，有没有让您感到更安心呢？
login.captionEn: Commander, it's almost time for your physical. I hope this outfit I picked out will help you relax.

main_1.caption: 这张床睡着不舒服吗？稍等——我已经把这个型号的床都销毁了。请暂时把我当作最舒适的床，安心入睡吧，我会好好抱紧您的。
main_1.captionEn: Is the bed uncomfortable to lie on? Wait just a moment... Okay, I've disposed of all beds of that model. Instead, you may use me as your bed. I'll hold you tight so you can sleep well.

main_2.caption: 尚未开始的体检让您有些紧张吗？普利茅斯可以为您提供特别抚慰，来让您放松下来哦。
main_2.captionEn: Are you nervous about your physical? I can offer you some special, relaxing care to help you. Please enjoy...

main_3.caption: 啊，您的心跳好快，请躺下，让我好好检测一会。
main_3.captionEn: Ah! Commander, your heart is racing. Lie down and let me examine you, okay?

touch_body.caption: 一听到指挥官大人的呼唤，我就立刻赶过来了呢。我这就为您测量体温。
touch_body.captionEn: I came running as soon as I heard your voice. I'll take your temperature now.

touch_head.caption: 感受我肌肤的温度，有没有让您感到治愈？如果揉脸不够的话，其它地方也可以哦。
touch_head.captionEn: Is my warmth soothing? If my face isn't enough, I can let you try other places, too.

touch_special.caption: 请您随意，只要您满足就好，这对您的身心健康很有益处哦。
touch_special.captionEn: Please do whatever you'd like, until you're satisfied. It's good for the body and the mind.

complete.caption: 军事委托完成了。指挥官大人，恭喜您。
complete.captionEn: A commission has been completed. Let us rejoice now, dear Commander.

mail.caption: 指挥官大人，是新的邮件，希望您能高兴。
mail.captionEn: Rejoice, dear Commander, for new mail has arrived.

mission.caption: 新任务来了。指挥官大人，请交给我……您要自己做吗？
mission.captionEn: A new mission has arrived, Commander. Allow me to– Hmm? You're going to do it yourself?

mission_complete.caption: 是任务的报酬，这就打开——用炮击的话会毁掉是吧。明白了。
mission_complete.captionEn: The mission rewards are here. Let's open it—it'll be destroyed if I fire a shell at it? Understood.

wedding.caption: 指挥官大人，请高兴起来吧。从今天起我就是指挥官的专属舰了。专属意味着特别……也就是说我成为了指挥官大人特别的舰船。今天我可以不顾指挥官大人，自己先感到高兴吗？呵呵呵~
wedding.captionEn: Rejoice, dear Commander! Starting today, I shall become your exclusive-use shipgirl! By exclusive, I mean special... Basically, I've become someone special to you, so can I stop looking after you today and just rejoice for myself? Heehee~

complete.caption: 指挥官，备用的烟花也都送过来了。
complete.captionEn: Commander, the commission team brought back spare fireworks.

home.caption: 指挥官，跳舞可不比修行轻松哦，刚刚你也跳累了吧？在南瓜马车上好好休息一下吧~
home.captionEn: Dancing is no easier than combat training. You must be tired, too, Commander. Please, come rest in my pumpkin carriage with me.

login.caption: 指挥官，已经开始放烟花了呢。不论是工作还是修行，都等看完烟花之后再一起处理吧，如何？
login.captionEn: Commander, it's time for the fireworks to start. Let's leave our work and daily training until after they're done, okay?

mail.caption: 指挥官，你的信。如果是其它舞会的邀请函的话~我可以继续做你的舞伴吗？
mail.captionEn: There's a letter for you, Commander. If it's an invitation to a dance party, then may I join you as your partner?

main_1.caption: ……马车坐着不舒服么？果然初次设计服饰以外的东西，我还是有很多考虑不周全的地方啊……
main_1.captionEn: Is the carriage uncomfortable? This is my first time designing anything other than clothes, so there were a lot of unknowns...

main_2.caption: 用南瓜马车把你偷偷带走，让你只陪着我一个人看烟花，是不是有些太自私了呢……？
main_2.captionEn: What if I just spirited you away in my carriage to watch the fireworks together? A little too selfish, perhaps?

main_3.caption: 仙女对我施下的魔法，指挥官要不要猜猜看是什么呢？……是“无论你在哪里，我都能够找到你”的魔法哦~呵呵~开玩笑的~
main_3.captionEn: Want to guess what spell the fairy cast on me? Okay, I'll tell you. It lets me find you no matter where you are... Heehee, just kidding.

main_4.caption: 我的脸很红么……？可能是因为这杯饮料吧？确实有些头晕呢……指挥官让我靠一下你的肩膀吧~
main_4.captionEn: Am I blushing? I-it's probably because of this... I do feel a little tipsy. Mind if I lean on your shoulder...?

mission.caption: 这种时候还有工作吗？明明是休息时间了哦……没办法，我来帮你吧，赶紧完成后，再尽情享受吧。
mission.captionEn: You're still working? But it's time for your break... Fine, I'll just have to help you. Once we're done, we're going to have fun together, got it?

mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，可以尽情欣赏烟花了~
mission_complete.captionEn: Now that we're done with all that work, it's time to focus on enjoying the fireworks show♪

touch_body.caption: 指挥官，是想在夜空下跳舞吗~？握住我的手吧~
touch_body.captionEn: Would you like to dance under the night sky? Just take my hand, Commander♪

touch_head.caption: 这个小王冠也是配套设计的哦~
touch_head.captionEn: I made this crown to match my outfit, too~

touch_special.caption: 嗯……马车可是透明的哦，会被看见的///……
touch_special.captionEn: Umm... P-people will see us here...

wedding.caption: 指挥官，你听说过白泷公主的传说吗？擅长编织的公主与她的爱人，以名为“降临石”的石头作为许下誓言的信物……你为我戴上的……我想也是另一种意义上的降临石呢，就让它见证我们之间爱的誓言吧~
wedding.captionEn: Commander, do you know the legend of Princess Shirataki? The promise made between the weaving princess and her lover, the korinseki stone that witnessed it... What you just put on is our own korinseki. May this ring oversee our love to the end.

home.caption: 指挥官看起来有些疲惫呢？没关系，剩下的“麻烦”就交给我吧~
home.captionEn: You look a little tired... It's okay. Leave the rest of that trouble to me.

login.caption: 呵呵，我正在担心指挥官是不是遭遇了什么危险……你就准时出现了，我可差点就要去救你了呢~
login.captionEn: Heehee, I was worried that you'd gotten wrapped up in some trouble, but you made it on time after all. Any longer, and I would've come rushing to your aid!

main_1.caption: 指挥官要乖乖地待在我身边，让我好好保护你哦~要是有别的想法的话……滋滋滋~
main_1.captionEn: Let me stay with you and protect you, Commander. If you have anything else in mind, well... Zap!

main_2.caption: 不必担心，我会控制好攻击时的电量，只会让敌人睡着而已~至于到底会睡多久……可能因人而异吧？
main_2.captionEn: I'll control my electricity during battle so I just put our enemies to sleep. How long they sleep, well... That depends on them!

main_3.caption: 要时常保养电击枪，让它保持最佳状态呢~毕竟，它和我的尾巴一样，都能“说服”指挥官永远陪在我身边呢~
main_3.captionEn: My stun gun needs regular maintenance to stay in tip-top shape. Just like my tail, it's perfect for "convincing" you to stay with me forever~

mission.caption: 任务来了哦，让我们一起解决这些麻烦吧~
mission.captionEn: You have missions to do. Let's take care of that trouble together!

mission_complete.caption: 任务解决，看来我们很适合一起处理各种麻烦呢~
mission_complete.captionEn: Missions complete. We might be the perfect combination!

touch_body.caption: 是在担心我吗？放心，我很快就能把敌人解决掉的~
touch_body.captionEn: Are you worried about me? Don't be. I'll take care of the enemy in no time.

touch_head.caption: 被指挥官偷袭成功了呢~嘿嘿♪
touch_head.captionEn: You caught me by surprise, Commander... Heehee.

touch_special.caption: 原来指挥官喜欢这种即兴发挥吗？呵呵，那我可得好好配合才行~
touch_special.captionEn: Do you like improvising like this, Commander? Heehee, guess I'd better play along.

complete.caption: 委托队带着资源回来了哦。哎呀，看你的笑容……似乎很满意呢~
complete.captionEn: The commission team brought resources home. Hehe... That smile tells me you're quite satisfied with them.

mail.caption: 邮件来了哦。需要我帮你把所有无趣和麻烦的内容，都“处理”掉吗~
mail.captionEn: You have mail. Want me to dispose of the boring and troublesome ones for you?

wedding.caption: 终于等到这一刻了~指挥官，我的心早就是你的了，而你的心……我也要全部收下啦~当然，是用我的方式哦……
wedding.captionEn: So the time has finally come. My heart is already yours, but in return... I'll be taking your heart, too. Through my own methods, of course!

home.caption: 指挥官，这么快就回来了吗？！我这是在……是在尝试一种全新的镜头表现……你就当是提前演示吧！
home.captionEn: Back already, Commander?! I-I was... in the middle of trying a new technique... Consider it a little sneak peek!

login.caption: ……嗯，指挥官，我已经准备好了。我会用绝佳的pose，让你见识到真正的内在修养！
login.captionEn: Hmm. Commander, I am prepared. I'll strike the perfect pose to show you true mental fortitude!

main_1.caption: 没错，修养越高，面对危机时的姿态就越自然……仔细看！我现在的表现，已经谈得上是完全领悟了吧……！
main_1.captionEn: I see. The more one self-cultivates, the more naturally one can face dangerous situations... Watch carefully. My performance displays true mastery, does it not?

main_2.caption: 这布料的触感，和我习惯穿的那些款式不太一样……怎么说呢，虽然格外轻薄，但似乎也让人变得更敏感了……？
main_2.captionEn: This fabric has such a different texture from the ones I usually wear. It's light, but when I wear it... I feel oddly sensitive.

main_3.caption: 这样会不会冷？指挥官不用担心，就连冬天的瀑布修行都难不住我，这点温差不算什么。
main_3.captionEn: Am I cold? Don't worry about me. I can meditate under waterfalls in the winter, so this chill is nothing to me.

touch_body.caption: ……这真的很畅销吗？……可明明什么都遮不住……
touch_body.captionEn: Is this outfit really a best-seller? It doesn't leave much to the imagination...

touch_head.caption: 我还是太紧绷了吗？抱歉，或许多换几件衣服就能习惯了吧……
touch_head.captionEn: Am I still too tense? Apologies... I'm sure I'll be more confident once I have tried a few more outfits on.

touch_special.caption: 突、突然这样敞开心扉是做什么……！
touch_special.captionEn: Y-you're suddenly so forward!

mail.caption: 有新邮件，要帮你拿过来吗？
mail.captionEn: Commander, there's new mail. Shall I bring it for you?

complete.caption: 执行委托的舰队回来了，要去迎接吗？
complete.captionEn: Your fleet has returned from commission. Want to welcome them back?

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，要前往回收奖励吗？
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission accomplished! Are we going to collect the rewards?

mission.caption: 新的任务下达了，要确认一下吗？
mission.captionEn: New tasks have been assigned - would you like to confirm them?

wedding.caption: 能得到指挥官的认可是高雄无上的荣幸……这柄剑，从今往后，也将只为你而挥动！从今往后，也请多指教了！
wedding.captionEn: For you to acknowledge me like this, Commander, is the greatest honor. From now on, this blade shall serve only you. Please continue to treat me kindly.

home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官大人——这是为了这次要展示的技艺所做的练习，虽说确实也想表达对指挥官的感谢啦……不过……///
home.captionEn: It's good to see you've returned, Commander. I was just practicing my next jutsu. I did want to honor you for your services, but, well...

login.caption: 这便是仙忍能够千变万化的奥义所在——呀！指挥官大人，难不成云仙……失败了吗……？
login.captionEn: This is the ninja sage's ultimate transformation technique... Hyah! Commander, have I failed again...?

main_1.caption: 没必要这么认真吗？嗯……但做到哪一步才算“认真”，云仙有些不太明白呢……？
main_1.captionEn: You think I don't have to take this role so seriously? Honestly, I'm not sure what part of this you think is "serious"...

main_2.caption: 只要主君召唤，忍者便会立即赶到……原来如此，原来这就是伙伴们藏在指挥官大人办公室的天花板上的原因啊~呵呵……
main_2.captionEn: It is a ninja's duty to come when her lord calls... I see. That must be why everyone is hiding in the ceiling of your office. Haha!

main_3.caption: 看指挥官大人并未动摇，难不成这个忍术的正确用法，就是要像这样被绑住才行……？
main_3.captionEn: The fact that you seem unmoved makes me wonder... Is this ninjutsu meant to be performed while tied up, after all?

touch_body.caption: 绳子绑得太紧了……这有点失误了呢……
touch_body.captionEn: The rope is far too tight. I may have made... a mistake.

touch_head.caption: 看来云仙还需继续修行才行……
touch_head.captionEn: I still have much training ahead of me...

touch_special.caption: 原来如此，您是想看到“身陷囹圄的云仙”吗……？
touch_special.captionEn: So you want to see me restrained, do you?

complete.caption: 委托组回来了呢。殷切期待她们的旅途见闻呢。呵呵。
complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. I can't wait to hear their stories, heehee.

mail.caption: 有来信呢，指挥官大人。至少过目下再收到盒子里会比较好哦。
mail.captionEn: You have mail, Commander. Don't you think you should at least skim through it before you leave it in the box?

main_4.caption: 被小狐妹妹的问题围攻了吗……若不知应对的法子确实很棘手呢。指挥官大人，不回答也是一种应对之策哦。
main_4.captionEn: The Guardian Fox's little sister asks you questions incessantly? I suppose that would be difficult if you don't know the secret to victory. Commander, sometimes NOT answering is an option.

mission.caption: 任务似乎有所滞留呢。呵呵，无妨。若等到最后关头才动手，那也是人之常情。
mission.captionEn: You have a backlog of missions. Heehee, I understand. It's only human to procrastinate until right before your deadline.

main_5.caption: 有时候，从工作和人际关系中抽离出来也不失为一种选择。并不是让您脱离世俗的意思，您不妨稍微学学仙家的心态如何？
main_5.captionEn: Sometimes, fleeing from work and human relationships is a viable option. I won't tell you to forsake society, but maybe you could learn a little about the hermit mentality?

mission_complete.caption: 似乎有未领取的任务报酬呢。呵呵，无妨。就放那里也罢。
mission_complete.captionEn: You have some unchecked mission rewards. Heehee, don't worry. It's nice to watch them build up, isn't it?

wedding.caption: 您提出的誓约，令我感到光荣至极。小女子不才，还望多多关照。——呵呵，看来我需要进行特别修行了呢，对吧？指挥官大人？
wedding.captionEn: I'm deeply honored by your proposal. While I don't feel deserving, I graciously accept... Heehee, it seems I'll have to train to be a bride, won't I, Commander?

home.caption: 这次的战果很丰厚呢。要不要以此为赌注，玩些游戏呢~指挥官要是输了的话……会被我悄悄缠住哦~
home.captionEn: A most splendid result. Shall we take this chance for a bit of merriment? With a condition that, should you lose... I shall take possession of you.

login.caption: 指挥官，你来了……你看起来有些口渴呢，要来点茶水吗？呵呵，我也陪你喝一杯吧~
login.captionEn: Welcome, Commander. May I interest you in some tea if you're feeling thirsty? Heehee – I shall keep you company tonight.

main_1.caption: 嗯？你看见了某种不祥之物？呵呵，是眼花了吧~毕竟，这屋内……只有你我二人哟？
main_1.captionEn: Hm? You saw an ill-boding thing, you say? Heehee. It was surely just your imagination. There is no one here but you and me.

main_2.caption: ……角落的手鞠球动了一下吗？呵呵，是错觉啊~指挥官看着有些紧张呢，要不要……来我怀里小憩一会儿？
main_2.captionEn: You're certain that the temari moved? Heehee. Your eyes are merely playing tricks on you. If it bothers you so, then may I suggest closing your eyes in my embrace for a while?

main_3.caption: 都说影子是人心的投射呢。我对指挥官的渴求，又会幻化作什么呢……
main_3.captionEn: It is said that shadows are reflections of the heart. One must wonder what form my attachment to you, my Commander, may take...

mission.caption: 新任务来了哦。指挥官，走夜路的时候，可不要被蛛丝绊住了哦……
mission.captionEn: We have been assigned new missions. Please, Commander, do be careful of spider's silk while walking the streets at night.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了吗？那就继续我们未完的游戏吧……
mission_complete.captionEn: You've finished a mission? Then let us resume our play.

touch_body.caption: 哦呀……想看看你给我留下的痕迹吗？还是说，今夜……会有更多？
touch_body.captionEn: Ah, do you wish to see the mark that you left upon me? Or perhaps... do you intend to give me a new one tonight?

touch_head.caption: 怎么样？确实是你眼花了吧？呵呵……我头上没有角，对吧？
touch_head.captionEn: Well? Do you feel that you were mistaken now? Heehee. There are no horns on my head after all, are there?

touch_special.caption: 呵呵……指挥官，你已经没法逃走了哦……啊呜？呵呵……
touch_special.captionEn: Heehee... There is no escaping now, Commander... Mgh... Mmh...

complete.caption: 要去迎接委托舰队吗？我也陪你一起吧。
complete.captionEn: Are you leaving to receive those returning from a commission? Then kindly allow me to accompany you.

mail.caption: 不要错过任何有用的信息——尤其是邮件。
mail.captionEn: One must not let useful information slip past. Your letter demands your attention.

wedding.caption: 你已经做出了决定吗……既然如此，从现在起，我不会放开你的手。从你掌心所传来的温度，让我想要站在你的身旁，与你一起看着四季的晨昏流转。
wedding.captionEn: I see that you've made up your mind. That being the case, I vow to take your hand, now and into eternity. The warmth that your hand imparts... it urges me to stay by your side and, together, behold the passing of the seasons.

home.caption: 嗨~又见面了呢~还没发现吗？你是逃不掉的。不管你按下哪个楼层的按钮……最后都会回到我的面前~
home.captionEn: Oh, you're back. Don't you realize there's no escape? No matter what floor you try, you'll end up back here with me♡

login.caption: 这种又老又旧的电梯，最容易出意外了……要不要放我进去，和你一起享受意外带来的新感觉？
login.captionEn: This old, creaking elevator is bound to give you some trouble... Now, can you let me in? Let's enjoy the surprise together♡

main_1.caption: 我的耐心可是有限的——你不会真的以为，区区一道门就能拦住我吧？
main_1.captionEn: My patience is running thin... Do you really think a mere door could stop me?

main_2.caption: 还没决定好要在哪个楼层停下吗？放心，每个楼层的我，都会带给你截然不同的新感觉哦~
main_2.captionEn: Haven't decided which floor to run off to next? I'll be there to welcome you, no matter where you go~

main_3.caption: 呼……呼……电梯门已经打开一条缝了……那么，我·要·进·来·咯——
main_3.captionEn: Hm~ Mhm~ The door just opened a little, huh? Well, I'm coming in!

main_4.caption: 虽然这个桥段已经老掉牙了，但由我来吓人的话……呵呵，这样的体验倒是比当受害者新鲜多了呢~
main_4.captionEn: I know it's a little cliché, but it's really fresh to not be on the receiving end of a little spook♪

touch_body.caption: 那种冷冰冰的传统恐怖角色已经过时了，但我不一样，心跳和体温都能被感受到哦……
touch_body.captionEn: Those old and creepy horror stories are so outdated by now. I want to feel your heartbeat and your warmth instead♪

touch_head.caption: 想摸我的头……那就乖乖按下开门按钮吧？
touch_head.captionEn: You want to pat my head, don't you? Then be nice and open that door♪

touch_special.caption: 很会抓机会嘛？没关系，等我进来之后，有的是时间慢慢算这笔账……
touch_special.captionEn: Ah, you sure got away with that. Just watch, I'll pay you back plenty when I get in there with you...

mission.caption: 不去做任务吗？还是说，你终于也厌倦这些千篇一律、毫无新意的职责与琐事了？呵呵~
mission.captionEn: Not working today? Or, perhaps... have you finally grown tired of all that mundane, repetitive drudgery? Heehee~♪

mail.caption: 有新邮件，说不定是我投资的创新产品的进度汇报……为什么突然在我的手机里装了个反诈软件？
mail.captionEn: A letter, huh? Hopefully a progress report on the new product I invested in the other day... Hm, what's this? A fraud prevention app?

complete.caption: 委托队回来了么……希望这次她们能带回些新鲜的玩意。
complete.captionEn: Seems like the commission team has returned... Hmph, hope they brought back something new and interesting.

mission_complete.caption: 哇哦——那么无聊的任务你都完成了？下次不如换点有新意的任务怎么样？要不干脆让我来帮你安排？
mission_complete.captionEn: Oh? You actually managed to slog through all that tedium? Why not try something more worthwhile next? I could give the orders if you want.

wedding.caption: 永恒的誓约……对于这种一成不变的东西，我以前没什么兴趣。不过，对象是你就不一样了。你值得我押上所有。继续和我一起，沉沦在这场爱欲的豪赌里吧~
wedding.captionEn: An eternal vow, I see... I'm not the kind to cling to things that never change, but you're special. I would give you my everything... Yes, let's leave it all behind and make it just the two of us♪

complete.caption: 委托组的孩子们好像回来了。就把这些奖品和你的迎接当作是对她们的犒劳吧。
complete.captionEn: The girls who went out on commission are back. Your welcome, and these prizes, will be a suitable reward for them.

home.caption: 都逛遍了吗？那就坐在那里好好休息一会儿吧。我这就刷新最高记录给你看——
home.captionEn: Have you gotten a good look around? Then sit, rest, and watch as I break a new record.

login.caption: 你来了啊。你不觉得这身迎合你喜好的服装，还有这把水枪……都很符合这座乐园以及这些游乐设施的氛围吗？你也坦率地享受其中才好……
login.captionEn: Well met. This bunny outfit I picked to suit your tastes, this water gun... Don't you think they're perfect for this amusement park? I suggest you simply enjoy yourself...

main_1.caption: 祭典上的射击游戏，我早已轻车熟路。呵呵，既然指挥官亦是枪技习熟之人，与我分个高下也不失为一件乐事。
main_1.captionEn: I'm used to festival shooting games. Heehee, I know how good a shot you are. Why don't we have fun and test our skills together?

main_2.caption: 你如此努力令港区伙伴们享受这里的各种水上设施以及余兴节目……真是辛苦了。
main_2.captionEn: Preparing so many waterpark attractions and entertainment for your friends... I admire your efforts, Commander.

main_3.caption: 如同你用这乐园招待我们一般，我们也会用各种装扮来令你悦目。当然，如果你希望有更多服务，我也会满足你的……
main_3.captionEn: Just as you entertain us with this park, we'd like to treat your eyes with these different costumes. Of course, I'm able to offer more services...

main_4.caption: 无论是雷霆一斩，还是舰装的炮击，手感都确实不同……不过这样反而更有挑战的价值。别担心，像平常那样指出我应该瞄准的敌人就好。
main_4.captionEn: It's not the same as thunder-clad sword swings or cannon fire, but that makes it all the more challenging. Don't worry – just point me toward my enemy, and I'll do the rest.

main_5.caption: ……又打偏了吗。总感觉这个水枪用着不太顺手……难道准备它的不是尾张，而是明石……
main_5.captionEn: Missed again... This water gun's handling is poor at best. I have to wonder if Akashi made it, rather than Owari...

mission.caption: 有新的任务。不论形势如何风云诡谲，只要沉着应对就没有问题。
mission.captionEn: New missions. No matter how treacherous the situation is, a calm response will be more than enough to handle them.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了呢。就用这份报酬和游戏奖赏来回报你的努力吧。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. May this bounty and these prizes reward your efforts.

touch_body.caption: 你感兴趣的是这把枪……还是这身衣物的布料呢？呵呵。
touch_body.captionEn: Are you more interested in my gun... or the fabric of my clothes? Heehee.

touch_special.caption: 兔子的习性……你也应该心知肚明吧？♡
touch_special.captionEn: You know what they say about rabbits... don't you?♥

mail.caption: 给，有你的邮件，我帮你拿来了。
mail.captionEn: I brought over this letter addressed to you. Please look it over.

touch_head.caption: 真是胆大的孩子…呵呵，这种感觉，也不坏…
touch_head.captionEn: A most courageous child... Hehe, I do not object...

wedding.caption: 将所有的不安、迷惘与害怕都交给我，你只要注视着理想前进就好。更多、更多地依靠我吧，没有任何事物能将你从我的身边夺走的，我的指挥官——
wedding.captionEn: Entrust all your anxieties, doubts, and fears to me, and focus your mind only on moving forward without hesitation. Come, let me become your bedrock, your foundation. My beloved Commander, nothing in existence shall ever tear you from me.

home.caption: 凯旋的身姿，比灯光更耀眼呢……先好好享受这份荣耀吧。
home.captionEn: The heroic sight of you as you make your triumphant return shines more lustrously than any light... I hope you will take the time to bask in your glory.

login.caption: 辛苦了，我的冠军。灯光与喝彩已为你准备就绪——今夜，你将是我唯一的观众与主角。
login.captionEn: Well fought, victor. I have prepared a radiant celebration and ovation for you. You are tonight's lead and my sole spectator.

main_1.caption: 庆功的灯光，此刻只为我们舞动。喧嚣散尽，唯余并肩的宁静。能与你独享这份胜利后的宁静，正是我此刻最想品味的滋味。
main_1.captionEn: The radiance of this celebration glows solely for you and me. The tumult will eventually fade, leaving only stillness in its wake. I wish for nothing more than to spend that stillness with you.

main_2.caption: 每一个弯道的抉择，每一次果断的超车……你今日的轨迹，我都看在眼里。很漂亮，指挥官。
main_2.captionEn: The choice you faced at that corner and your bold decision to overtake... I bore witness to it all. It was magnificent, Commander.

main_3.caption: 最大的挑战已由你征服。此刻，请安心沉浸在我的掌声与灯光里吧。
main_3.captionEn: You have overcome a great trial. Therefore, you may give yourself over to my support and the radiance of this celebration.

main_4.caption: 倾注全力的应援，果然令人满足……现在，你该如何回馈如此投入的我呢？呵呵~
main_4.captionEn: I invested all I had into cheering for you, and you seem satisfied by it... How will you reward me for my support of you? Hehehe...

touch_body.caption: 花球与怀抱……在这庆功的时刻，你更想要哪一个呢？……呵呵，答案似乎很明显了呢~
touch_body.captionEn: These pom-poms, or an embrace... which is it that you seek at this celebration? Hehehe, I suppose the answer is clearer than any crystal.

touch_head.caption: 看来你对今天的我格外中意呢……呵呵，这就是给你的奖励哦~
touch_head.captionEn: You seem especially fond of me today... Hehehe, this is my reward to you.

touch_special.caption: 看来，庆功的喜悦让你比平日更坦诚了呢~这份热情，我就欣然收下了♡
touch_special.captionEn: You are less reserved than usual due to this celebration... I shall gladly receive your passion.

mail.caption: 给，有你的邮件，我帮你拿来了。
mail.captionEn: I brought over this letter addressed to you. Please look it over.

complete.caption: 委托组的孩子们归来了。虽然不能亲自护送，不过能见到她们平安归来也算是安心了。
complete.captionEn: The children of the commission fleet have returned. I am unable to personally escort them back, but am nevertheless glad to see them safe and sound.

wedding.caption: 将所有的不安、迷惘与害怕都交给我，你只要注视着理想前进就好。更多、更多地依靠我吧，没有任何事物能将你从我的身边夺走的，我的指挥官——
wedding.captionEn: Entrust all your anxieties, doubts, and fears to me, and focus your mind only on moving forward without hesitation. Come, let me become your bedrock, your foundation. My beloved Commander, nothing in existence shall ever tear you from me.

mission.caption: 新的任务下达了？稳扎稳打的执行即可，切莫急于求成。
mission.captionEn: A new mission? Take it one step at a time, and at a comfortable pace. Haste makes waste.

mission_complete.caption: 任务报酬已确认，港区的物资储备变更加丰富了呢。
mission_complete.captionEn: The mission rewards have arrived. Our stockpiles continue to grow more and more abundant.

complete.caption: 啊！这些东西看起来都好危险！让我来清点吧~恶魔之主才不会觉得害怕！
complete.captionEn: Sheesh! That looks mighty dangerous! Lemme have a look at it. A demoness can handle herself!

home.caption: 想休息一会儿？这是你现在的愿望么？那用一个拥抱来交换，我就满足你！
home.captionEn: You want a break? That's your wish, then? Aight, I'll grant your wish if you gimme a hug♪

login.caption: 你来了，想好要让我帮你实现什么愿望了吗~？什么都可以哦，不要小看我！
login.captionEn: Welcome back! So, figured out your wish to me yet? Anything's valid, remember that! Don't underestimate my abilities!

mail.caption: 你的信，都检查过了哦，没有诅咒的气息，安心拆开看吧~
mail.captionEn: I looked through all the letters addressed to you. They ain't cursed or nothin', so go ahead and read!

main_1.caption: 这个？这个当然是用来惩罚不守约定的客人的！当然，也可以有其他用途哦，比如……什么？你好奇了？
main_1.captionEn: The whip? Oh, it's for the naughty kids who don't keep their promises! It's got other uses too, 'course, like for instance... Hm? You wanna try it?

main_2.caption: 新鲜的蔬菜真的很美味呢~你也觉得好吃吗？待会一起去收菜吧~什么？恶魔一般不吃蔬菜的么？
main_2.captionEn: Man, fresh veggies are so delish. You think so too? Cool, then wanna harvest the field with me later? ...What? Demons aren't supposed to eat veggies?!

main_3.caption: 哦？想实现我的愿望吗？还真是大胆的提议呢！那我就认真想想我的愿望吧！
main_3.captionEn: Huh? You wanna grant MY wish? Pretty gutsy proposal ya got there. Aight, I'm gonna think about my wish for later!

mission.caption: 工作还没做完？什么工作还能在这里做……？算了，我帮你吧！作为等价交换，工作结束后，陪我一起吃饭吧！
mission.captionEn: Work ain't over yet? You shouldn't be workin' down here in the... Whatevs, I'll help ya out! In return, you gotta grab a bite with me after we're done!

mission_complete.caption: 嗯？工作就做完了？我还什么都没做呢……？总之还是一起吃饭吧！
mission_complete.captionEn: Huh? Already finished your work? But I haven't lifted a finger yet... Oh well! Time to get some food!

touch_body.caption: 怎么？这么想靠近我吗？那恶魔之主就特别准许你在这里坐下啦♪~
touch_body.captionEn: Huh? You sure you wanna get THAT close to me? Aight, then as the lord of this place, I allow you to sit here!

touch_head.caption: 小心别被划伤手哦！在恶魔栖息之城中落下鲜甜的血液……可能会被吃掉哦！大概！
touch_head.captionEn: Watch it so ya don't cut your fingers! If you spill any yummy-yummy blood of yours in the Dwelling of Demons, you're gettin' eaten! Probably.

touch_special.caption: 满足了吗？之后呢，还想要什么？无论什么，我都可以实现哦♡~
touch_special.captionEn: Already satisfied? Sure there ain't nothin' else you wanna do? Remember – I'll grant ANY wish you have♡

wedding.caption: 真是的！该说是无论何时何地我都很在意，还是该说指挥官这个存在本身就太具有破坏力了…总之，我是彻底迷上你了！到这种情况…已经束手无策了…对吧？
wedding.captionEn: God! I just can't stop thinkin' about you, whatever I do, like you're literally stuck in my head... What I'm getting at is: I'm crazy for you! Might as well stop fighting it and... accept it, y'know?

home.caption: 指挥官，您终于回来了。这次……能帮我解开绳子了吗？
home.captionEn: Oh, you're finally back... Can you untie me this time, please?

login.caption: 指挥官，如您所见……我的逃脱之术还不够娴熟，所以……拜托您再靠过来一些~好吗？
login.captionEn: As you can see, my escape technique isn't quite perfect. Can you get a little closer, please?

main_1.caption: 哎呀~费尽心思系的绳结，解开时却成了难题……指挥官，要是能给我解开的话~作为回报，让我来教您“更复杂的绑法”也可以哦~
main_1.captionEn: Ugh... Tying the knot was hard enough. I'm amazed that it's even more difficult to untie... Commander, if you untie it for me, I'll teach you an even more enticing way to tie it.

main_2.caption: 长天如海云波起，繁星似林隐月舟……忽然在此情此景下，怀念起过去与您泛舟湖面的经历了，不知道您是否……嗯……或许我应该先把绳子解开再想这些？
main_2.captionEn: "In the sea of heaven, the waves of cloud arise. And the moon's ship is seen sailing, to hide in a forest of stars." That reminds me of when you and I sailed together. Um... Actually, maybe you should untie me before we reminisce?

main_3.caption: 指挥官，我正在苦恼该怎么“得体”地把酒喂给您呢，现在这副姿态实在是……呵呵，我明白了~这种时候就需要一些另类的展开了，对吧~
main_3.captionEn: Frankly, I'm not sure how we can share a drink in this state. I mean, this posture doesn't lend itself to the act very well... Hehe, you're right! Desperate times do call for desperate measures, no?

mission.caption: 虽然很想让您尽快帮我解开绳子，但果然还是任务比较重要吧？
mission.captionEn: I'd really like to be untied right now, but your missions come first, I suppose...

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成~您问我是怎么知道的？呵呵……要是您愿意靠近点的话，我就告诉您~
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission accomplished, hmm? How did I know? Come closer, and I'll tell you.

touch_body.caption: 指挥官，可不要趁机使坏哦~
touch_body.captionEn: I hope you're not plotting anything evil right now...

touch_head.caption: 嗯哼……到我身边来吧，指挥官，这样才能摸得更舒服哦~
touch_head.captionEn: Hehe... Come over here, and you can touch me more freely.

touch_special.caption: 哎呀，看来您完全相信我被困住了呢……不过，对我来说，这世上唯一能够束缚住我的东西……就是您哦~？
touch_special.captionEn: Oh, my... You're certain that I can't move, aren't you? Of course, there's only one thing in this world that can truly bind me – and that's you.

complete.caption: 参与委托的同伴们回来了吗？嗯……您觉得用这几瓶佳酿慰劳一下她们怎么样？
complete.captionEn: Oh, are the commission girls back? Hmm... Why don't we welcome them with ample drinks?

mail.caption: 嗯？莫非是我订购的佳酿送到了吗？呵呵，开玩笑的，是您的邮件哟~
mail.captionEn: Hmm? Did the wine I ordered arrive? Hehe, just kidding. There's mail for you, Commander.

wedding.caption: 纵然世事寡淡如水，只要有酒入怀，便可缀满诗意——心若盈芳，大千世界皆为绝景——指挥官，我愿与您同行于这幅画卷之中，相伴不离。
wedding.captionEn: No matter how bland daily life can be, wine is enough to fill it with poetry. As long as flowers bloom in my heart, the whole world can be like a beautiful painting. Commander, let's keep walking through life's picture scroll together.

complete.caption: 委托完成了哦～呵呵，不过指挥官大人得先起来才行呢♡
complete.captionEn: The commission is done~ Heehee, you should get up first, okay?♡

home.caption: 哈...欢迎回来，指挥官大人～大凤一直一直一直在这里等着您呢♡
home.captionEn: Aah... Welcome back, my Commander~ I've been waiting here for you for so, so, sooo very long♡

login.caption: 呼...指挥官大人，您的技术还是这么好呢～下一球想打哪里都可以，准备好了随时叫大凤来就好♡
login.captionEn: Phew... You're too good at this, my Commander~ Once you've decided on your next move, call me, and I'll be there right away♡

main_1.caption: 该从哪里进攻呢...请用手指轻轻指给大凤看呢♡随时都准备就绪哦～
main_1.captionEn: Where should I shoot, and how? Use your finger to guide me♡ I'm ready any time~

main_2.caption: 如果要打库射的话，得好好计算反射角度，预先让球朝着想要打进的袋角调整杆头......指，指挥官大人！？突然变得太专业了，大凤跟不上节奏了...！
main_2.captionEn: If you want to go for a bank shot, then you need to calculate the angle it will bounce at to hit the pocket... M-my Commander?! This is getting too detailed for me to keep up!

main_3.caption: 指挥官大人又在发呆呢...不用管大凤，就这样瞄准吧～要用大凤来支撑球杆也可以哦♡
main_3.captionEn: My Commander, you're spacing out again... Go ahead and aim. Don't mind me~ If you want, use me to balance your cue♡

mission.caption: 有新的任务了～啧，偏偏在这种时候......
mission.captionEn: New missions are here~ Tch, what bad timing...

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了哦～光是大凤一个人还不够做指挥官大人的奖励吗？
mission_complete.captionEn: Missions complete~ My Commander, do you mean to say that I'm not reward enough for you?

touch_body.caption: 指挥官大人怎么了？不是说好要和大凤一起练习台球的吗？♡
touch_body.captionEn: Is something the matter, my Commander? Aren't you supposed to be teaching me billiards right now?♡

touch_head.caption: 指挥官大人～就把一切都交给大凤吧♡
touch_head.captionEn: My Commander~ Leave everything to me♡

touch_special.caption: 指挥官大人♡请更多更多地宠爱大凤吧♡
touch_special.captionEn: My Commander♡ Love me more and more and more♡

mail.caption: 指挥官，新邮件~大凤已经用舌头检查过没有毒了唷~
mail.captionEn: My Commander, you've got mail~ I licked it very tho-rough-ly. It's safe.

wedding.caption: 终于送到大凤手里了呢~如果不是上面写着大凤的名字，早就把它处理掉了呢嘻嘻——嗯？为什么会知道？指挥官的全～部大凤都知道哟，从今往后，大凤也会全心想着您的～
wedding.captionEn: It's finally on my finger! You know, I would have thrown this ring out long ago if it didn't have my name on it. Hehehe. Oh? How did I know about it? I tollld you, I know EVERYTHING about my Commander. And from now on I'm going to love EVERYTHING about you too~

home.caption: 汝想再度观赏这场魔术么……？若能抚慰汝疲惫身心，妾身自当竭尽全力。
home.captionEn: Do you wish to see this one's magic again...? Whatever it takes to soothe you...

login.caption: 汝来了……若汝钟情此梦，不妨在此多停留片刻吧……当然，妾身亦会于此，与汝相伴。
login.captionEn: This one welcomes your arrival... If you wish, you may stay in my grotto. This one will accompany you, of course...

main_1.caption: 时间仓促，妾身未能仔细打理尾巴，稍显凌乱了……望汝莫要在意……
main_1.captionEn: There wasn't much time to prepare, so this one's tail is unbrushed and messy... Please forgive me.

main_2.caption: 此密闭玻璃箱的尺寸，与妾身原先所想略有偏差，稍显局促……好在并未影响演出的效果。
main_2.captionEn: This glass box is rather cramped... Fortunately, it did not affect the performance...

main_3.caption: 这般摇曳生姿的灯火，与汝炽热如炬的目光……皆令妾身情难自禁……
main_3.captionEn: Phantasmal, dancing lights and your passionate gaze... They make this one's self-control futile...

main_4.caption: 听闻此般手势能够传达欢欣之意？汝能够感受到么？妾身面对汝时，满怀的欣喜。
main_4.captionEn: Supposedly, this hand gesture conveys joy... Do you see the joy this one feels in your presence?

touch_body.caption: 汝可是想将此箱子打开？
touch_body.captionEn: Do you... wish to open this box?

touch_head.caption: 嗯？在这梦境之中，妾身不会再睡去。
touch_head.captionEn: Hmm...? In this dream realm, this one will not fall asleep...

touch_special.caption: 嗯……汝的温度，妾身感受到了，这是汝的魔术么……？
touch_special.captionEn: Hmm... Your warmth reaches this one. Is this your own magic...?

complete.caption: Zzzzz…万不可…忘记那些默默付出之人，前往…迎接她们吧
complete.captionEn: Mmmm... The girls on commission are returning now... 'twould behoove you to forget them not...

mail.caption: 信件承载着来自远方的思念，万不可轻视…
mail.captionEn: Dismiss not the letters bearing distant thoughts...

mission_complete.caption: 果然有汝在，没有什么是做不到的。
mission_complete.captionEn: As long as you are here, there is nothing that cannot be accomplished...

mission.caption: 任务…能及时完成吗？
mission.captionEn: This task... can it be completed in time...?

wedding.caption: 回想在此港区与汝经历之种种，皆是令人不禁微笑的美好回忆…是汝为妾身带来了截然不同的生活。从今往后，妾身会与汝一同，直面各种命运，无论幸或不幸——
wedding.captionEn: The memories forged at this port... have brought me great joy... Alas, from now on... I shall cherish my time with you through fates both joyful and painful... through weal and woe alike...

home.caption: 妾身一直在等汝……此时此刻，汝之渴望与悸动，皆随风而至，传至妾身心中……
home.captionEn: This one has waited for you... Oh, how the wind has carried your yearnings to my heart.

login.caption: 与汝分饮此酒，即可知觉相融，互通五感……啊，果真是妙不可言的体验……
login.captionEn: By sharing this liquor, we allow our senses to mingle, our minds to meld... Ah, it is too wonderful for words...

main_1.caption: 从未体验过这般妙趣……汝可愿再近半步，与妾身同寐共枕、合织一梦？
main_1.captionEn: Unprecedented ecstasy... Will you take the next step, share this bed with me, and weave new dreams together?

main_2.caption: ……妾身没有睡着哦，只是在仔细体会汝给予的，这和煦如风的轻抚……
main_2.captionEn: Phew... This one is not asleep, but savoring your soft caress...

main_3.caption: 醉意正酣，情亦甚浓……此刻涌上心头的欢喜，既属于妾身，也属于汝……
main_3.captionEn: Intoxicated, burning with affection... The bliss welling up in this one's heart belongs to the both of us...

touch_body.caption: 汝之感触，妾身之感触，现已合二为一。
touch_body.captionEn: Our feelings are joined in perfect union...

touch_head.caption: 汝似乎钟爱此处……妾身能感受到汝的愉悦~
touch_head.captionEn: Mmnh, do you love this place? This one feels your ecstasy...

touch_special.caption: 嗯……这双份的醇美滋味，真让人沉醉……
touch_special.captionEn: Mm... The overlap of these rich flavors is... too heady to bear... Aaah...

complete.caption: Zzzzz…万不可…忘记那些默默付出之人，前往…迎接她们吧
complete.captionEn: Mmmm... The girls on commission are returning now... 'twould behoove you to forget them not...

mail.caption: 信件承载着来自远方的思念，万不可轻视…
mail.captionEn: Dismiss not the letters bearing distant thoughts...

mission.caption: 任务…能及时完成吗？
mission.captionEn: This task... can it be completed in time...?

main_4.caption: 汝托付于妾身的报告书在此…错误很多？…看来赶工也不是个好事…
main_4.captionEn: I have left the report here... Hmm... There are many errors? ...'twould seem that hasty deadlines are not this one's strong suit...

main_5.caption: 之字…嗯…啊，刚才不小心撞上汝了吗？抱歉…
main_5.captionEn: Vrooom... Zzzzzz... Oh... Did I hit you by mistake? ...Sincerest apologies...

wedding.caption: 回想在此港区与汝经历之种种，皆是令人不禁微笑的美好回忆…是汝为妾身带来了截然不同的生活。从今往后，妾身会与汝一同，直面各种命运，无论幸或不幸——
wedding.captionEn: The memories forged at this port... have brought me great joy... Alas, from now on... I shall cherish my time with you through fates both joyful and painful... through weal and woe alike...

mission_complete.caption: 果然有汝在，没有什么是做不到的。
mission_complete.captionEn: As long as you are here, there is nothing that cannot be accomplished...

complete.caption: 主上，委托组或许为您带来了不一样的惊喜，一起去看看吧？
complete.captionEn: The commission team might've brought back something surprising. Commander, shall we go take a look together?

home.caption: 如预想的一般，主上得胜归来了。天城已经命人为您准备好了凯旋之宴，请您与我同去吧。
home.captionEn: You have returned victorious, just as I predicted. I have already called for a celebration, so please follow me to the venue, if you would.

login.caption: 主上，欢迎来到我的城堡，请您忘却烦恼，在此处尽情享受吧。
login.captionEn: Commander, welcome to Castle Amagi. Please set aside your worries and revel to your heart's content.

mail.caption: 主上，您的信。嗯……不如就在这王座之上阅读吧？
mail.captionEn: Commander, your mail has arrived. Umm... If you don't mind, maybe we could share the throne and read them together?

main_1.caption: 嗯？主上是觉得自己来了以后，似乎每天都是好天气？呵呵……还是被您发现了啊，果然瞒不过主上。
main_1.captionEn: Hmm? You've noticed that it's been clear and sunny every day here since you arrived? Heehee... How observant of you. I would expect nothing less.

main_2.caption: 城堡中寂寞的主人与误入的访客——主上不觉得，对童话故事而言，这是很不错的题材吗？那么，接下来又会发生什么呢？
main_2.captionEn: "A chance encounter between a world-weary castellan and a lost visitor"... Hmm, don't you think that makes for a wonderful fairy tale theme?

main_3.caption: 在这梦幻的乐园之中，偶尔也可以小小地放纵一次呢……呵呵，主上，要不要从羊羹开始，陪天城一起把想吃的点心全部试着吃吃看呢？
main_3.captionEn: Since you're already in a dreamland paradise, why not take advantage of the opportunity fully and indulge yourself? Heeehee... Commander, shall we try all the sweets here together? Starting with the yokan~

main_4.caption: 主上，城堡内上锁房间的钥匙都在天城手中，想要入内探索的话，就请满足我的心愿吧。一个心愿，换取一把钥匙，如何~？
main_4.captionEn: I am in charge of all the keys to the doors here that cannot be opened. I would be glad to give these keys to you, as long as you fulfill my wishes. So, Commander... One wish per key. Does that sound like a good deal?

mission.caption: 是新的任务呢。没关系，天城会陪着主上一起完成的。
mission.captionEn: A new mission, huh? Worry not, for I am with you.

mission_complete.caption: 主上，无需忧虑，任务都完成了，您安心在此处享受就好。
mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, there's nothing to worry about. All your missions have already been completed. All you need to do now is rest and relax.

touch_body.caption: 嗯？主上的心思，我或许已经猜到了……
touch_body.captionEn: Hmm... Commander, I do believe I've already caught a glimpse of your true intentions. Heehee.

touch_head.caption: 嗯？主上是觉得无聊了么……？
touch_head.captionEn: Hmm? Commander... Am I not keeping you entertained?

touch_special.caption: 嗯……主上……天城，不用再忍耐了……对么？
touch_special.captionEn: Ahhn... Commander... I, don't have to rein in my urges any longer, right...?

wedding.caption: 现在的天城，已经不再是过去那个羸弱的天城，主上……也不是当日那个略显青涩的主上了呢……天城在此起誓，从今往后，我绝对不会再离开您的身边了。主上，乱世仍未平息，让我们一同努力吧！
wedding.captionEn: I am no longer the weak and naive Amagi that I was before... just as you are no longer the same naive Commander you were before. And so, I vow to never leave your side again. The world remains in turmoil, Commander, so let us join hands and continue our good work.

home.caption: 主上，您看到了吗，水面因您的到来漾开柔光……即便是方才等候您的时光，也都化作甜蜜的烦恼了。
home.captionEn: Did you see that? The surface of the water was glowing so gently, as if it were welcoming you back... Hehe, all that time I spent waiting was nothing more than sweet torment.

login.caption: 主上，请更多地用您的眼睛注视我，用您的手感知我，也让我用同样的方式……回应您。
login.captionEn: Commander, I want you to keep gazing at me with those eyes and touching me with those hands. I will... return the favor.

main_1.caption: 指尖划开的涟漪，一圈一圈，都是寄向您的心之信笺。它们在水光中闪烁的模样，很漂亮吧？
main_1.captionEn: The ripples I make with my fingers represent the feelings I hope will reach you, Commander. Don't they look beautiful as they shimmer in the water?

main_2.caption: 水下的世界很安静，安静到……我只能听见自己的心跳，在为您加速。主上，您能感觉到吗？
main_2.captionEn: The waters are so quiet. I can hear the racing of my own heart as I sense your presence, Commander. Can you feel my heartbeat too?

main_3.caption: 呵呵，主上也想要试试摆动鱼尾的动作吗？那靠我近些，我来为您示范~
main_3.captionEn: Hehehe, would you like to know how mermaids swish their tails? Come a little closer, Commander, and I'll show you.

main_4.caption: 如今终于有机会，能像这样悠闲地欣赏水下景色了呢……指挥官，您愿意陪我四下看看吗~
main_4.captionEn: We finally have time to take in the underwater scenery. Would you like to take a tour of the area with me, Commander?

touch_head.caption: 嗯……即便在纷扰的水流中，我也能感受到，从您掌心传来的温暖呢~
touch_head.captionEn: Aah... Even underwater, I can feel the warmth of your palm, Commander.

touch_special.caption: 主上……是想与天城，分享氧气吗？
touch_special.captionEn: Commander... Were you hoping to exchange oxygen with me?

wedding.caption: 现在的天城，已经不再是过去那个羸弱的天城，主上……也不是当日那个略显青涩的主上了呢……天城在此起誓，从今往后，我绝对不会再离开您的身边了。主上，乱世仍未平息，让我们一同努力吧！
wedding.captionEn: I am no longer the weak and naive Amagi that I was before... just as you are no longer the same naive Commander you were before. And so, I vow to never leave your side again. The world remains in turmoil, Commander, so let us join hands and continue our good work.

complete.caption: 主上，委托完成了，我们一起去仓库看看吧？
complete.captionEn: Commander, a commission has been completed. Shall we head down to meet our friends at the warehouse?

mission.caption: 呵呵，关于接下来的任务，我已经想好应对之策了。主上，请过目。
mission.captionEn: Heehee. I've already put together a plan for the next mission. Would you like to look it over, Commander?

touch_body.caption: 主上，既然累了的话，要不要枕着我的尾巴歇息片刻呢？
touch_body.captionEn: Commander, if you are tired, come and rest awhile. Would you like to use my tail as your pillow?

mission_complete.caption: 这些报酬，都会成为主上大业的基石……得想办法再多要些来呢~
mission_complete.captionEn: Let these rewards pave the way towards your next great achievement. Yes... I'll have to come up with some plan to procure us even greater rewards...

mail.caption: 主上，有您的信。我用舰载机送到您的桌子上了哦~
mail.captionEn: Commander, new mail has arrived. I'm sending it over via carrier-based aircraft, so please take a look when you have time.

home.caption: 您回来得真快……哎呀，这把刀怎么出鞘了？真危险，赶紧合上吧……但如果白凤以死相逼，想必主公大人也会心软地同意我留下吧？
home.captionEn: Back so soon? Why is your blade unsheathed? That's dangerous, so you'd best put it away... If I begged desperately, you would have mercy on me, wouldn't you?

login.caption: 被主公大人压制得太狼狈了呢，您想好该怎么对我负责了吗？……释放？这可真是令人意外的选择……
login.captionEn: You have me in your clutches now. What will you do to me? ...Oh. You'll release me? That's... unexpected.

main_1.caption: 主公大人觉得，像白凤这样失败的“刺客”，还有改进空间吗？比如潜入技巧？……呵呵，先把杀意藏起来吗？这确实是我的失误……
main_1.captionEn: My lord, do you have any advice for this failed assassin? For example, techniques to improve my stealth... Heehee, you think I should try harder to hide my malice first? I can't believe that's what did me in.

main_2.caption: 为什么能轻松找到您的位置？我留在您身上的香气可不会骗人啊，主公大人~
main_2.captionEn: How did I pinpoint your location so easily? It's because of the scent I left on you, of course!

main_3.caption: 能用来捆住白凤的绳子，还剩这么多呢……主公大人，不要浪费了白凤的心意哦……~
main_3.captionEn: You still have a lot of rope left over, I see... Please make good use of my love for you, my lord.

main_4.caption: 呼……呼……难道就没有回旋的余地了吗，明明白凤已经对主公大人毫无保留……
main_4.captionEn: *pant*... *pant*... I'm trying to offer my everything to you. Is there no room for mercy?

mission.caption: 主公大人，新任务来了哦，只要能在您身边，白凤就一定会给您帮上忙的~
mission.captionEn: New missions require your attention, my lord. Allow me to join you, and I'm sure I can help.

touch_body.caption: 抓住您了，主公大人~呵呵，您不该这样毫无防备地靠近呢……
touch_body.captionEn: Caught you! Hehe, that's for approaching me so carelessly.

touch_head.caption: 白凤博得您的欢心了吗~
touch_head.captionEn: Have I pleased you, my lord?

touch_special.caption: 主公大人现在是白凤的俘虏了呢，呵呵……
touch_special.captionEn: You're my captive now, my lord... Heehee.

mail.caption: 新邮件来了哦，已经帮您熏过香了~这香味合您心意吗？
mail.captionEn: You have new mail. Heehee, I gave it a scent for you. Do you like it?

complete.caption: 要去迎接委托队了嘛？白凤已经备好了迎接仪式，愿与您一同前往~
complete.captionEn: Are you going to meet the commission team? I've prepared a welcoming ceremony, so allow me to join you.

mission_complete.caption: 如此便算完成了~作为辛苦工作的奖励，请允许我为您熏燃新香~
mission_complete.captionEn: All done♪ As a reward for your efforts, may I burn a new stick of incense?

wedding.caption: 我好开心，好开心，指挥官大人果然牵挂着我呢……嗯？您是不是开始困了呢？那就再睡会儿吧——我会陪着您……就在这静悄悄的，黎明前的永恒之夜……
wedding.captionEn: I'm so... so happy... You really do care for me, don't you? Oh...? Are you sleepy, my Commander? Then rest a while. I'll stay here with you throughout this eternal night...

home.caption: 指挥官大人，您回来了吗？那就请把门打开吧——白凤的嫁仪可不等人呢……呵呵~您不会是想装作没听见吧~
home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. Our nuptials cannot wait any longer, so please open the door – Heheh, you're not pretending you can't hear me, are you?

login.caption: 若您迟迟未归，这场雨……大概也要陪我一直等下去了呢。不过没关系，再久一点也无妨，我知道您总会来的……呵呵呵~
login.captionEn: I will await your return, Commander, with this sunshower as my company. You need not worry: it's alright if you run a little late. I know you will return to my side someday.

main_1.caption: 外面下着雨，您哪儿也去不了呢……但对白凤而言，只要有您在身边，便是再麻烦的天气也会变得惹人怜爱呢~呵呵~
main_1.captionEn: With this pouring rain, you cannot go anywhere, Commander... But for me, even this sunshower is a precious moment♪ Heheheh...

main_2.caption: 白凤心里，始终就只有指挥官大人呢……那您的心里，也会有白凤的身影吗？真想看看啊……
main_2.captionEn: My heart is yours, Commander, and no one else's... Is your heart mine, as well? Aaah... I look forward to finding out.

main_3.caption: 白凤愿化身这纸红伞，无论晴雨都陪伴在您身边……您说这样，够不够显眼呢？姐姐听到这话，大概要生气了吧，呵呵呵~
main_3.captionEn: How I long to become this red umbrella, so I may always be by your side, in rain or shine... Don't you think I'd stand out? My, if my sister heard me say this, she'd no doubt be furious! Heheheh♪

main_4.caption: 您听说过晴雨狐嫁吗？为了表明心意，新郎啊——可要把自己的心剖出来哦~指挥官大人……您准备好了吗？
main_4.captionEn: Do you know the legend of the Fox Bride, Commander? It is said that the groom is supposed to offer his heart, you know? Commander... are you ready?

touch_body.caption: 好闻吗？今天的白凤……应该比平时更惹您怜爱吧~呵呵呵~
touch_body.captionEn: I smell nice, don't I? I think you'll find me... even more irresistible than ever today♪ Heehee~

touch_head.caption: 呵呵……您这样摸我的耳朵，是在哄我开心吗？那以后，可要每天都这样哄我哦~
touch_head.captionEn: Heheheh... The way you're stroking these ears... Are you trying to please me? Then, pamper me like this every day from now on, you hear?

touch_special.caption: 呼——再一次、就一次……让白凤记住这种感觉吧~
touch_special.captionEn: Mmgh... More, mooore... Let me relish this sensation...

mail.caption: 新邮件来了哦，已经帮您熏过香了~这香味合您心意吗？
mail.captionEn: You have new mail. Heehee, I gave it a scent for you. Do you like it?

complete.caption: 要去迎接委托队了嘛？白凤已经备好了迎接仪式，愿与您一同前往~
complete.captionEn: Are you going to meet the commission team? I've prepared a welcoming ceremony, so allow me to join you.

mission_complete.caption: 如此便算完成了~作为辛苦工作的奖励，请允许我为您熏燃新香~
mission_complete.captionEn: All done♪ As a reward for your efforts, may I burn a new stick of incense?

wedding.caption: 我好开心，好开心，指挥官大人果然牵挂着我呢……嗯？您是不是开始困了呢？那就再睡会儿吧——我会陪着您……就在这静悄悄的，黎明前的永恒之夜……
wedding.captionEn: I'm so... so happy... You really do care for me, don't you? Oh...? Are you sleepy, my Commander? Then rest a while. I'll stay here with you throughout this eternal night...

mission.caption: 新任务来了呢，如果是仪式相关的事务，请尽管吩咐白凤~
mission.captionEn: New missions, hmm? If they relate to ceremony at all, then don't hesitate to ask for my help.

home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。您若是想要做些什么，亦或者是渴望着想要成为什么样的存在……用言语还是身体都可以，请您毫无保留地向我坦白吧♪
home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. What do you want to do, who do you want to be? Tell me with your words... or your body...

login.caption: 指挥官，所有的文件都已经提交完毕了吗？如果还有什么疏漏的地方，我会陪您修改到完美为止的哦。当然，是零距离贴身指导那种——
login.captionEn: Have you submitted all of your documents? If anything is missing, I'll help you revise them. Just the two of us...

main_1.caption: 有点难想象指挥官补习的模样呢，如果是给其他孩子补习的话倒还好——但如果是这种情况的话，我应该就不会在场了吧……
main_1.captionEn: I can't imagine you getting tutored. Maybe tutoring others... But I wouldn't be here in that scenario, would I?

main_2.caption: 指挥官，都是因为您港区的风纪才会乱作一团的，您该不会还没意识到吧？呵呵~♫
main_2.captionEn: You're the reason that the port is so undisciplined, you know. Do you understand that? Heehee!

main_3.caption: 嘿咻嘿咻……原来指挥官对这种亲密接触的指导方式情有独钟吗？原来如此，看来我的修行还远远不够呢……嗯？您说这种东西不需要去学吗……？
main_3.captionEn: Here you go... You like getting stepped on a little in your role-play, don't you? Ah, so I still need to improve my skills... Hm? You think I don't need to learn that?

mission.caption: 是在完成任务上遇到了什么困难吗？呵呵，不用害羞，请尽管跟我商量吧
mission.captionEn: Are you having trouble with your missions? Heehee, don't be shy. Tell me all about it.

touch_body.caption: 这种情况下，您刚才的那番举动……意思是想跟我“更近距离地接触”，对吧？
touch_body.captionEn: That was a sign that you want to be touched, wasn't it?

touch_special.caption: 那个，外面说不定还有其他人……呼呼~指挥官，来吧～这里除了我们就没有别人了哦♡
touch_special.captionEn: Let's see, is there anyone outside... Phew, okay. Come on, Commander~ There's nobody around but us♡

mail.caption: 邮件我已经帮指挥官收好了，快看看吧~
mail.captionEn: I got the mail. Please look it over.

complete.caption: 委托组的大家已经回港了，指挥官，要我代为清点物资么？
complete.captionEn: The girls you sent out on commission have returned. Would you like me to inspect the rewards for you? Commander?

mission_complete.caption: 任务的奖励有好多……真不愧是指挥官呢~
mission_complete.captionEn: So many mission rewards... Commander, you're fantastic.

wedding.caption: 指挥官的心意，我已经完全明白了。从此刻起，我会用未来的全部时光去爱着您的…呼…虽然是自己说出来的，不过还是有点害羞呢…嘻嘻…
wedding.captionEn: Now that I understand your feelings, Commander, I will offer you all that I am, body and soul... Phew... Saying that out loud is as embarrassing as I thought it would be. Hehehe.

home.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。您若是想要做些什么，亦或者是渴望着想要成为什么样的存在……用言语还是身体都可以，请您毫无保留地向我坦白吧♪
home.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. What do you want to do, who do you want to be? Tell me with your words... or your body...

login.captionEn: Have you submitted all of your documents? If anything is missing, I'll help you revise them. Just the two of us...

main_1.captionEn: I can't imagine you getting tutored. Maybe tutoring others... But I wouldn't be here in that scenario, would I?

main_2.captionEn: You're the reason that the port is so undisciplined, you know. Do you understand that? Heehee!

mission.captionEn: Are you having trouble with your missions? Heehee, don't be shy. Tell me all about it.

touch_body.captionEn: That was a sign that you want to be touched, wasn't it?

touch_special.caption: 那个，外面说不定还有其他人……呼呼~指挥官，来吧～这里除了我们就没有别人了哦♡
touch_special.captionEn: Let's see, is there anyone outside... Phew, okay. Come on, Commander~ There's nobody around but us♡

mail.caption: 邮件我已经帮指挥官收好了，快看看吧~
mail.captionEn: I got the mail. Please look it over.

complete.caption: 委托组的大家已经回港了，指挥官，要我代为清点物资么？
complete.captionEn: The girls you sent out on commission have returned. Would you like me to inspect the rewards for you? Commander?

mission_complete.caption: 任务的奖励有好多……真不愧是指挥官呢~
mission_complete.captionEn: So many mission rewards... Commander, you're fantastic.

wedding.caption: 指挥官的心意，我已经完全明白了。从此刻起，我会用未来的全部时光去爱着您的…呼…虽然是自己说出来的，不过还是有点害羞呢…嘻嘻…
wedding.captionEn: Now that I understand your feelings, Commander, I will offer you all that I am, body and soul... Phew... Saying that out loud is as embarrassing as I thought it would be. Hehehe.

complete.caption: 委托的伙伴们好像已经回来了～对，这里的水流是和大海相连的所以我能感受到。哼哼♪
complete.captionEn: Seems the commission team is back! Why, yes, this stream connects to the sea, so I can tell. Heehee♪

home.caption: 用山川治愈疲劳，以龙神恩惠化解战争的业障……咳。也，也就是说一起享受的意思啦
home.captionEn: Lounge in nature's waters, draw upon the Dragon God's blessing to cleanse the karma of war... Ahem. Wh-what I'm saying is: Let's have a good time.

login.caption: 以仙流净身，以净水去厄，与瑞穂丰饶的自然融为一体，净化内心——这可是龙神大人的珍贵教诲哦♪
login.captionEn: Cleanse yourself like the mountain hermit, purge evil with pure water, become one with Mizuho's nature and purify your heart – this is a teaching of gratitude from the Dragon God♪

main_1.caption: ♪～来，指挥官也一起到水里来吧？难得的机会，不尽情享受一下可就亏了哦？
main_1.captionEn: Hm-hmm-hm♪ Come into the water, Commander. You don't wanna waste this opportunity to have as much as we can, do you?

main_2.caption: 问我「修行」是不是大多都选在瀑布…？我，我不怎么喜欢瀑布啦…因为有点痛嘛…
main_2.captionEn: You thought this kind of training would be done under a waterfall? Uh, well... I don't really like waterfall training. It's painful.

main_3.caption: 将瑞穗的灵气汇蓄于身，将云霞化为养分——当然也可以用这种方法修行，不过指挥官感兴趣吗？…真的吗？
main_3.captionEn: Take Mizuho's aura within you, and let its clouds nourish you – that's one way of doing it if you're interested... Really? You are?

mission.caption: 指挥官，看来还有任务没完成。洗净了厄运的现在，一定会事半功倍的
mission.captionEn: Commander, there are missions left to do. I'm sure they'll be a cinch now that you've cleansed yourself.

mission_complete.caption: 感觉可以将任务奖励沿河顺流而下送到下游的伙伴那里呢。不行吗？
mission_complete.captionEn: We could set the mission rewards afloat for the others downstream to collect. Too far-fetched?

touch_body.caption: 呀！？好啊你！现在就让你尝尝我的降雨之术，做好觉悟吧！
touch_body.captionEn: Eek! Now you've done it! Better get ready, because I'm going to make it rain above you!

touch_special.caption: 这，这可算不上修行……///
touch_special.captionEn: Th-this is not what self-training is about...

mail.caption: 信件？会有人送来吗…
mail.captionEn: Mail? Will someone drop by to deliver it...?

touch_head.captionEn: Hmm...?

main_4.caption: 嗯，叠好了。啊，这个不是普通的纸飞机而是式纸……不过现在确实就和指挥官说的一样，只是普通的纸飞机呢……唔……
main_4.captionEn: Perfect, all done. Oh, this isn't an ordinary paper airplane– it's a shikigami plane. Uhh, but, right now, it pretty much is just a paper airplane, just as you said... Mhm...

wedding.caption: 如果交换了誓约，那我们之间就是斩也斩不断的关系——这既是恩赐，也是诅咒。这样也可以吗？…是吗？呵呵，那下一步该怎么做？接吻？拥抱？还是…？
wedding.captionEn: Should we exchange vows, then an inseparable bond would form between us– indeed, this is both a blessing and a curse. Are you fine with that? ...I see. Heehee. In that case, what should we do next? A kiss? A hug? Or maybe...

home.caption: 指挥官，我认为视察工作还是需要注重效率的。看~我给你做了些规划，把办公分为四个区域，然后……您说你不是来视察工作的？那……是来见我的吗~？
home.captionEn: Commander, efficiency matters even when conducting inspections. I've come up with some plans for you and divided the office into four sections and... What? You're not here to watch? So... are you here to see me, then?

login.caption: 哎呀，指挥官来视察工作了？我可没有在偷懒，我这叫战略性休息~
login.captionEn: Hm? You here to watch me work? I'm not slacking on the job! This is what's called a strategic break period!

main_1.caption: 指挥官，根据最新研究，穿上制服啊女仆装啊之类的是可以有效提升团队凝聚力的哦，要不要在港区大力推广一下？……至于您的话，当然是想穿什么就穿什么啦~
main_1.captionEn: According to the latest research, wearing matching clothes – uniforms, maid outfits, et cetera – sharply increases team synergy! How about we make it a port-wide thing? You, of course, can wear whatever you want.

main_2.caption: 这个颜色指挥官喜欢么？不喜欢的话，我可以战略性换色！喜欢的话……要不要给您的指甲上也画一个爱心啊~？
main_2.captionEn: Do you like this color? I can strategically change my clothes if you're not a fan, but if you are... want me to paint some hearts on your nails, too?

main_3.caption: 哎呀，指挥官您一定明白“劳逸结合”这个道理的，快点坐下来吧……不过这附近也没有空椅子了……这样，您坐我这，我呢，就坐您腿上，好不好~？
main_3.captionEn: Come on, Commander, you of all people should know how important a work-life balance is! Take a seat already and... Oh, no vacant seats? Alright, then why don't you just take mine and I'll get real comfy on your lap?

touch_body.caption: 您想借用我的工卡？当然可以，您直接拿吧，我手上的指甲油还没干，不是很方便呢~
touch_body.captionEn: You asking to borrow my ID card? Sure thing, although I can't use my hands right now since I'm waiting for my nail polish to dry. Just go ahead and take it by yourself♪

touch_head.caption: 想让我体验被眼罩遮住视线的感觉吗？好像还蛮有趣的~嘿嘿！
touch_head.captionEn: Wear a sleep mask and experience what it's like to have my vision blocked? Sounds interesting. Heehee!

touch_special.caption: 指挥官，我这里可是办公室的视觉死角哦，就算偷偷做些什么，也不会被发现的哦~
touch_special.captionEn: My cubicle is in a bit of a blind spot, so we can get up to anything we want and nobody will ever know!

complete.caption: 指挥官，解决资源不足的问题还要从资金链入手……啊？要先清点物资？唔，战略顾问的工作规划里可没这一项……
complete.captionEn: Commander, if you want to solve a financial difficulty, start by considering how your cash flow... Hm? A goods inspection first of all? Um, that's kind of outside the field of consultancy.

mission.caption: 指挥官，新的任务清单又来了，让我这个专业的战略顾问来帮您合理规划一下吧。
mission.captionEn: Commander, a new mission list has arrived. Allow me, your professional consultant, to provide you with some reasonable solutions!

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，指挥官辛苦了。要不要打把游戏放松一下？……不务正业？这您就不了解了吧，打游戏其实是一种压力释放训练~
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete! Exemplary work, Commander. Why don't we wind down by playing a game? ...You think I play games too much? Tsk-tsk-tsk, you're clearly not in the know. Games are an excellent way of relieving stress!

mail.caption: 我给邮件按照重要程度做了标记哦，总共分成了七种……嗯？标记太多了反而跟没标记一样了？啊这……这其实这是为了锻炼分类能力~
mail.captionEn: I've marked your mail to denote priority and the like! There are seven types in all, and... Hm? There are so many marks that they're effectively useless? Uhh... This is actually just to practice my sorting skills!

wedding.caption: 指挥官，我最近专门研究了很多恋爱心理学呢，您选择我绝对是最优解……至于从哪些方面论证嘛，我现在也说不清楚，毕竟恋爱中产生的苯乙胺会让我的脑子里、我的心里满满的只有你~嘿嘿！
wedding.captionEn: I've been doing a lot of research into the psychology of love, and I think you made the optimum choice by going for me. How can I prove it? Well, right now, I can't! That's because all the love hormones are flooding my head with thoughts of you! Heehee♡

home.caption: 回来了？那就继续吧。我为你精选了几款威士忌，先从哪杯开始呢……？
home.captionEn: Oh, you're back. Let's pick up where we left off. I've selected several brands of whiskey. Which one will you be trying first?

login.caption: 上次……你好像看到我喝醉的样子了吧？那这一次，就换我来观察你喝醉之后的表现吧~？
login.captionEn: You've seen me drunk before, haven't you? Well, now it's time for ME to see YOU drunk.

main_1.caption: 嗯哼？指挥官看着完全没醉啊……那就让我见识下你的本事吧。
main_1.captionEn: Well, well, look who doesn't seem drunk in the slightest. Let's see if you're really made of stronger stuff♪

main_2.caption: 这里的环境不错吧？而且……只有你我的话，就不需要有任何顾忌了哦~
main_2.captionEn: Pretty nice mood in here, don't you think? Also... We're all to ourselves. No need to hold yourself back any longer.

main_3.caption: 听说混着喝不同的酒会更容易醉呢……指挥官千万不要尝试哦？我只需要观察你微醺的状态就足够了~
main_3.captionEn: I've heard drinking several alcohols mixed together gets you wasted easily, but don't even think about trying it. Heh – I'll be happy with just seeing you tipsy.

touch_body.caption: 不知不觉已经靠得这么近了吗？呵呵，这个距离很适合观察哦……
touch_body.captionEn: Seems we got physically close without realizing it... Heh. This is the perfect distance for watching you.

touch_head.caption: 想让我分心吗？没这么简单呢，呵呵~
touch_head.captionEn: Hoping to distract me? Heheh. You're gravely mistaken if you think it'll be that easy.

touch_special.caption: 终于想要展示真实的自己了吗？Nicht schlecht……♪
touch_special.captionEn: So you finally feel like revealing your true self? Nicht schlecht♪

complete.caption: 委托完成了吗，呵呵，那我们就去看看有没有什么有趣的东西吧
complete.captionEn: Commission completed? Let's see if there is anything interesting to report.

mail.caption: 有新邮件呢~呵呵呵
mail.captionEn: There's new mail. Hehe~

mission_complete.caption: 指挥官，有奖励哦——我？没有兴趣
mission_complete.captionEn: Commander, the rewards. My portion? Not interested~

mission.caption: 任务……会有什么新奇的内容吗？
mission.captionEn: Missions... aren't there any interesting ones?
