wedding.caption: ——这就是你给我的答案吗？怎么办好呢……噗，真是笨啊，我的指挥官大人，我早就不是一开始那个对什么都感到空虚的我了，你难道忘了是谁让我改变的吗？
wedding.captionEn: So this is the answer you're giving me? What shall I do? What a dense commander. I have long stopped being the empty person I was before. Did you forget that you were the one who changed me?

complete.caption: 委托好像完成了？她们应该会带新的洗浴用品回来吧……总之就拜托指挥官去帮我看看吧~？
complete.captionEn: A commission's been completed? So that's why they brought a new basket. Anyhow, check this out, Commander!

home.caption: 啊~指挥官进来的时候可以再慢点？地上很滑，别像我一样摔倒了。
home.captionEn: Hey, don't rush your way into the tub. Take it slow so you won't slip like I did.

login.caption: 你来了，可真是帮大忙了，指挥官……下次我肯定不会摔倒的啦，嗯。
login.captionEn: Boy, am I glad you're here, Commander... even if I definitely won't trip again. For sure.

mail.caption: 咦？这里也有指挥官的信……哇啊，要被打湿啦！
mail.captionEn: Huh? What's a letter for you doing in here? Aw crap! It's gonna get soaked!

main_1.caption: 唔、唔唔，这块肥皂是不是产生了太多的泡泡了……得让指挥官帮我把它们都冲干净啊……
main_1.captionEn: Mgh! Hngh! This soap is so bubbly! I'm gonna need your help to wash them away.

main_2.caption: 也不要一直用担忧的眼神看着我嘛，早就不痛了！而且像这样坐着洗好像也蛮舒服的~指挥官要试试吗？
main_2.captionEn: You can stop it with that concerned look already. My rear don't hurt anymore. Also, sitting to wash is pretty comfy – you should give it a try.

main_3.caption: 指挥官还是慢一点比较好哦？不过就算你摔倒了，我也肯定能接住你就是了~
main_3.captionEn: What's the rush, Commander? Take it easy. If you start to trip, I'll catch you.

mission.caption: 任务清单……啊，我差点都忘了。嗯，不过丢进水里打湿就不用管了吧！
mission.captionEn: The mission list? Oh, I almost forgot. What can I say? It got too wet to read.

mission_complete.caption: 让我不用管任务，因为你已经都做完了？……哇！那也就是说，现在可以去领奖励了！
mission_complete.captionEn: It's fine 'cause you finished that mission? Oh. Then someone's gotta go claim the rewards!

touch_body.caption: 是想帮我搓一搓背么？没问题！
touch_body.captionEn: You'll scrub my back? Go on.

touch_head.caption: 嗯？想要给我洗头发么？那交给你了！
touch_head.captionEn: Hm? You wanna wash my hair? Cool. Go right ahead!

touch_special.caption: 指挥官，在这种场合来了兴致？
touch_special.captionEn: Is this the kind of scenario that gets you fired up?

main_4.caption: 海因里希好像叫她自己的铁鱼“小铁”来着……唔，我要不要也给我的起个名字？
main_4.captionEn: You know how Heinrich nicknamed her rigging "Eisen"? I'm thinking about naming mine too.

wedding.caption: 这个的意思是，我们是关系非常非常好的朋友对吧！……比这还要更近一步？唔……那是不是还要再加两个“非常”才够？不管怎样，今后我也会一直在你身边的！我们约好了哦~
wedding.captionEn: Does this mean we're like, super duper besties? ...Even more than that? Huh... Super duper ultra mega besties then? Let's go with that, and promise each other we'll always be together~

home.caption: 啊…终于回来了，我的小指挥官～不知道是太阳的缘故还是“爱”太炽热了…我差点就要被晒干了…
home.captionEn: Ah, you're finally here, little one. I feel like I'm drying out from the heat of the sun and my love...

login.caption: 呼…能感受到从你手中溢出的“爱”呢～比炙热的太阳还要强烈♪
login.captionEn: Mmm... I feel the love slipping between your fingers. It's even hotter than the scorching sun...

main_1.caption: 呼…真想这样直接跳进泳池呢…不过防晒霜会白涂了，再忍耐一下吧♥
main_1.captionEn: *sigh*... I just want to jump in... No, I need to wait, or else the sunscreen will go to waste.

main_2.caption: 嗯？不是刚涂过吗…？指挥官该不会是被热晕了吧？呵呵呵
main_2.captionEn: Hmm? Didn't you just put some on me? Is the heat making you lose your wits, little one? Heehee.

main_3.caption: 累了的话要不要一起躺下来？…说什么太挤了，这种事情用“爱”就能解决哦♥
main_3.captionEn: If you're tired, then lie down with me. Is it too cramped? I'm sure the power of love can fix that little problem♥

mission.caption: 任务…？在这样的烈日下…传播“爱”的道路真是艰难呢
mission.captionEn: Missions? Under the blazing sun? Spreading the word of love is a difficult path...

mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励到了～去找找有没有什么冰凉的东西吧♪
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission rewards~ See if there's anything that can cool me down in there.

touch_body.caption: 现在变得大胆一点也没关系哦？呵呵呵♥
touch_body.captionEn: Be a little bolder, if you want. Heehee♥

touch_special.caption: 那里也要涂…？嗯，“爱”可是要均匀涂抹才行呢♥
touch_special.captionEn: There, too...? Well, love does need to be applied evenly♥

complete.caption: 委托组吗？想必是踏着充满爱的航路归来吧~
complete.captionEn: The commission team? They must be back from their voyage full of love.

touch_head.caption: 呵呵~我的指挥官，应该由我来对您做这种事比较好吧？
touch_head.captionEn: Heehee, oh, you silly little thing – shouldn't it be ME doing this to you?

wedding.caption: 我的指挥官，终于到了我们互相见证爱意的这天啊~那么，就请您为我戴上这爱的证明吧？呵呵……从现在开始，就让我教给您更加深邃和美妙的爱吧~亲·爱·的~
wedding.captionEn: Finally, the day has come for us to acknowledge each other's love. Now, take your proof of love and put it on me. Heehee... Tonight, I'm going to show you a deeper, more wonderful kind of love... darling♥

mail.caption: 有新的信件呢~不来看看吗？这里面说不定有我为您而作的曲谱哦？
mail.captionEn: There's a new letter for you. Aren't you going to read it? There could be a new sheet music in there for you, little one!

home.caption: 外面的世界太吵闹了，对不对？来，到我面前来……让我带给你充满“爱”的寂静……
home.captionEn: Isn't the outside world so noisy? Come to me... and I'll give you silence overflowing with love...

login.caption: 我的指挥官，很寂寞吧……这么晚了还一个人盯着屏幕，看来是真的很需要我的爱抚呢~别害怕，我现在……就出来见你~
login.captionEn: You must have been lonely, little one, staring at a screen so late at night... You must need my love. Don't be afraid... I'm on my way~

main_1.caption: 等了好久……现在终于能从这个小小的屏幕里出来，好好拥抱您了呢~我的指挥官~
main_1.captionEn: After so long... I can finally escape this cramped screen and give you the hugs you need, little one♥

main_2.caption: 唔……又卡住了吗……我最爱的指挥官~能拉我一把吗？但如果您更喜欢我现在这幅样子……呵呵，也可以哦~
main_2.captionEn: Mmh, I'm stuck again... Could you lend me a hand, little one? Or if you like me better this way... heehee, I wouldn't mind.

main_3.caption: 切换频道也没用哦~既然想看点不一样的，那就让您感受下屏幕另一边的风景吧~
main_3.captionEn: It's too late to change the channel now. If you want to see something different... then why don't I show you what's behind the screen?

touch_body.caption: 呵呵~敢这样触碰从屏幕里出来的我，您的胆子……比我想象的还要大呢~
touch_body.captionEn: Heehee, you'd touch an entity that emerged from your screen? You're more daring than I imagined, little one~

touch_head.caption: 我是从很冷、很冷的地方过来的哦，所以……现在的我，也很贪心呢♡
touch_head.captionEn: I came from a place ever so cold... so I have certain "needs" that must be satisfied♥

touch_special.caption: 卡得好紧♡……既然已经这样了，那您想做什么都可以哦~
touch_special.captionEn: Oh nooo, I'm stuck♥ You can do whatever you want to me now~

complete.caption: 委托组吗？想必是踏着充满爱的航路归来吧~
complete.captionEn: The commission team? They must be back from their voyage full of love.

wedding.caption: 我的指挥官，终于到了我们互相见证爱意的这天啊~那么，就请您为我戴上这爱的证明吧？呵呵……从现在开始，就让我教给您更加深邃和美妙的爱吧~亲·爱·的~
wedding.captionEn: Finally, the day has come for us to acknowledge each other's love. Now, take your proof of love and put it on me. Heehee... Tonight, I'm going to show you a deeper, more wonderful kind of love... darling♥

mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励已经送达了吧？呵呵，这就因爱而获得的回报呢~
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission rewards are here? Heehee, sounds like our efforts have been repaid by love.

mission.caption: 还有任务没有完成哦？传播爱的脚步可不能停歇~
mission.captionEn: There's still work to do on these missions. You can't put our preaching of love on the backburner!

mail.caption: 有新的信件呢~不来看看吗？这里面说不定有我为您而作的曲谱哦？
mail.captionEn: There's a new letter for you. Aren't you going to read it? There could be a new sheet music in there for you, little one!

home.caption: 指挥官，现在是您的休息时间吧？打乱计划来陪我练台词不要紧么？……只是想陪陪我？呵~你总是能说出让人意想不到的话呢……
home.captionEn: Commander, isn't it your break time? Are you sure you can change your plans just to help me practice lines? ...You just wanted to be with me? Heh, you always know just how to surprise me...

login.caption: ……唔，光，眼睛……你来了……怎么？今天还是不打算放弃么？……等等、总感觉情绪还是……面对指挥官的时候，语气总会不自觉地变得温和一些……
login.captionEn: Urgh, the light... Ah, you're here. Still haven't given up yet, I presume? Wait, I don't think that came out right. It's hard to be mean when I'm dealing with you.

main_1.caption: 想要瓦解你们的势力数不胜数，又何必在我身上浪费时间？我是不会告诉你我的身份的。
main_1.captionEn: There are a whole lot of people out there who wanna see you dead. Why waste time on little old me? I'll never give you my true identity.

main_2.caption: 仅仅是这种程度的审讯……我想你心里也很清楚，根本不会有任何结果的。
main_2.captionEn: You know your measly interrogation isn't enough. This will amount to nothing.

main_3.caption: 我还是第一次参演电影，和大家一起筹备、一起出演很有趣、也很开心。当然，如果可以的话，我希望不要一直出现因为迟到而打乱计划的现象。
main_3.captionEn: This is my first time being in a movie. It's fun to prepare and perform with everyone. I just wish people would stop being late and disrupting plans.

touch_body.caption: ……没事，我的手不疼，不用解开手铐……这样子会更有临场感、更好入戏……您是在担心我么？
touch_body.captionEn: You can leave the cuffs as they are – they don't hurt. It's easier to get immersed in the role, too... Are you worried about me, Commander?

touch_head.caption: ……很可惜，你无法窥探我脑中的情报，呵呵。
touch_head.captionEn: Too bad for you, you'll never get a look inside my mind. Heh.

touch_special.caption: ……？！即兴表演？！等、等等，我想想该怎么回应……唔嗯///……
touch_special.captionEn: Ack?! Are we ad-libbing?! U-umm, let me think of how to react to this... Hmm...

complete.caption: 委托舰队在预计的时间内回来了，物资清单整理完毕，请您确认。
complete.captionEn: The commission fleet is back on schedule, and their goods have been inspected. Here's the list for your perusal.

mail.caption: 指挥官，现在是您审阅邮件的时间，请尽快开始处理。
mail.captionEn: Commander, it's time to check your mail. Please begin as soon as possible.

mission_complete.caption: 任务提前完成了。那么，剩余的时间就请您好好休息吧。
mission_complete.captionEn: Finished ahead of schedule? Then you've earned a good break until our next assignment.

mission.caption: 指挥官，请尽快完成任务，之后我还给您规划了其他的工作。
mission.captionEn: Commander, please finish your missions soon. Else they'll conflict with other work I have scheduled for you later.

wedding.caption: 指挥官，我曾数次预演过这个场景的每一个细节、每一句话……但此刻站在您面前，我的预演似乎都是多余的……我有太多的话想对您说， 却不知道从何说起……指挥官，请允许我用一生的时间，将这些话一点一点告诉您吧。
wedding.captionEn: I've rehearsed every little word and action of this little moment so many times now, but when I'm faced with you, I realize it was all unnecessary... There are so many things I want to say to you, but I don't know where to start. Commander... Please, let me take my whole lifetime to share it all with you!

complete.caption: 委托组把物资存放完毕后，让她们也来参加宴会吧
complete.captionEn: Once the commission fleet has finished dropping off their supplies, let's invite them to the banquet as well.

home.caption: 就用这杯红酒来慰劳从战场回来的勇士吧
home.captionEn: Let us raise our glasses to the heroes who have returned from battle.

login.caption: 公务都处理完成了吗，指挥官？
login.captionEn: How's your work coming along, Commander?

mail.caption: 即使在最盛大的宴会中，一旦有新的情报也必须马上进入状态，这也是领导者的职责
mail.captionEn: Even at the most lavish banquet, it is your responsibility as commander to be well-informed should the situation change.

main_1.caption: 指挥官，能帮我邀请一下提尔比茨吗？抱歉，我……不知道该怎么亲自去邀请她
main_1.captionEn: Commander, would you invite Tirpitz for me? Apologies, I'm... still not sure how to ask her myself.

main_2.caption: 我只要像这样坐在这里，稍微露出一些笑容，很多人就会心满意足……但那只是因为我是铁血舰队的领导者
main_2.captionEn: I can keep a lot of people satisfied merely by sitting here with a smile... but only because of my status as the fleet leader of the Iron Blood.

main_3.caption: 作为领导者，有时候不得不说一些违心的话，做一些违心的事……指挥官，永远不要忘了自己是谁
main_3.captionEn: As a leader, I must sometimes say and do things that I do not believe in. Commander, I hope you never lose sight of who you are.

mission.caption: 还有没完成的事的话，酒也会变得乏味，你说对吧，指挥官？
mission.captionEn: Having unfinished work will turn even the finest wine into vinegar. Isn't that right, Commander?

mission_complete.caption: 用这些来装点宴会吗，有劳了
mission_complete.captionEn: A decoration for the banquet? Splendid work.

touch_body.caption: 舞蹈……？……不，我并不是在拒绝，只是，过去从来没有人邀请过我
touch_body.captionEn: A dance...? Oh, no, I wouldn't turn one down, I just haven't been asked until now...

touch_special.caption: 指、指挥官，不要故意逗我……
touch_special.captionEn: C-Commander... don't tease me like that...

touch_head.caption: 这顶帽子和我的制服一样，都是荣耀的象征。
touch_head.captionEn: This hat and this uniform both are symbols of glory.

wedding.caption: …指挥官…这种时候我该露出什么表情比较好？——微笑……吗？
wedding.captionEn: ... Commander, what kind of expression should I have at a time like this? I should... just smile?

complete.caption: 委托组就辛苦指挥官迎接了，我现在恐怕……
complete.captionEn: Please receive the commission team on my behalf. Dressed like this, well...

home.caption: 辛苦了，指挥官。在稍作休息之后，可以帮我一点小忙么？
home.captionEn: Outstanding work, Commander. Take a break, then once you're done, could you help me here?

login.caption: 当着你的面“包装礼物”……会不会有些太奇怪了？
login.captionEn: Wrapping myself up right in front of you... It's rather odd, don't you think?

mail.caption: 邮件和贺卡一起送来的吗？
mail.captionEn: Did your letter come with a seasonal greeting card?

main_1.caption: 我是喝了一点。毕竟这样的事情，我也是第一次做……想着也许这样能让我表现得更自然一些，或者更“勇敢”一些……？
main_1.captionEn: I'll admit, I've had a little to drink. It's my first time doing something like this, and a bit of alcohol helps me feel more natural and empowered, I suppose?

main_2.caption: 难得有这样给你准备惊喜的机会，如果刚刚没有不小心弄出声响，现在应该是截然不同的局面吧……
main_2.captionEn: This was my chance to give you a surprise... If only I hadn't made that noise, this would've gone very differently.

main_3.caption: 很在意这身衣服么？嗯……毕竟是礼物，你能喜欢真是再好不过了。
main_3.captionEn: Do you like this outfit? As long as you like it, it has done its job as a present.

mission.caption: 把需要处理的任务也分给我一些吧，完成得越快，剩下能享受节日的时间就越多。
mission.captionEn: Share the burden of your unfinished missions with me. The sooner they're done, the longer we can enjoy this holiday.

mission_complete.caption: 嗯……不知道这次任务的奖励，会不会比平常更丰厚？
mission_complete.captionEn: Is it just me, or are our rewards better than usual?

touch_body.caption: 需要我帮你一起拆礼物么？
touch_body.captionEn: Do you want my help with the unwrapping?

touch_head.caption: 如果这是作为帮忙系头发的交换……摸吧。
touch_head.captionEn: Consider this a thank-you for tying up my hair.

touch_special.caption: 虽说是未完成的圣诞惊喜，但既然你很满意的话……
touch_special.captionEn: Although my present turned out half-baked, as long as you're happy with it...

wedding.caption: …指挥官…这种时候我该露出什么表情比较好？——微笑……吗？
wedding.captionEn: ... Commander, what kind of expression should I have at a time like this? I should... just smile?

home.caption: 喜欢这个为你量身定制的美梦吗，指挥官阁下？……那就让这梦延续下去吧~
home.captionEn: Do you like the dream I made just for you, Commander? Heehee, then let's continue...

login.caption: 你终于来了，指挥官阁下~那就让我们一同……开启这场美梦吧~
login.captionEn: If it isn't you, Commander♪ Shall we begin our wonderful dream together?

main_1.caption: 逆位的梦魔，倒悬的美梦……这是一个摒弃道德、接纳诅咒，只为让你我投身欲望而存在的世界。
main_1.captionEn: An upside-down succubus for an upside-down world... One where we can cast aside morality, accept this sweet curse, and indulge in our mutual desire forever...

main_2.caption: 猩红的月亮诞下堕落的诗篇，呵呵，如此甘美的幻象……真是让人无法自持。
main_2.captionEn: The blood moon's ode to depravity... Hehe, such a wonderful illusion. I don't know if I can hold myself back for much longer♡

main_3.caption: 亲爱的阁下……再稍微忍耐一下吧，很快的，很快……我就能抵达你身边~
main_3.captionEn: Beloved Commander, you have to hold on just a little longer. Soon... Soon, I will be right by your side♥

touch_body.caption: 阁下想好要如何款待饥肠辘辘的梦魔了吗~？
touch_body.captionEn: How will you entertain this hungry succubus, Commander?

touch_head.caption: 害怕我掉下去？呵呵别担心，梦魔不仅有“翅膀”，还可以用尾巴紧紧缠住你哦，阁下~
touch_head.captionEn: Are you worried that I'll fall? Heehee, don't be. I have wings to fly with – and a tail to coil tightly around you, as well.

touch_special.caption: 呵呵……多谢款待，亲爱的~♪
touch_special.captionEn: Heehee... I'll have my fill of you before long, my beloved♥

complete.caption: 委托队回来了。相关后勤工作已经安排好了，接下来就该去慰问辛苦的同僚们了呢。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned. I've made the logistical arrangements, so all that's left is for you to welcome our weary friends.

mail.caption: 需要我来为你筛选邮件吗？那我可能会把某些措辞暧昧的来信悄悄藏起来哦~
mail.captionEn: Shall I screen your mail for you? Just understand that if I see anything "suggestive" in there, I might end up hiding it♪

mission.caption: 阁下，那些未完成的任务，就像舞会上等待邀约的淑女呢。可别冷落得太久哦？
mission.captionEn: Commander, you must understand that unfinished work is like ladies at a ball, waiting for you to invite them to dance. One mustn't keep them waiting.

mission_complete.caption: 任务顺利完成了呢。让我们举杯庆祝此刻吧~
mission_complete.captionEn: The missions are complete. Shall we raise a glass in celebration?

wedding.caption: ……我是个掠食者，亲爱的阁下。如果你愿意奉上鲜血，愿意让我顺着跳动的脉搏直抵你的心脏……我也愿意与你一同坠入这黑色的迷梦，直至永恒。
wedding.captionEn: Dear silly Commander of mine, you ought to know by now that I'M the one who pursues. If you'll offer your blood unto me and let me trace it all the way back to your beating heart... then I promise that I will plunge alongside you into this eternal dream♥

home.caption: 指挥官，就在店里好好感受一下我们的服务吧。当然，我会如实记录你的反馈。
home.captionEn: Commander, get a feel for the service in our shop. Naturally, I will take notes of your feedback.

login.caption: 上下班必须打卡、禁止迟到早退。——啊，指挥官，这不是说给你听的。
login.captionEn: Punch the clock when you start and finish work. Be on time, and don't leave early... Oh, Commander. That wasn't aimed at you.

main_1.caption: 我这样会吓到其他同伴？嗯……作为这里的店长，如果适度的强硬能让店内的同伴在服务指挥官这件事上更有章法的话，我不介意再强硬一些。
main_1.captionEn: I'm scaring people, you say? Well... As the manager, I don't at all mind being strict if it can better your experience at our shop.

main_2.caption: 多亏有俾斯麦阁下分享之前开店的经验，让我轻松了不少。等到回去的时候，需要和她好好道谢了。
main_2.captionEn: The experience Lord Bismarck imparted unto me has made my job significantly easier. I must thank her when I get the chance.

main_3.caption: 随意食用后厨备品、指挥官忙于工作无法前来就索性下班……诸如此类的问题层出不穷，该制订一套严格的店规约束大家了。
main_3.captionEn: Stealing food from the kitchen, leaving work early when they see you're not coming... Such terrible work ethics. It's high time I established a set of strict rules for the employees.

mission.caption: 果然又有任务么，这次我会帮你处理的。当然，你也不能拖沓。
mission.captionEn: Another mission. I will help you with it. You cannot afford to be lazy.

touch_head.caption: 这对耳朵看起来不太像兔子？嗯……
touch_head.captionEn: These ears don't look like rabbit ears to you? I see...

touch_special.caption: 指挥官，我欣赏你的勇气……
touch_special.captionEn: I do admire your bravery, but...

complete.caption: 军事委托已完成，指挥官，开始处理委托报告吧。
complete.captionEn: A commission has been completed. You should begin writing that report.

mission_complete.caption: 任务准时圆满完成了，做得很好，指挥官。
mission_complete.captionEn: You got it done on time, did you? Good work.

mail.caption: 指挥官，准时收件才能确保内容的时效性，不要忘了查看邮件。
mail.captionEn: Only by reading your letters can you guarantee the timeliness of their contents, Commander.

touch_body.caption: 指挥官，现在还不是休息的时间。打起精神来，工作还没有结束！
touch_body.captionEn: Now is not the time for rest. At attention! Your service has not concluded!

wedding.caption: 把我约到这里来，你想做什么已经一目了然。指挥官，我愿意接受这份誓约。你知道的，很多情感我都无法付诸于口。所以帮我戴上它吧，指挥官，这就是我的回答了。
wedding.captionEn: I already know why you summoned me here. I will gladly take this vow. As you surely know, I have many feelings that I struggle to put into words. Put this ring on my finger – how my hand trembles is my answer to your question.

home.caption: 从您身上……我听到了海水、阳光与风的声音……请到水幕后面，让我帮您……更换衣物吧？「☆(>o<)」
home.captionEn: I hear the sounds of the sea, sun, and wind coming from you... Come closer and let me help you get changed... [☆(>o<)]

login.caption: 哼哼~♪……嗯？您来了……您愿意……和我一起听……水幕温柔的声音么……？
login.captionEn: Hum hum♪... Hmm? Commander... Would you like to listen to the water with me?

main_1.caption: 嘘……这样……水声，还有您压抑的呼吸声……我都清晰地……收录了……
main_1.captionEn: Hush. The sound of the water... and your stifled breathing... I've got it now.

main_2.caption: 指挥官……宝物，不会自己浮出水面……不过……可以为你例外一次「o(*//▿//*)q」
main_2.captionEn: Commander... Treasures don't normally surface on their own, but this time, I'll make an exception for you... [o(*//▿//*)q]

main_3.caption: 水有些凉……但指挥官的手……很温暖……抱……「抱我，快抱紧我>w< 」
main_3.captionEn: The water is chilly, but your hands are warm... Hold me. [Hold me suuuper tight! >w<]

main_4.caption: 指挥官……您专注的，是这流动的水幕……还是我无法隐藏的……心跳声呢？「o(*//▿//*)q」
main_4.captionEn: Commander, are you more focused on the water curtain... or the sound of my heart? [o(*//▿//*)q]

mission.caption: 时……时间到了……我们……该做正事了……「o(*//▿//*)q」
mission.captionEn: I-it's time... We'd better get to business soon... [o(*//▿//*)q]

mission_complete.caption: 奖励……指挥官想怎么领……都可以的「o(*//▿//*)q」
mission_complete.captionEn: You can claim your rewards... however you like, Commander... [o(*//▿//*)q]

touch_body.caption: 是这里的衣服……没有穿好嘛……？「☆(>o<)」
touch_body.captionEn: Did I not put this on right...? [☆(>o<)]

touch_head.caption: 有指挥官帮我……就不会在换衣服的时候，夹到头发了……「>w<」
touch_head.captionEn: Since you're here... I won't have to worry about my hair getting caught while I change clothes... [>w<]

touch_special.caption: 唔……指挥官的……手……嗯~伸过来了……
touch_special.captionEn: Mmm... Your hand reached me... Phew...

complete.caption: 是归航时的笛声……要我陪您，去收录重逢之音么？
complete.captionEn: The sound of the homecoming horn... Should I go with you to record your reunion?

mail.caption: 无用的杂音已过滤……指挥官……「快看看剩下的邮件>w<」
mail.captionEn: I canceled out all that extra noise, Commander... [Time to check your mail! >w<]

wedding.caption: 我说……“我愿意”……现在起，就连和您在一起时的沉默，也将交由我来保管。谁都无法删除……直到永远……永远……
wedding.captionEn: Yes... [I do!] From now on, even the shared silence between us... will be all mine. Nobody can ever erase it... It'll be safe forever.

home.caption: 你看起来满脸疲惫呢，来，乖乖躺在我身边，稍微休息一会吧。
home.captionEn: You look tired. Come, come. Lie down with me and rest.

login.caption: 呵呵……看起来在夏夜结束之前，你都会每天来找我的，对吗？我的孩子。
login.captionEn: Heehee... Will you come and visit me every night until the end of summer, my dear child?

main_1.caption: 你也想品尝樱桃？很好，我的孩子，我喜欢你的这份率直，那么作为奖励……我会亲自送入你的口中。
main_1.captionEn: Do you want cherries? ...Heehee, I'm so glad you're honest, my child. As a reward... I'll feed you, just like this.

main_2.caption: 不要惧怕冒犯或是惹怒我，直接说出你的索求，我会满足与你。
main_2.captionEn: Don't be afraid of spoiling my mood or angering me. Just tell me what you desire – it's my duty to satisfy that.

main_3.caption: 也许偶尔也当让理性多作休息……毕竟是如此美丽的夏夜，此刻我只想让你在我怀中撒娇，我的孩子……
main_3.captionEn: Sometimes, it's good to give our rational mind a break. My only desire... is to pamper you in my arms on this beautiful summer night, my child.

touch_body.caption: 渴望肌肤的温热？可以哦，我的孩子。
touch_body.captionEn: Do you wish to feel my warmth? But of course, my dear child.

touch_head.caption: 你似乎很喜欢这简单的发型变化呢，我的孩子……
touch_head.captionEn: You really like this hairstyle, don't you, my child?

touch_special.caption: 呵呵……满足孩子的求知欲，也是我的责任呢……
touch_special.captionEn: Heehee... It's my job to sate your intellectual thirst...

complete.caption: 要好好欢迎认真完成了委托的孩子们哟
complete.captionEn: We must properly praise the girls who have returned from their commissions.

mail.caption: 那么，我来唱给你听吧
mail.captionEn: Shall I sing the contents of this message for you?

mission.caption: 无论想要什么，我都可以帮你拿到
mission.captionEn: My child, no matter what it is that you desire, I can help you obtain it.

mission_complete.caption: 那么，想要什么奖励呢？
mission_complete.captionEn: Now then, what kind of reward would you like?

wedding.caption: 以后，悲伤也好、喜悦也好、痛苦也好、欢愉也好，无论发生什么，都来依靠我吧，我会一直、一直理解你、包容你、支持你的喔……
wedding.captionEn: From now on, I shall share everything with you - your sorrow, your joy, your pain, and your pleasure. My child, I will always, always welcome you into my embrace...

home.caption: 回来了吗，我的孩子。只差最后一步，就能获得我为你准备的红包……大胆尝试吧。
home.captionEn: Welcome back, my child. Soon, you will have your own red envelope... Go on. Reach out your hand, if you dare.

login.caption: 门外似乎响起了欢快的乐曲呢……呵呵，来我身边，我们一同感受这份欢愉吧~
login.captionEn: I hear cheery music playing outside... Hehe, come, my child. Let's share in the mirth together.

main_1.caption: 红包里是什么？呵呵~你的内心深处渴求什么，里面就是什么哦。
main_1.captionEn: What's in the envelope? One could say... it's your deepest, most heartfelt desire.

main_2.caption: 今夜的布置，喜欢吗？喜欢的话，又该对我说些什么呢？当然，是“谢谢”之外的话哦~
main_2.captionEn: Do you like the decorations tonight? Hehe, then isn't there something you should say? Something other than "thank you," of course.

main_3.caption: 啊~今夜，就让我们合奏这美妙的乐曲吧……
main_3.captionEn: Ah... Let's play a beautiful serenade together on this night, my child.

touch_body.caption: 要享受获得奖励的过程？呵呵，说的不错……
touch_body.captionEn: You'd like to savor the process of being rewarded this time? Heehee, fine by me...

touch_head.caption: 奖励不在这里呢，呵呵……
touch_head.captionEn: Your reward isn't here, heehee...

touch_special.caption: 没错，就是这里……让我们共同庆贺你的成长吧，我的孩子。
touch_special.captionEn: Yes, that's the spot... Let us celebrate your growth together, my sweet child.

complete.caption: 要好好欢迎认真完成了委托的孩子们哟
complete.captionEn: We must properly praise the girls who have returned from their commissions.

mail.caption: 那么，我来唱给你听吧
mail.captionEn: Shall I sing the contents of this message for you?

mission.caption: 无论想要什么，我都可以帮你拿到
mission.captionEn: My child, no matter what it is that you desire, I can help you obtain it.

mission_complete.caption: 那么，想要什么奖励呢？
mission_complete.captionEn: Now then, what kind of reward would you like?

wedding.caption: 以后，悲伤也好、喜悦也好、痛苦也好、欢愉也好，无论发生什么，都来依靠我吧，我会一直、一直理解你、包容你、支持你的喔……
wedding.captionEn: From now on, I shall share everything with you - your sorrow, your joy, your pain, and your pleasure. My child, I will always, always welcome you into my embrace...

home.caption: 你……一直忙碌到现在？真是不容易啊，赶快来休息吧。
home.captionEn: Have you been working this whole time? Goodness. Get over here and relax already.

login.caption: 呼……要我为你腾个位置吗？
login.captionEn: Phew... Want me to scooch over for you?

main_1.caption: 茶叶与黑咖啡……虽说口感完全不同，但在许多地方上却有着异曲同工之处呢。尤其是在传统的沏茶方式中也不会加入糖和牛奶这一点。
main_1.captionEn: Tea and black coffee... Entirely different flavors, but many shared aspects. For example, traditional tea doesn't include sugar or milk.

main_2.caption: 希佩尔似乎对这件衣服的款式很是在意，之前一直在盯着看……指挥官，之后要不要也给她准备一件？
main_2.captionEn: I think Hipper was interested in this dress. She was staring an awful lot... Should I have one made for her, too?

main_3.caption: 虽然位置有些窄，但努力一下的话，想要躺下两个人也不是不可以。所以……要上来吗？
main_3.captionEn: It is a little cramped, but if we try hard enough, we could both sleep here. So... Want to lie down with me?

mission_complete.caption: 任务的奖励……一会再拿也没关系，现在还是休息时间呢。
mission_complete.captionEn: Your mission rewards... Bah, they can wait. You're on break right now, after all!

touch_body.caption: 鞋子掉下去了……什么时候？
touch_body.captionEn: My shoe fell off? When in the world...

touch_head.caption: 摸起来感觉……怎么样呢？
touch_head.captionEn: How does it, umm... feel?

touch_special.caption: 等、等等！非要现在么……？
touch_special.captionEn: H-hold on! Does it have to be right now...?

complete.caption: 失陪了，我去迎接一下委托归来的她们。
complete.captionEn: The girls who went on commissions are returning. I'll be leaving my seat for a bit.

mail.caption: 有新的信件，你该不会忘了吧？
mail.captionEn: There's new mail. There's no way you've forgotten, right?

mission.caption: 难道你要把这些任务一直留着吗？
mission.captionEn: Are you going to neglect all the missions?

wedding.caption: 对我来说，存在的意义早已不再停留于战斗。我的存在，我的命运，早已经和你紧紧地系在了一起了呢。我的心永远属于你，我的指挥官。
wedding.captionEn: My existence is no longer just about battle. My life and fate have already been tied to yours. My beloved Commander, I henceforth pledge my heart to you for the rest of eternity.

complete.caption: 委托完成了哦。去吧，别冷落了在节日还在辛苦付出的同伴们。
complete.captionEn: That commission is done. Now go. Those girls deserve some appreciation for working on a holiday.

home.caption: 叱咤海洋的猛兽，也有需要休息的时刻。正好屋内有静心养神的香薰，到我身边来好好坐会吧？
home.captionEn: Even lords of the sea need to rest. Why don't you sit down and enjoy the soothing aroma in the air?

login.caption: 回来了？呵呵，是想我了么？还是只是单纯的累了？
login.captionEn: You're back. Heheh, missed me, did you? Or are you just tired?

main_1.caption: 毛笔……应该怎么握来着？这样？还是……这样？嗯……我知道你会这个，别光看着了，快来教教我！
main_1.captionEn: How does one hold a brush? Like this? Or like... this? Ugh... I refuse to believe you don't know the proper technique. Stop gawking and come show me!

main_2.caption: 原来“舞龙”是这样的啊……当初听到这个名字时，我还以为要弄一个像铁血舰装那样“龙”呢。
main_2.captionEn: So that's what their dragon dance is like... When I first heard of it, I thought they would use a dragon-like rigging, similar to what we have in the Iron Blood.

main_3.caption: 布伦希尔德，这些是你收藏的东煌古玩么。这个碗确实做工精致……你的品位还挺不错的。
main_3.captionEn: Brünhilde, is this bowl an Empery antique of yours? I must admit, the workmanship is remarkable. Hmph, I suppose you do have a refined taste.

mission.caption: 正值佳节时，指挥官却因任务而无法抽身……这种事情我可不允许，我也来帮你一把好了。
mission.captionEn: All these missions leave you with no time to enjoy the holiday... That is unacceptable. Hmph, I'll assist you with them.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了，接下来就该专心享受节日了。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. You may now concentrate on celebrating.

touch_body.caption: 要出去走走吗？好啊。那就帮我把鞋子穿上吧？
touch_body.captionEn: Go on a stroll together, you say? I could do that... But first, put my heels on my feet, would you?

touch_head.caption: 喂，角上的挂饰不是拿来玩的！
touch_head.captionEn: Don't you touch my horn ornaments without my permission!

touch_special.caption: 等，等一下？！都怪你，墨汁沾到上面了……我，我自己擦就行了！！
touch_special.captionEn: Wha–?! You made me spill ink everywhere! I, I'll clean it up myself!

mail.caption: 来自远方的信件…姑且还是看看吧。
mail.captionEn: A letter has arrived from afar. Read it, would you?

wedding.caption: 誓约的证明？你喜欢这种形式上的东西吗？那样的话…不光是形式上的，我会给你更多实际上的束缚…呵呵呵，不如现在就让你见识一下吧~
wedding.captionEn: A symbol of our marriage? You must adore having proof of the ties that bind you to me. Prepare to double down, then. I'll find something that binds you to me. Physically... Hahaha! You shall see what I mean.

complete.caption: 物资送来了哦，要去清点吗？
complete.captionEn: Commission rewards have arrived. Are you going to examine the haul?

home.caption: 累了？想在这里休息吗？呵呵，那我就起身吧……嗯？我的鞋子，掉到哪里去了？
home.captionEn: Tired? Do you want to sit upon this couch? Hah, I don't mind giving it up for... Hm? Where have my shoes gone?

login.caption: 难得风平浪静又没人打扰，好好享受此刻的清闲吧。
login.captionEn: The seas have calmed, and no one can disturb us here. You should enjoy this moment of respite to its fullest.

main_1.caption: 哦？想跟我喝一杯吗？难得这么主动……嗯？你给我喝的什么东西？……酸奶？……健康？ 没有别的喝的了吗！
main_1.captionEn: Oh? You want to have a drink with me? You're forthcoming, for once... Probiotic yogurt? Because it's good for your health? Come on, you must have something better than that!

main_2.caption: 这房间里还挺暖和的，把外套脱掉吧……你……也要脱吗？！
main_2.captionEn: It's warming up in here. Perhaps I should take off my jacket... O-oh, you're taking yours off, too?

main_3.caption: 你也想坐在这吗？沙发这么小，挤不下的……什、什么？！
main_3.captionEn: You want to sit next to me, do you? There's too little room for the both of us to... Hey!

mission.caption: 明明是休息时间却还有任务么？我帮你吧，赶紧完成。
mission.captionEn: Are you really hell-bent on doing missions during your break time? I'll give you a hand, so get them done quickly.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，来喝一杯放松一下吧！啊……可惜，这里只有些过家家的饮品。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Now let us pour some drinks and get comfortable! Oh... A shame we only have drinks suited for children.

touch_body.caption: 要我把外套借给你吗？
touch_body.captionEn: Wish to borrow my jacket?

touch_head.caption: ……嗯？想做什么？
touch_head.captionEn: Hm? What are you doing?

touch_special.caption: ……又来？！就算没有其他人，也不要一直……
touch_special.captionEn: Again?! You don't need to keep doing this just because we're alone...

mail.caption: 来自远方的信件…姑且还是看看吧。
mail.captionEn: A letter has arrived from afar. Read it, would you?

wedding.caption: 誓约的证明？你喜欢这种形式上的东西吗？那样的话…不光是形式上的，我会给你更多实际上的束缚…呵呵呵，不如现在就让你见识一下吧~
wedding.captionEn: A symbol of our marriage? You must adore having proof of the ties that bind you to me. Prepare to double down, then. I'll find something that binds you to me. Physically... Hahaha! You shall see what I mean.

home.caption: 我就知道，你还会回来的，呵呵……即便是你，也无法逃出“魔女”的掌控。
home.captionEn: I knew you would return. Heehee... Not even you can escape the Unhulde's clutches.

login.caption: 很好，我的使魔，你又一次分毫不差地来到了我面前……夜宴的唯二主角都已到达，群星也因为你的到来而闪耀起来了。
login.captionEn: You revealed yourself at the appropriate time. Such an obedient little familiar... Now that the banquet's guests of honor are here, the stars have begun to shine for you.

main_1.caption: 你忘了吗？想要和“魔女”共舞，必须先履行邀约仪式。看来，我的使魔有些心急了呢。
main_1.captionEn: Have you forgotten? In order to dance with the Unhulde, you must first make the appropriate preparations. It seems my familiar is a touch impatient.

main_2.caption: 我今天的礼服，很美？与其赞美衣物，不如将目光投向更值得关注的目标，如何？呵呵~
main_2.captionEn: My dress is beautiful, you say? Shouldn't those eyes of yours be focusing on something more valuable than my attire? Heehee.

main_3.caption: 今晚，你的表现让我很满意。作为奖励，这支舞……由你决定何时结束。
main_3.captionEn: I am satisfied with you tonight. You may have this dance as a reward... I ask that you decide when it ends.

mission.caption: 任务没有完成的话，仪式可没法继续呢。
mission.captionEn: The ceremony cannot continue until you are finished with your "missions."

touch_body.caption: 手腕用力，再搂紧我一些……对，就是这样。
touch_body.captionEn: You will put more tension into those arms and hold me tightly... that's right. Very good.

touch_special.caption: 这里是“魔女”的花园，你做什么都没用哦。
touch_special.captionEn: Do what you will in the Unhulde's garden. It won't make a difference.

mail.caption: 新的邮件，尽快阅读吧。
mail.captionEn: There's a letter for you. I command you to read it at once.

complete.caption: 委托组的伙伴们回来了哦，该做点什么，你应该知道的吧？
complete.captionEn: Your commission team underlings have returned. You know what to do now, yes?

touch_head.caption: 想用这种方式向我表示抗议吗？
touch_head.captionEn: Are you... disobeying me?

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成。恭喜你，又往那迷人而危险的高峰前进了一小步。
mission_complete.captionEn: "Mission" complete. Congratulations. Another small step towards that alluring, dangerous climax.

wedding.caption: 没想到，你会亲手给你赢过我的可能性判处死刑…也好，你就在这名为“爱”的牢笼里，继续反抗我吧。就这样作为取悦我的存在，永远的在我身边吧，“亲爱的”——
wedding.captionEn: So you seized the chance to subjugate me first. Yes, you are at your brightest when you kick and scream in the cage known as love. Allow yourself to be bound to me and amuse me for all eternity... Darling.

home.caption: 契约者，你错过了不少“风景”呢~不过，你要是愿意乖乖接受惩罚……我可以再给你一次机会~
home.captionEn: Heh. You missed all sorts of "views." If you'll obediently accept your punishment, then I will give you one more chance.

login.caption: 你来早了~契约者，现在还是热身时间呢……怎么，已经迫不及待地想要欣赏了吗？
login.captionEn: You're early, Contract Binder. I'm still warming up. Oh, are you unable to endure the wait?

main_1.caption: 看得口干舌燥了？呵呵，水壶就在那边，你不自己去喝，是想让我喂你吗？
main_1.captionEn: Has watching me made you thirsty? Heehee. There's water right beside you, yet you haven't even had a sip. Are you saying you want me to quench your thirst?

main_2.caption: 你的目光让我很受用哦，契约者~不过，刚才只是热身，接下来……就用你的身体，成为我表演的道具吧~
main_2.captionEn: The look in your eyes pleases me, Contract Binder, but I'm still only warming up. For the next part, you'll use your body to aid with my dance.

main_3.caption: 哦~？还不愿意认输吗……看来我要拿出真本事了呢，契约者~
main_3.captionEn: Oh? Still not ready to admit defeat, I see. Then I'd better go all-out for you, Contract Binder♥

touch_body.caption: 呵呵，你碰到我了呢~如果不想输的话，就要好、好、忍、住哦~
touch_body.captionEn: Heh. You touched me. If you don't want to lose, you'd better keep it in as best you can.

touch_head.caption: 呵呵，想要我俯下身吗~别忘了，我现在可在“上位”——
touch_head.captionEn: Heheh. You want me to bow? Do remember: I'm the one on top right now.

touch_special.caption: 输得很彻底呢，契约者……接下来，我就要支配你去做些有趣的事情了哦~♡
touch_special.captionEn: You've been roundly defeated, Contract Binder... Next, I will take control of you and amuse myself to my heart's content♡

complete.caption: 委托的物资送到了？交给其他人去做吧。你没有时间做到任何事都亲力亲为。
complete.captionEn: Commission goods have arrived? Have someone else handle it. Doing everything by yourself is a waste of your limited time.

mission.caption: 去完成你该完成的事吧，契约者。我当然指的是那些任务。
mission.captionEn: Do what you must do, Contract Binder... I'm referring to your missions.

mail.caption: 契约者，早点查看信箱。这种事情不该由人提醒你。
mail.captionEn: Read your letter sooner rather than later, Contract Binder. I shouldn't have to point this out to you.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了。对着如此小事就盼望着对方有所回报，我记得并没有和这样的家伙签订契约吧？
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. I don't remember making a contract with a human who grows excited over measly rewards, and yet here you are.

wedding.caption: 不满足于现有的契约，妄图用更进一步的手段将我束缚？契约者，你的胆子真的是越来越大了。好啊，我就如你所愿，答应你的请求。以及，接下来就做好随时被我吃掉的准备吧，呵呵呵～
wedding.captionEn: Our current contract isn't enough for you, and you want to take it even further? How cocksure you've become, Contract Binder... I shall grant your wish and give you what you desire. That is, if your body and soul are ready for the indulgence that is to come.

home.caption: 欢迎回来，打得漂亮！本小姐用烙印赋予你的力量，是不是足以征服一切呢~
home.captionEn: Splendid! You fought well! The power granted by my brand lets you conquer everything, doesn't it?

login.caption: 欢迎来到本小姐的匿名俱乐部，魔王——感谢您应我的呼唤而来~现在，就请好好记住这份灼热的疼痛吧~
login.captionEn: Welcome to my shop of refreshments, Imperator. I'm glad you answered my call. Now, let this searing pain leave a mark on your memory!

main_1.caption: 欢迎来到我的领域，我的魔王！接下来，请尽情享受吧~这蚀骨销魂的痛楚——也能让你体会到飞行的快乐！
main_1.captionEn: Welcome to my domain! Now come and revel in this pain that gnaws at the soul; in this pleasure that sends you to the heavens!

main_2.caption: 嗯？你怎么拿着记号——烙印之刻？……你也想为本小姐刻下烙印？那就允许你放肆一番吧——等、等等！大腿内侧不可以！好痒~！！
main_2.captionEn: Hm? Why do you have a marker pe– I mean, a Branding Mark? Do you seriously mean to brand me? I'd love to see you try to– W-wait! Not my thigh! It tickles like mad!

main_3.caption: 鞭子？哦，你说这个？本小姐握住它时，就感受到一股神秘的魔力涌进了我的身体……挥动之时充满了气势~喏，给，你也尝试一下这份力量吧！
main_3.captionEn: The whip? Oh, you mean this? Yes, I felt a tremendous power flow into me the moment I took it in hand. I feel an even greater power when I swing it! Go on, you give it a try as well!

mission.caption: 我的魔王，该继续履行你应尽的责任了~在刻下烙印之前，先搞定那些任务吧！
mission.captionEn: Go, my Imperator, and realize your duty! Complete your missions before I imprint my brand upon you!

mission_complete.caption: 搞定了？速度很快嘛，看来是迫不及待地想要接受本小姐的烙印了嘛~！
mission_complete.captionEn: You're finished? That was rather quick. Are you that excited to receive my brand?

touch_body.caption: 就算你不再抵触我的烙印，现在也已经晚了……啊？你早就想这么做了？
touch_body.captionEn: Even if you'd welcome receiving my brand, it's too late to– Huh? You wanted my brand since the very start?

touch_head.caption: 嗯~还是想加深我们之间的烙印吗！
touch_head.captionEn: Oh? Do you want my brand more deeply imprinted on you?

touch_special.caption: 呜……这宛如直冲云霄般的快感，究竟是——唔！
touch_special.captionEn: Agh... Why does this pleasure feel like being launched skyward?!

complete.caption: 执行委托任务的同伴回来了，有没有给本小姐带“暗夜纵行之翼”的魔法配件啊？
complete.captionEn: The girls that went on a commission are back. Perhaps they've brought magic components for my Midnight Wings with them?

mail.caption: 是“魔女飞行之夜”的邀请函到了嘛？！接收~！起飞！
mail.captionEn: Is this an invitation to the Night of Witches' Flight? Consider it accepted. Off we go!

wedding.caption: 指挥官，作为灵魂契合之人，此后……本小姐的魔女之力将带你遨游每个夜晚，也会为你沸腾整个黑夜——这是来自“夜之魔女”的、名为永恒的咒言。
wedding.captionEn: Commander, our souls are drawn to one another... Every night from this day on, I will bring you on a journey through the skies, and I will make the dark night dance for you until morning comes. This is the Nachthexe's everlasting spell.

main_4.caption: 今晚的港区还是没有什么活动安排呢……看来夜之魔女的飞行派对可以继续了哦！今天就让摇滚乐队来助兴吧……哈哈，本小姐要继续准备飞行表演了！
main_4.captionEn: Seeing as the port has no notable events planned for tonight, it seems the airborne gatherings that I host can continue! I could bring in a rock band for tonight's climax... Ahahaha! I must continue preparing for the flying show!

complete.caption: 委托队的孩子们好像回来了哦，在迎接完她们之后，再继续我们的沉浸式介绍吧~？
complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. Let's get back to this after we've welcomed them, okay?

home.caption: 劳顿的旅人，你现在一定累了吧？这里的床温暖柔软，我允许你不必拘礼，可以在这里尽情休息。
home.captionEn: You must be tired from your journey. Don't be afraid~ There's a soft, fluffy bed with your name on it right here.

login.caption: 哎呀，是你？看来风沙也阻止不了命定之人来到我的身边呢~
login.captionEn: Oh, it's you. Heehee, even the winds and sands can't stop my destined partner's arrival.

mail.caption: 有新的来信哦~会不会是邀请你启程的信呢……
mail.captionEn: You've got new mail... A call to new adventure, perhaps?

main_1.caption: 虽然一路走来见识了不少瑰丽的景致，但您也一定需要一个宁静安详的隐世天堂……也许这里就是让你卸下重担的地方哦。
main_1.captionEn: I know you've seen much in your travels, but surely you must need a peaceful place of rest. Maybe here is the place for you to unload your burdens.

main_2.caption: 如果指挥官觉得这样的介绍有些乏味，那我们可以一边下棋一边聊天，或者让我为你烹饪一些我新学到的独具特色的佳肴……“烹饪就不用了”？欸——
main_2.captionEn: If you find this exposition plain, then why don't we do it over a game or an exotic meal... Oh? You don't want my cooking? Aww, but why?

main_3.caption: 这里的一切都那么完美……唯一美中不足的是，你随时可能离开去开启下一段旅程。如果你能多留在这里一会儿，该有多好啊。
main_3.captionEn: Everything here is so perfect, yet I know that you will someday leave... Ah, how I wish you could stay...

mission.caption: 还有任务没完成吗？哎呀~就由姐姐我来协助指挥官先处理一下任务，然后再继续吧~☆
mission.captionEn: Do you still have unfinished tasks? Heehee, then let me help you take care of them all. Then we can resume our fun...

touch_body.caption: 嗯？有什么疑问吗？我可以为指挥官解答哦——
touch_body.captionEn: Hm? Do you have a question for me? I'm happy to answer~

touch_head.caption: 这样的温柔，真是让人心动呢~
touch_head.captionEn: Your tenderness always warms my heart, Commander.

touch_special.caption: 哎呀……真是淘气的旅人呢♪
touch_special.captionEn: Oh, my... This traveler is a naughty one.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了，优势就是这样积累的呢。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Slowly but steadily, this is how great advantages are accrued.

wedding.caption: 重要的事……就是指这个吧。我没有提前料到哦~倒不如说，您真是以果断的气势，打了我一个措手不及呢……那么，请您做好准备，我会用更加热烈的感情，回应您的心意哦——！
wedding.captionEn: An important discussion, hmm? Heehee. Is this what you meant? My, I suppose I was caught off guard this time by your bold and decisive move. Though, I do hope you've prepared yourself, because my counterattack is going to be even more passionate~♡

home.caption: 怎么宴会前还这么忙？趁现在还没开始，先休息一会儿吧，刚好你的礼服这里有些空，我给你搭配些配饰吧。
home.captionEn: I can't believe you're still this busy before the party. *sigh*... Take a break. There's some free real estate on your tuxedo, so I'll go get some accessories for you.

login.caption: 这么早就过来了。看你的表情……这次我设计的服饰也很成功呢，呵呵~
login.captionEn: You're here quite early. Judging by that look, this design of mine is a hit. Heehee♪

main_1.caption: 有话就说，闲聊也可以。我已经收拾得差不多了，可以陪你聊会儿天。
main_1.captionEn: If you have something to say, now's the time. I'm almost finished here, so I could certainly have a chat with you.

main_2.caption: 嗯？裙摆乱了么？身后的位置我不好调整，你帮我整理一下。
main_2.captionEn: Oh? The train of my dress is a mess? It's hard to fix if I have to reach behind me, so give me a hand.

main_3.caption: 累了？到床上休息一会儿也可以，不过我先帮你把礼服脱下来，不要压皱了。
main_3.captionEn: Tired, are you? While you're free to rest on the bed, you'll first have to take off your tuxedo. So it doesn't... get wrinkles, you know?

mission.caption: 赶紧完成任务吧，再拖延下去就要错过晚宴了。我也可以帮你……不过，这就要看看你的诚意了。
mission.captionEn: We'll be late to the party at this rate, so get those missions done quickly. I'll help you... depending on how sincerely you ask for it, I suppose.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，我们出发吧。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Let's get going now.

touch_body.caption: 想帮我调整衣服？还是……想做其他事情？
touch_body.captionEn: Are you trying to help adjust my outfit? Or... were you doing something else?

touch_head.caption: 喜欢这个配饰？给你做个同款胸针吧，刚好你礼服胸口这一块的设计有些空缺。
touch_head.captionEn: Do you like this accessory? I'll make a brooch version of it for you. It would go perfectly on that empty breast pocket on your tuxedo.

touch_special.caption: 想要的话，不如等晚宴结束后再继续？我们会有更多的时间……
touch_special.captionEn: If you want it that badly, wait until after the party. There'll be plenty of time then♥

complete.caption: 委托组按时回来了，我还在画设计图，你自己接收和清点物资。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned on time. I'm concentrating on designing new fashion, so kindly fetch and inspect the supplies by yourself.

wedding.caption: 给我的？跟我这身衣服倒是挺搭的。看来我的影响力不错，你的品味提升得很快。傻站在那里干什么？过来帮我戴上。
wedding.captionEn: For me? It'll go well with my attire... Heehee. I suppose I've rubbed off on you, because your tastes are getting better all the time. Go on, don't just stand there – put it on my finger.

mail.caption: 现在是你该查收邮件的时间了，记得看。
mail.captionEn: It's time to check your mail. Don't forget.

complete.caption: 委托队回来了，指挥官快去吧……不过这满屋春色，你也得负责哦~
complete.captionEn: The commission team is back. Commander, go and greet them now... but don't forget about the romantic mood in here, okay?

home.caption: 看着暗下来的天色，我正想着，你也该回来了。
home.captionEn: When I saw the sky getting dark, I knew you'd come back soon.

login.caption: 指挥官觉得，是这枝头的梅花，还是我……更堪入怀呢？
login.captionEn: Which will you embrace, Commander? These plum blossoms, or me?

main_1.caption: ……是床边的梅枝更乱，还是我的云鬓……更不堪瞧？
main_1.captionEn: Which seems more disheveled? The branches by my bed, or my hair...?

main_2.caption: 指挥官，眼前的春色……可值得你细细品鉴？
main_2.captionEn: Commander, would you say... that the scenery before you is worthy of a closer look?

main_3.caption: 这枝梅，我守着它，从日暮到夜深，只为你来时第一眼便能看见它……也看见我……
main_3.captionEn: I've guarded these plum branches from dusk 'til night, such that you might view them... and me as well, of course...

touch_body.caption: 嗯？这般手法……是想盘玉了么？
touch_body.captionEn: Hmm? That technique... Are you trying to polish your favorite jewel?

touch_head.caption: 你的手总是这么温暖……
touch_head.captionEn: Your hands are always so warm...

touch_special.caption: 就算是想品鉴玉石，这也、也……嗯~
touch_special.captionEn: Even for an appraisal, this is... Ah... Mm...

mail.caption: 邮件？不知我新购的玉石到了没有……
mail.captionEn: Mail? I hope the jade I ordered came in...

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成。此番所获得的奖励，定不负所望。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. I'm sure the rewards won't disappoint.

mission.caption: 指挥官，似乎还有璞玉在等你“雕琢”呢……
mission.captionEn: Commander, there are still some uncut jade waiting for you to carve them.

wedding.caption: 契约已成。这次，我不琢玉，只琢一心——愿能长伴你左右，如暖玉在怀，温润此生……
wedding.captionEn: The contract is sealed. Now I shape not jade, but a heart – I'll be by your side forever, bringing warmth and comfort like a treasured jewel...

complete.caption: 嗯~凡世的委托吗？那就破例允许你暂时离开我的领域吧~
complete.captionEn: Ah, a commission from the mortal world? I shall permit you to briefly leave this place, then!

home.caption: 无论你去到哪里，最终都要回到我身边呢~这就是身为我的收藏品的宿命哦。
home.captionEn: No matter where you run, you'll always return to me in the end. That's your bound fate, my dear collection piece♪

login.caption: 哎呀，今天的闯入者也想着逃走吗？不过在喝完我手中的永恒之饮前是逃不掉的哦。就乖乖留在这里供我欣赏吧~♪
login.captionEn: What's this? Trying to escape today? Sorry, that's not gonna happen until you finish this Eternal Beverage. Be good and stay put so I can observe you♪

main_1.caption: 想要离开？但你已经进入我的领域了哦，这里可是有永续……啊，是有规则的！难得遇到这么完美的素材，就让我好好记录下你的每个表情变化吧♪
main_1.captionEn: You wanna leave, huh? Heh. You've entered my domain, my eternal tra– You know the drill! You're the best ref I could ask for, and I'm gonna draw out each and every one of your expressions!

main_2.caption: 闯入者，既然踏入了这片神圣领域，就要接受我的审视……欸嘿嘿，不如说这是难得的艺术创作机会呢☆
main_2.captionEn: Whoa there, intruder! You're in my holy domain, so you must remain under my watchful gaze! Heehee. This is a great chance to draw some art, so hold real still!

main_3.caption: 身为爱与美的守护者，区区闯入者原本不配得到我的注视。不过没想到凡人也能展现出如此完美的姿态……哼哼~今后就留在我的身边吧！
main_3.captionEn: A common invader means nothing to the Protector of Love and Beauty – but I didn't expect a mortal to show me such beauty... Heehee. You're staying by my side from now on!

main_4.caption: 也不是不能放你走啦~只要喝完这壶里的东西就行哦。欸？“为什么明明喝了很多，但壶里还一直都是满的？”欸嘿嘿，神明的恩赐是取之不尽的哦☆
main_4.captionEn: I'll let you go if you manage to drink all the liquid in this pot. Hm? You keep drinking but it never runs out? Heehee! The gifts of God are endless!

mission.caption: 区区闯入者竟敢在神域留下未完的使命？这可不行哦！
mission.captionEn: How dare a lowly intruder leave an unfinished mission in the domain of a god? Unacceptable!

mission_complete.caption: 好像有什么东西送过来了……哎呀，既然被我看到了，那完成的奖励就归我咯☆
mission_complete.captionEn: Something just arrived... Oh, since I laid eyes on these mission rewards, they're mine now!

touch_body.caption: 嗯~？想再来一杯吗？
touch_body.captionEn: Hmm? Want a refill?

touch_head.caption: 嗯~？就允许你这么做吧，就当是对你这份“美丽”的嘉奖啦☆
touch_head.captionEn: Hmm? I'll forgive that transgression just because you're so beautiful!

touch_special.caption: 这、这种亵渎的行为……为什么会这么……！
touch_special.captionEn: Ohh... This behavior is so blasphemous... but so good!

mail.caption: 有新邮件！啊……要不要干脆全都折成小船放进河里送过来好了！
mail.captionEn: New letterino! Hey, why don't we fold it up into a paper boat and send 'er down the river?

wedding.caption: 终于……等到这最珍贵的时刻了呢。您指尖温柔的触碰，将永远铭刻在我的心底。指挥官，今后也请让我用最虔诚的笔触，描绘我们相伴的每一个珍贵时刻吧~♪
wedding.captionEn: Finally... Finally this precious moment has come. The gentle touch of your fingers will forever be imprinted upon my heart... Heehee. Allow me the honor to depict every moment of our lives together from now on, using the most pious brushstrokes!

complete.caption: 委托组回来了……没事的，还是让我陪你去吧……现在不想离开你呢。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned. Worry not, I can come with you – I don't wish to leave your side already.

home.caption: 我还是第一次品尝这种风味的饮品，无论是口感还是味道，都很好，指挥官要试试么？……嗯？这个喝了会头晕？啊，原来是这样么……
home.captionEn: I've never before had a beverage like this. Its mouthfeel is quite good. Would you care to give it a taste? ...Hm? It will make my head spin, you say? Is that really so?

login.caption: 指挥官，请到我身边来、开始扑克游戏的教学吧。我应该没什么问题吧……？
login.captionEn: Won't you come here and teach me how to play cards, like you promised? I think I should be able to handle it.

main_1.caption: 因为今天没有迷路，所以来得有些早了。在等待你的时候，觉得有些口渴，便喝了些饮料……没想到会变成现在这样呢……
main_1.captionEn: I arrived early since I did not lose my way. Whilst waiting for you, I got thirsty, so I had this to drink. Alas, what you see now is the effect it had on me...

main_2.caption: 想学哪一种玩法规则……？有没有只有两个人才能玩的玩法呢……？没有的话，就学指挥官喜欢的吧~
main_2.captionEn: What type of game do I want to study? Are there even games just the two of us can play? If not, you may pick any game of your choosing.

main_3.caption: 如果闭上眼睛去感受……会不会能抽到更好的牌呢？您说不会偷看，让我尽情尝试？呵呵……这一点我当然相信您~
main_3.captionEn: Perhaps if I close my eyes, I'll draw better cards... Hm? I can do whatever I want since you promise you won't cheat, you say? Heehee. I trust you, Commander.

main_4.caption: 那我出这张牌……嗯？不是这样么？我这样是违反规则的……那要惩罚我么~？
main_4.captionEn: This is my next card... Hm? Am I playing it wrong? Did I break the rules, then? If so, can I expect a punishment?

mission.caption: 指挥官，还有未完成的任务哦，我来帮……嗯？担心我出错么……？呵呵，不会的……
mission.captionEn: You have unfinished missions, Commander. I shall help you with... Hm? You worry that I'll make mistakes? Heehee. I promise I won't.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了，没什么纰漏吧？呵呵~那就好……嗯？我的头还是有些晕哦，指挥官送我回去休息吧~
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. I don't see any errors – do you? Heehee. Good... Hm? I'm still a tad unsteady, so would you mind carrying me back home?

touch_body.caption: 要扶我起来么……？谢谢你……请让我靠一会儿吧。
touch_body.captionEn: You'll help me get up? Thank you. Although, I would like to practice with you a little more.

touch_head.caption: 感觉这样的触碰似乎能让我清醒很多？指挥官再多摸摸吧。
touch_head.captionEn: Being touched in this manner is rather refreshing... Kindly do it more, Commander.

touch_special.caption: 嗯？不见的牌原来在这里啊……嗯，指挥官取出来吧~
touch_special.captionEn: Oh, here's that card that went missing... Mmh... Could you take it for me, Commander?

mail.caption: 指挥官，你的信……我有些在意，这样漂亮的信封样式……
mail.captionEn: There's a letter for you, Commander. I'm rather curious about this gorgeous envelope it's arrived in...

wedding.caption: 只是戴上这个，可不足以让我不再迷路、永远在你身边哦。还请牵起我的手，紧紧拥抱我吧。指挥官，不要再让我走丢了~
wedding.captionEn: I'm afraid this ring won't do much to better my sense of direction. Take my hand and hold me tight, Commander. Do that, and I'll never get lost again.

complete.caption: 参与委托的同伴们都按计划回来了呢。为了不让计划出问题，请找个合适的时机去迎接她们吧。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned on time. Find a suitable time to meet them to ensure the plan doesn't fall through.

home.caption: ……嗯。指挥官同志，是准备解除机关吗？我这边还能忍受，所以其实就这样再待一会儿也没什么问题……
home.captionEn: Mgh... Are you going to disable the trap already, Comrade Commander? You don't need to, as I can maintain this pose without trouble.

login.caption: 指挥官同志！？咳咳，没想到我居然会被抓住……不，这或许反而是个令人高兴的发展呢……
login.captionEn: Comrade Commander?! Ahem! How shameful of me to be caught... No, actually, this may very well be a blessing in disguise.

mail.caption: 这是给指挥官同志的信。如果利用机关的话，应该能轻松拆开……嗯……
mail.captionEn: There's a letter for you, Comrade Commander. You should be able to easily open it if you make adept use of these strings.

main_1.caption: 我这边不要紧的。不过……嗯……这个姿势有些看不清指挥官同志的模样呢……
main_1.captionEn: There's no need to worry about me. My only issue... mmh... is that it's hard to see you in this position.

main_2.caption: 再拖延下去就会影响计划了。指挥官同志，用强硬的手段来获取信息也未尝不可哦。
main_2.captionEn: Any further delays will negatively impact the plan. Using force to extract information is an option at your disposal, Comrade Commander.

main_3.caption: 话说回来，便于活动的服装反而成了弱点。像这样被束缚住的话……光凭自己的力量实在是……嗯……
main_3.captionEn: My outfit being as flexible as it is has backfired. I'm tied up in such a way that... I can't free myself with my own strength...

main_4.caption: 换个角度来看，这也算得上是和指挥官一起克服危机，加深关系的机会……不，没什么……
main_4.captionEn: When viewed another way, this is a chance for us to share secrets and deepen our relationship... Ah, no, I didn't say anything.

mission.caption: 为了让指挥官同志能够尽快着手任务，这里——嗯！？
mission.captionEn: To ensure you can begin your mission as soon as possible, I'll– Mmh!

mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励已经送达了呢。伙伴们当中一定有人会去确认的。
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission rewards have arrived. One of our comrades will surely claim them for us.

touch_body.caption: 指挥官同志，那个地方……！？不、我自己……可以……
touch_body.captionEn: Comrade Commander, that's my– Ah! No, I'm fine...

touch_special.caption: 呼……抱歉……因为身子有些僵，所以敏感了些……
touch_special.captionEn: Ahh... Apologies, my body has gone numb, impairing my tactile sensitivity...

touch_head.caption: 预料之外的动作啊……指挥官同志。但，我认可这个行为，它足够鼓舞士气。
touch_head.captionEn: Well... This is unexpected, coming from you. Still, I'll allow it. This contact is a morale booster for your troops, after all.

wedding.caption: ……终于，我们走到这一刻了。坦诚地说，尽管是我提出希望能和你更进一步，但我一直在犹豫，犹豫我能否回应你的真挚。不过，此时此刻，我不再犹豫了——是的，这就是我所希望和期待的，让我们在接下来的时光继续同行吧！
wedding.captionEn: At last, this time has come. I know I specifically asked to deepen our relationship, but... to be frank, I always feared I wasn't returning your feelings properly. I've felt this the whole time, but now, there is no longer any doubt in my heart, heehee. Yes, this is the future I wished and hoped for. From this day onward, we walk together.

complete.caption: 委托组回来了，不过就目前的情况……我暂时无法前去给她们检修设备呢。
complete.captionEn: Commission team is back. I don't think I'm dressed to perform a machine inspection, though...

home.caption: 我来帮你检修装备……让我专心拍摄就好？嗯……好吧。
home.captionEn: I could inspect your gear if you... Just focus on the photoshoot? Alright, I will.

login.caption: 指挥官，来得正好，看看刚刚拍摄的影片……有什么建议么？笑容还可以再自然一些……？我试试看。
login.captionEn: Good timing, Commander. We just got done shooting and I'm wondering if you have any suggestions... Try to smile more naturally? I'll give it a shot.

main_1.caption: 镜头里的效果和人眼中的效果是有区别的，所以，指挥官，请不要盯着我看，认真看相机画面吧。
main_1.captionEn: The human eye and the camera lens view the same thing differently. By which I mean: Focus on the camera, not me, Commander.

main_2.caption: 让我更放松一些……跟着你深呼吸？好吧，呼……呼……
main_2.captionEn: Relax and take deep breaths with you? Okay. *huff*... *puff*... *huff*...

main_3.caption: 灯具坏了么？我来检修吧……没事，不会影响摄影状态的，不如说这样能让我更快放松下来。
main_3.captionEn: The lighting broke? I'll fix it. Don't worry, it won't impact the photoshoot. Heck, if anything, fixing it will help me relax.

main_4.caption: 让我喝点水休息一下么？也好。等等，这个味道是……用荆芥泡的茶……？指挥官……你……！唔……喵……~
main_4.captionEn: Drink some water and take a break, huh? Sure. Wait... What's that smell? Is this tea made with catnip? Commander, I... Mgh... Ah... Meow♡

touch_body.caption: 把身体挺直一些？这样么？果然，还是有些难为情。
touch_body.captionEn: Straighten out a bit? What, like this? Okay, this is embarrassing stuff...

touch_head.caption: 没错，“猫耳”的样式和配色也跟着服装主题调整过……
touch_head.captionEn: Yes, I've adjusted the design and color of my cat ears to match my outfit.

touch_special.caption: 在镜头前么？！别、别这样……唔……喵~！
touch_special.captionEn: Right in front of the camera?! B-but I... Ah... Mreow...♡

mail.caption: 指挥官，邮件已进行智能分类，记得查看。
mail.captionEn: I ran a smart sorter on your letters, Commander. Don't forget to read them.

mission.caption: 还有任务尚未完成，指挥官，需要提供技术支持吗？
mission.captionEn: You have unfinished missions. Would you like my technical support?

mission_complete.caption: 高效完成任务的感觉还不错吧？看来任务辅助系统的开发还算成功。
mission_complete.captionEn: Doesn't it feel great to complete missions efficiently? Seems my mission assistance system is working well.

wedding.caption: 指挥官，这是什么最新型的装备吗……？“爱的誓言”……？欸？抱、抱歉……我明白了，我的回答当然是“我愿意”，为我戴上吧……等等，尾巴……不，线缆！不要把指挥官捆起来喵！
wedding.captionEn: What is this, Commander? Some kind of... part for a machine? What? A pledge of your love? Oh, forgive me... I understand now. You already know my answer – "I do." Now put it on my... Oh no, what are my tails doing?! Cut it out! Let the Commeownder go!

home.caption: 快来，指挥官，看到你带零食给我了哦……我趴在这里吃就好~啊——
home.captionEn: Come here, Commander... I see you brought snacks for me. I'll just dig right in! Nom♪

login.caption: 呼~新的温泉池好舒服……但好像有点烫，指挥官可以给我换一条凉毛巾么？
login.captionEn: Ooh... This spring feels so nice. It's a bit too hot, though... Commander, could you fetch me a cold towel?

main_1.caption: 身上的凉毛巾……这样盖会重新变热？指挥官帮我调整一下吧？
main_1.captionEn: My towel doesn't do much if I use it like this, you say? Well, could you adjust it for me?

main_2.caption: 这样趴着就好……唔~好舒服，整个人像棉花糖一样软软的，是不是也很好吃？
main_2.captionEn: Just gonna lie on my stomach... Ahh, that's good... I wonder – if my body turns as soft as a marshmallow, will I taste good?

main_3.caption: 樱桃好甜好甜~唔是甜过头了吗，我好像在云上一样……嗯？到指挥官怀里了？嘿嘿，原来是太热的原因啊。
main_3.captionEn: These cherries are sooo sweet. Ahh... Wow, they're so sweet it feels like I'm on a cloud... Hm? And now I've fallen into your arms? Heehee – the water must have made me dizzy.

mission.caption: 哗啦哗啦——咕嘟咕嘟——泡温泉的时候出现了新任务……？
mission.captionEn: Splash, splash... Blub-blub-blub... You got a new mission in the middle of a bath?

touch_body.caption: 指挥官的手没有温泉暖和~要加热一下自己哦！
touch_body.captionEn: Your hand feels colder than the water. You should warm it up.

touch_head.caption: 就算是在温泉里，这撮头发好像也不会塌下来。
touch_head.captionEn: This one tuft of hair just won't flatten out, even in the bath.

touch_special.caption: 不、不要在温泉里带走幸运的能量，会站不起来的……
touch_special.captionEn: D-don't take away my lucky blessing, or I won't be able to stand up...

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了么……我等你好久了哦，快来玩一会儿吧！~
mission_complete.captionEn: You completed a mission. That took you a while. Can we enjoy ourselves now?

mail.caption: 指挥官看邮件之前抱抱我吧，肯定都会是好消息哦~
mail.captionEn: You should give me a hug before you read your letter. It'll turn all the contents into good news.

complete.caption: 指挥官，委托队的伙伴回来了，她们带回的物资看着好诱人……唔，我觉得应该有好吃的东西吧~
complete.captionEn: Commander, the commission team is back. Their haul of goodies looks really appealing... Yeah, I have a feeling there's some delicious food in there.

wedding.caption: 马塞纳，会用自己来庇佑指挥官即将经历的一切。指挥官想做的，就是我想做的，指挥官坚持的，就是我坚持的。只要指挥官需要，就算面前有超级多的零食，我也会立刻赶到你的身边！
wedding.captionEn: I will give myself to you and protect your future. Your wishes are my wishes, and your commitments are mine as well. When you need me, I'll come running... even if there's a pile of snacks in front of me!

complete.caption: 接收到了委托舰队的返程信号。现在就下去……唔！？
complete.captionEn: Message received: The commission team has returned. One shall get down and– Mgh?!

home.caption: 指挥官，一起干了这盏酒吧——呼。我已经将你的出色表现详细地记录下来……咕？！酒、酒盏要掉下去了……！
home.captionEn: Commander, let us drink every drop of this sake... Ahh. Your heroic performance has been duly logged in– Gah! Th-the cup!

login.caption: 你终于来了，指挥官。接下来就请和阿尔萨斯一起完成神圣的……唔！？没、没什么……///
login.captionEn: Welcome, Commander. The holy task awai– Mrgh! N-no, it's... It's nothing...

main_1.caption: 赎罪无需拘泥于形式。不论是行善积德还是履行圣务，其本质别无二致。
main_1.captionEn: You needn't fuss over form when atoning for a sin. Doing good deeds and accomplishing holy tasks are one and the same.

main_2.caption: 戴上这个面具是为了抑制感情，采取与角色相符的行动——帅、帅气也是原因之一……///
main_2.captionEn: This one adorned this mask to suppress one's emotions and act in adherence to one's role... a-and also because it looks cool... *blushes*

main_3.caption: 指挥官推荐给我的酒……并不是重樱酒而是雅马邑白兰地呢……是酒精让阿尔萨斯的感情模块运作出现了障碍吗……?
main_3.captionEn: About the alcohol you recommended – it wasn't sake, but rather Armagnac... which is causing problems for one's emotion module...

main_4.caption: 以阿尔萨斯的平衡功能来说，维持这个姿势很容易……但、但是衣服就……哇哇哇哇……
main_4.captionEn: Maintaining this pose is a simple task thanks to one's balance function... M-my clothes, on the other hand... Oh, god...

mission.caption: 指挥官需要完成圣务……阿尔萨斯也要，履行被赋予的职责。
mission.captionEn: You carry out your holy tasks... So, too, shall this one fulfill one's role.

mission_complete.caption: 请别忘了领取完成圣务后的报酬，以及给阿尔萨斯的奖励……
mission_complete.captionEn: Do not forget to claim the rewards of your holy task. And to give this one a reward.

touch_body.caption: 是在检查阿尔萨斯的散热功能吗……？
touch_body.captionEn: Are you checking this one's ventilation function?

touch_head.caption: 啊……呀啊！？指、指挥官……面具要掉下来了……！
touch_head.captionEn: Hahh... Eek! C-Commander! My mask!

touch_special.caption: 呀啊！？阿尔萨斯……感知传感器陷入了过载模式♡，机体温度正在急剧上升……♡
touch_special.captionEn: Eek! This one's sensors are... overheating! Detecting sudden temperature increase!

mail.caption: 阿尔萨斯报告，有新的邮件送达了。对了，有机会阿尔萨斯也来给指挥官写信吧。
mail.captionEn: Thus one reports – a new letter has arrived. Speaking of which, this one should send you a letter sometime.

wedding.caption: 就算没能成功探索指挥官的情感模块，阿尔萨斯也依然感受到了指挥官的心意，这就是神奇的指挥官电波么……还有这个……只是看着它，阿尔萨斯的情感模块就要爆炸了……我要将这份情绪用阿尔萨斯电波加倍传给指挥官，然后我们一起……变、变得奇怪吧！
wedding.captionEn: Seems I didn't need to connect to your emotion module to see what's inside your heart... Are you zapping me with your brainwaves again? Y-you can't, not after making me put this ring on! I feel like my emotion module will explode just from looking at you! Fine, if that's how it's gonna be... L-let's f– Let's get freaky!

home.caption: Zzzz……啊，差点一觉睡到明天了……长浴疗法果然太适合睡觉了吗？
home.captionEn: Zzz... Ah?! I-I could've slept until morning... Long baths really do make me sleepy.

login.caption: 温泉疗法结束后，指挥官就可以更专心工作了。现在，我们开始吧，要来点轻音乐吗？
login.captionEn: After your hot spring treatment, you should be able to focus more on your work than before. Now, let's get to it. Want me to play some calming music?

main_1.caption: 工作总结还没完成啊……那指挥官也可以一边接受疗愈一边工作，这样理论上可以抵消疲惫。但是指挥官……可以一心二用吗？
main_1.captionEn: Your deliverables still aren't done? Well, if you work while you bathe, you probably won't get tired... I know that's impossible for you, though.

main_2.caption: ……啊——保持这个姿势太久……腿麻了……指挥官，短浴疗法到了阶段性出浴的时候了……你、你能抱我一起吗？
main_2.captionEn: Ugh... My legs are numb from sitting like this for so long. Commander, we should get out for a while. Umm... Can you carry me?

main_3.caption: 这个泡池中的石头很光滑，指挥官可以拉着我慢点起——小心！唔……///
main_3.captionEn: It's easy to slip in here. Can you pull me up – Hyah?! Ah...

touch_body.caption: 泡温泉过程中是不能按摩的，我可不会纵容指挥官……
touch_body.captionEn: I'm not giving you a massage in the hot spring. Try all you like, but I'm not indulging you this time...

touch_head.caption: 嗯……被指挥官治愈了呢……
touch_head.captionEn: Mmm... Ah, now you've gone and healed ME, Commander...

touch_special.caption: 你……心跳好快，血压有升高吗？泡太久了吗？……不是温泉的原因？唔……啊///？？
touch_special.captionEn: Your heartbeat is quickening... Is your blood pressure spiking? Is it because of the hot spring... You're certain it's not? O-oh...

complete.caption: 休息时间结束，去迎接参与委托的同伴们吧。
complete.captionEn: Break time is over. Let's go greet the commission team.

mail.caption: 邮件来了，我帮你拿过来……怎么感觉你越来越依赖我了？这样好吗？
mail.captionEn: Mail's here. I'll get it... Say, don't you think you rely on me too much now? Is that really what you want?

mission.caption: 新任务来了，得尽快完成。我会帮你的，放心。
mission.captionEn: New missions have arrived and require urgent attention. I'll help you, so don't worry.

mission_complete.caption: 不错。赶在超时前完成了所有工作，可以睡个好觉了。
mission_complete.captionEn: I'm glad we've finished our sacred duties on time. Now I can finally sleep...

wedding.caption: ……为什么你能这么自然地让人想去接触呢？明明只在工作时才会接触，却不知不觉变得这么亲密……甚至会让我感受到被你照顾……你究竟是怎么做到的呢？嗯……作为回报，我之后的工作会向你倾斜更多一点，对你的关照，也会升级了……
wedding.captionEn: What is it that makes me want to be so close to you? We were only together for work, but we've become so intimate. It's as if you're caring for me... How did you turn the tables like that? *sigh*... I'll keep performing my sacred duties for you and take better care of you than ever from now on.

complete.caption: 委托组回来了么？嗯……这是今天的幸运物，请您带上后再一起去迎接她们吧……~
complete.captionEn: Has the commission team returned? Umm... Here's today's lucky item. When you go greet them, please bring one of these back.

home.caption: 啊，您终于回来了……芭菲的量没变少？因为一直想着您的事，想等您一起回来再吃……///
home.captionEn: W-welcome back, Commander. ...You're wondering why I haven't eaten any? I just thought it'd be better if I waited for you to get back so we could eat together... *blush*

login.caption: 指挥官，您来了。请品尝这杯因祈祷而变得更加美味的芭菲吧……啊——
login.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. My prayers have made this parfait even more delicious, so please, eat up. ...Okay, open up, and I'll feed you.

main_1.caption: 指挥官，那个……不，不行，这样好像太贪心了……唔，算了，即使贪心，我也想和您一直待在一起呢……///
main_1.captionEn: Commander, umm... N-no, I shouldn't be greedy... b-but I want to be with you forever... *blush*

main_2.caption: 果然，又聊到心愿了呢……嗯，指挥官可以对我说出一个愿望哦。我会试试看能不能帮指挥官达成的哦~
main_2.captionEn: You want to talk about wishes again? Heehee, tell me one of yours. I'll do my best to help you achieve it.

main_3.caption: 通过芭菲融化出来的形状也是可以预测当日运势的哦……嗯嗯，今天的运势是……啊！是非常适宜与指挥官约会的幸运日呢！
main_3.captionEn: The shape of the melted parfait can divine today's fortune... Umm, today, let's see... Oh! It's a very lucky day for a date!

mission.caption: 马上就要到今天的幸运时间段了呢……指挥官，要是利用这段时间完成任务的话，应该会格外顺利吧？
mission.captionEn: It's almost that lucky time of day... Commander, I think you'll see great success if you do your missions now.

mission_complete.caption: 您出色地完成了所有任务呢……看来幸运时间段有起作用……！太好了！
mission_complete.captionEn: Did you see great success in your missions?! So the lucky time really did help! Thank goodness.

touch_body.caption: 是喜欢伴尔维的新衣服吗……？
touch_body.captionEn: Does this mean... you like my new outfit?

touch_special.caption: 那、那个，冰淇淋会蹭到到处都是哦……！
touch_special.captionEn: U-umm... I'm going to spill my ice cream!

mail.caption: 新的邮件……呼……希望是好消息。
mail.captionEn: New mail... *sigh*... I hope it's good news.

touch_head.caption: 指挥官……是在祝福伴尔维么？
touch_head.captionEn: Commander... Are you trying to bless me?

wedding.caption: 我有很多很多愿望……但此时此刻，我的脑海全部被一个愿望完全占据了。而且，这个愿望即将实现。指挥官，谢谢您帮我实现了这个愿望，能喜欢上您……真的太好了……
wedding.captionEn: I have more wishes than I can count, but right now... Heehee, there's only one on my mind, and it's about to come true. Commander, thank you for making my dream a reality. I'm so glad... I came to love you.

home.caption: 还不快把我抱在怀里？这会儿有点冷了呢……呵呵呵呵~感受到了，指挥官的温度……
home.captionEn: Hey, can you come over and hold me already? I'm a little chilly. Heheheh... Ah, I can feel your warmth...

login.caption: 没想到会以这样的姿态和指挥官相见~先是在演出时意外滑倒，然后又正好压倒了唯一的观众……还真是巧合呢呵呵呵呵~~
login.captionEn: I didn't think I'd run into you quite like this... First I tripped and fell, and then, I almost crushed my one and only audience member... What a coincidence! Hehehe.

main_1.caption: 身为演员的我，居然把指挥官这样的观众压倒了……接下来该怎么办才好呢~？呵呵呵呵~
main_1.captionEn: As an actor, I've managed to draw you, my viewer, into the spectacle... What should I do now, you think? Heehee!

main_2.caption: 唔，这样的姿势，真叫人难堪呢~……欸~指挥官你呀……难道很享受吗~？不会吧不会吧~
main_2.captionEn: Hm... This position is really embarrassing... Oh? Are you enjoying the sight, Commander? Surely not~

main_3.caption: 一切是不是都在我的计划之中？没有哦~完全是随机事件~我做的只是在心里想着指挥官而已~这样的随机性，很神奇吧~
main_3.captionEn: Was this all part of my plan? Nooo, it was just bad luck~ All I did was think about you. Isn't fate just an incredible thing?

touch_body.caption: 要扶我起来吗？感谢你的好意……哎呀~不小心又滑倒了呢~
touch_body.captionEn: Aw, you're helping me up? Thank you... Oh nooo, I'm falling again~

touch_head.caption: 别担心，布偶服软软的，完全不疼~而且，我可是乐在其中呢，呵呵呵呵~
touch_head.captionEn: Don't worry. My outfit is soft, so it's a good cushion... To be quite honest, I'm having fun right now... Hehehe.

touch_special.caption: 居然想要趁人之危~指挥官，可真是坏心眼呢~
touch_special.captionEn: Taking advantage of a poor girl in distress? You're a real bully, Commander... Heheheh~

complete.caption: 委托队带回了小山那么高的物资哦——（小声）呵呵，当然是幻术啦~看她们这么开心，我都不忍心解除了呢。
complete.captionEn: The commission team has brought back a veritable mountain of supplies! Heehee... It's actually an illusion. Aww, now I can't bring myself to dispel it, seeing how happy they are.

mail.caption: 有新的邮件送到了哦~会是什么内容呢……？真让人好奇~
mail.captionEn: You have new mail~ What could it be? I'm dying to know.

mission.caption: 待完成的任务清单已经整理好了，请过目~……最后这项任务是不是我加的？啊……幻术居然被识破了……
mission.captionEn: I've put together a list of your unfinished missions. Take a look... Oh? You think I added that last one myself? Goodness, how easily you pierced my illusion...

wedding.caption: 誓约？我接受~光是想想那属于你我的不可预测的未来，就让我兴奋到颤抖……从今往后，请一定一定，不要让我无聊哦？
wedding.captionEn: Marriage? Why, I'd be happy to~ Just imagining the unpredictable future that we share makes me shiver with excitement... Never ever bore me, you got that?

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了……但你真的不考虑试试我准备的“特别”任务吗？
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete... Are you SURE you're not interested in the special mission I planned for you?

home.caption: 欢迎回来。看到你平安归来我就放心了……托你的福，我也休息够了，现在精神很好。
home.captionEn: Welcome back. I'm relieved to see you return unharmed. Thank you for allowing me this rest in your absence. I am now in perfect condition.

login.caption: 指挥官，您的酒杯空了吗？请放心，我虽然还有些……但为您斟酒的职责，我始终铭刻在心。
login.captionEn: Is your glass empty, Commander? Worry not. It seems the alcohol is affecting me somewhat... but I won't forget my duty to pour you another drink.

main_1.caption: 战斗和仲裁，都是严谨到不容半分含糊的事务，但在指挥官身边，我会不由自主放松……甚至能清晰地听到，自己的心声。
main_1.captionEn: The solemn duties of combat and arbitration must not be carried out with vagueness or deceit. And yet, I find myself less disciplined in your presence, Commander... so much so that I can hear my own heart pound...

main_2.caption: 指挥官，请恕我无法再饮……自由不应是沉沦的借口。我的剑，还需为守护您而保持清醒。
main_2.captionEn: I'm sorry, Commander. Forgive me for being unable to drink with you any longer. Freedom must not be an excuse to indulge. I must keep my wits about me in order to protect you.

main_3.caption: 宴会的灯火……比战场上温暖许多。但不必担心，指挥官，我依然能分辨出哪一盏是来自于您的指引。
main_3.captionEn: The lights of this banquet feel much warmer than the flames of the battlefield. You have nothing to fear, Commander. I shall always be able to distinguish your light from any other.

touch_body.caption: 指挥官，我可能……有些失态了……
touch_body.captionEn: Commander... it seems I have made a terrible error.

touch_head.caption: 呼……Zzz……嗯？抱歉，待在您身边，不自觉就放松下来了。
touch_head.captionEn: Aaah... Zzz... Mm? Oh, forgive me. It seems I unintentionally let my guard down in your presence.

touch_special.caption: 指挥官，难道……喜欢这种口感的果酱吗？
touch_special.captionEn: Am I to take it that you're fond of this flavor, Commander?

mission.caption: 指挥官，虽然不是神的旨意，不过军部的任务下达了
mission.captionEn: Commander, it may not be the will of God, but you do have new missions issued from headquarters.

complete.caption: 指挥官，我看到委托的同僚们返回了
complete.captionEn: Commander, my sisters in arms have returned from their commission.

mission_complete.caption: 奖励吗……虽然都是些不错的东西，不过我没有兴趣
mission_complete.captionEn: While rewards may certainly be nice... I have no interest in them.

mail.caption: 指挥官，信件不拆封没有关系吗
mail.captionEn: Commander, does it not matter if these letters remain unopened?

wedding.caption: 你的身边将是我的归所，你的胜利将是我的荣光，你的喜悦将是我唯一的动力。感谢神将我送到了你的面前，我的先知，我的爱人，我的……光
wedding.captionEn: This I do swear. Your joy is my will, your victory is my glory, and the place that I can call home, is by your side... Blessed be the Lord who has brought me together with you – my commander, my love, and... my light.

home.caption: 英雄大人，没想到你今日也依旧忙碌呢……到我这里来休息一会儿吧？
home.captionEn: O Champion, you've been hard at work. Come to me and enjoy a moment's respite.

login.caption: 能从这窗中望见月亮，又有这炉中的香气缭绕……正是为你创作新诗歌的好时机呢。
login.captionEn: The window's view of the moon, the fragrance of the stove... A perfect environment in which to pen poetry.

main_1.caption: 英雄大人也认为红色的花钿更适合我么？那真是太好了，我便继续画了。
main_1.captionEn: O Champion, do you think the red floral makeup suits me more? Good. Then I'll keep applying this one...

main_2.caption: 现在英雄大人正在为我绘制花钿，就像传统故事中爱侣“画眉”一样……
main_2.captionEn: The way you paint my face now reminds me of lovers in old folktales.

main_3.caption: 英雄大人，再凑近些如何，今夜会有更多别样的风景，值得你驻足。
main_3.captionEn: O Champion, please come closer. You may find the scenery tonight is unique enough to warrant a moment's rest.

touch_body.caption: 英雄大人想要坐在我身边么？靠着靠枕吧……嗯？想靠着我么？
touch_body.captionEn: O Champion, do you wish to sit next to me? Here is a cushion... Oh? You want me to be your cushion?

touch_head.caption: 头发，要不要试着也盘成东煌传统的风格呢？
touch_head.captionEn: Should I style my hair in a Dragon Empery fashion, as well?

touch_special.caption: 唔……英雄大人，不如将烛火熄灭吧？
touch_special.captionEn: Heehee... O Champion, put out the candles first.

mail.caption: 新的信件来了呢。
mail.captionEn: New mail has arrived.

complete.caption: 远征的伙伴已经归来，不知道这次她们会带回来什么样的故事呢？
complete.captionEn: Our friends have returned to us from their odyssey. I wonder what kind of stories they brought back with them?

mission.caption: 不用心急，英雄大人，按照平时的步调来一步步完成任务就好。
mission.captionEn: There's no need for haste, Champion. Keep it slow and steady, just as you always do.

mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励一直在那里，稍微放一放也不会消失的，不用着急。
mission_complete.captionEn: The mission rewards aren't going anywhere. There's no need for haste - we can always check them later.

wedding.caption: 没想到最后，吟唱英雄诗篇的诗人，也成了故事的一部分呢。让我们并肩同行，一起谱写未来的幸福之诗吧——
wedding.captionEn: To think that I, as a singer, would become part of my Champion's tale... What an unexpected plot twist. Heehee~ O Champion, shall we join hands and weave the paean to a more joyous tomorrow?

complete.caption: 委托队似乎回来了……指挥官就继续在这里休息吧~莫加多尔去慰问一下大家……
complete.captionEn: Seems the commission team is back. Just stay where you are, Commander. I'll go and receive them for you.

home.caption: 指挥官，让莫加多尔检查一下你身上有没有受伤嘛……嗅嗅，哈啊♡ 刚从出击回来的指挥官，新鲜的汗水气息……嗅嗅♡ 莫加多尔，太幸福了都要飘起来了呢……♡
home.captionEn: Commander, let me check your body for injuries. *sniff sniff*... Ahh! The fresh smell of your sweat after a sortie... *sniff sniff*... This is so good it's making my mind blank out♥

login.caption: 呼—哈♡呼—哈♡这是触……不对不对，是“嗅”诊才对，所以完全没问题哦……指挥官的气味，实在是太美妙了……♡
login.captionEn: *sniiiff*...♥ *sniiiff*... ♥ This is a physical... or should I say, olfactory checkup, so it's perfectly fine. God, you smell so good, Commander♥

mail.caption: 给指挥官的信……今天难得穿着衣服...差点把放在口袋里的信给忘了……
mail.captionEn: There's a letter for you. I rarely wear clothes, so I almost forgot I'd put it in my pocket.

main_1.caption: 哈啊哈啊♡……指挥官，到定期诊疗时间了哦……啊哈♡让莫加多尔好~好地替你做个全身检查吧……♡
main_1.captionEn: Hahh, ahh...♥ Commander, it's time for your regular checkup! Let me take a good, long look at your body...♥

main_2.caption: 指挥官的身体好热呢……啊嘿♡咕嘿嘿嘿嘿♡莫加多尔也是，热得头都晕乎乎的了……好想马上就脱掉啊……
main_2.captionEn: Wow, your body feels so warm... Heh♥ Heheheh♥ You know, mine's hot too, and it's making me lightheaded... Makes me wanna undress right about now...

main_3.caption: 虽然想打针，但是指挥官的衣服好碍事……卷起袖子就好了？欸~人家有说过要在你手臂上打针吗？没说过吧……所以上面下面都要……啊哈♡
main_3.captionEn: I'd like to give you an injection, but your clothes are in the way... Just roll up your sleeve? Uhh, I don't remember saying the shot was meant for your arm – do you? Exactly, so you'll have to fully strip... Ahah♥

main_4.caption: 在审判庭有种叫“治愈秘迹”的东西呢……像是抽血啊涂奇怪的药膏啊之类的~♡但人家会用更普通的方法来治愈你哦……
main_4.captionEn: The Tribunal has this thing called the Sacrament of Healing. It draws your blood, applies strange ointments, stuff like that... I, on the other hand, will heal you with more conventional methods.

mission.caption: 别管任务的事了，就让莫加多尔来好好疗愈你吧……♡
mission.captionEn: Your missions can wait, just focus on my healing...♥

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了……？指挥官……你是什么时候完成任务的……？
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete? Wait, when did you do that missions?

touch_body.caption: 指挥官……♡这里没有其他人在，不用顾虑这么多哦♡
touch_body.captionEn: Commander... There's no one but us here, so you don't have to hold back♥

touch_head.caption: 啊哈♡指挥官♡就这样把我推倒吧……
touch_head.captionEn: Ahah♥ Now pull me into bed with you...

touch_special.caption: 哈啊♡哈啊♡……指挥官♡现在♡不用动哦……♡
touch_special.captionEn: Ahh♥ Hahh♥ Commander... You can just... stay put for now♥

wedding.caption: 作为教廷审判官，我在此为您立下忠诚的誓言，我将作为您手中的利刃，从今往后……心甘情愿服从您的一切命令，承受您的一切怒火……任您驱使……绝无怨言……
wedding.captionEn: On my name as an Orthodoxy judge, I swear my fidelity to you. Henceforth, I will be your axe... Heheh. I will follow your every order and take your every punishment, without any objection or complaint... ♥

home.caption: 莫加多尔在天空中呼唤着您哦——让我们继续享受……这永不停歇的坠落吧♡
home.captionEn: I'm calling you from the sky! Let's keep falling together... endlessly♥

login.caption: 啊哈——指挥官，您和我的距离越来越近了呢♡衣服都飘起来了……？没关系——就让这呼啸的狂风，将我推入您怀中吧♡
login.captionEn: Ahah♥ Commaaander, we're getting closer and closer♥ What, my clothes are getting blown around...? Don't worry. Just let me fly and dive into your arms!

main_1.caption: 哇哈——汗水一出来就被风吹走了——但和您紧贴的部位，还是变得好热哦♡……
main_1.captionEn: Hahh... The wind blew all my sweat away, but the places I'm smooshed up against you still feel hot♥

main_2.caption: 碍事的衣服要被吹走了——指挥官，请您抱紧我吧——不然，人家就要被你看光了哦……♡
main_2.captionEn: I feel like the wind's going to blow away these pesky clothes... Hold me tight, Commaaander~ Otherwise I might end up totally naked♥

main_3.caption: 呜——风太大了，闻不到指挥官的气味了……不行……落地之后，一定要加倍——加倍地补充回来才行♡
main_3.captionEn: Hmph, the wind's so strong that I can't smell your scent. I'll have to do twice... no, three times as much sniffing when we land to make up for it♥

main_4.caption: 指挥官——我说的话您能听清吗——？那……我只好在您耳边，再~说一遍咯♡
main_4.captionEn: Can you hear what I'm saying, Commaaander? Alright, I'll whisper it once more into your ear then♥

touch_body.caption: 呀——我的汗会流得更厉害的哦♡
touch_body.captionEn: Angh... I'm about to get even sweatier...♥

touch_head.caption: （深嗅）狂风也吹不散您在我身上留下的气味——哈啊♡哈啊♡
touch_head.captionEn: Mmm... Haaah! No matter how strong the wind gets, it'll never erase your scent on me... Hahh... Aah♥

touch_special.caption: 指挥官，您可真是、真是太坏了……莫加多尔好喜欢♡
touch_special.captionEn: You're so mean, Commander... You really are. And I love you for it♥

wedding.caption: 作为教廷审判官，我在此为您立下忠诚的誓言，我将作为您手中的利刃，从今往后……心甘情愿服从您的一切命令，承受您的一切怒火……任您驱使……绝无怨言……
wedding.captionEn: On my name as an Orthodoxy judge, I swear my fidelity to you. Henceforth, I will be your axe... Heheh. I will follow your every order and take your every punishment, without any objection or complaint... ♥

mail.caption: 这是您的邮件和帮您运送邮件的邮差……请过目……
mail.captionEn: Here's a letter for you... and here's the postwoman bringing it to you. Take a good, looong look!

complete.caption: 委托组回来了？啊啊，如果这样就能吸引您的注意力的话……我也可以为您执行委托任务！
complete.captionEn: The commission team is back? Ohh. So that gets your attention. I'm gonna start undertaking commissions, too!

mission.caption: 这是任务书，请过目……嘿嘿，因为是审判官，这种工作已经轻车熟路了。
mission.captionEn: New mission orders are in. Give them a look-see. Heheh, this looks like work a judge like me can handle.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了……真是令人神清气爽。指挥官，我们一起去冲个凉吧？
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Ohh, that's the good stuff. Now let's go take a shower, Commander!

home.caption: 比赛结束了呢，是指挥官，来一杯冰冰凉凉的饮料？想用冷水泼在身上好好冷静冷静？还是说~？
home.captionEn: The race is over, Commander. Want a cold drink? Or maybe a bucketful of cold water over your head? Or maybe you want...♡

login.caption: 指·挥·官~在看哪儿？在看哪儿呢？呵呵…刚刚到这里就被我迷住了吗？
login.captionEn: Commaaander – what are you looking at? I said, "what are you looking at"? Heehee... Have you fallen under my spell within moments of arrival, hmm?

main_1.caption: 机械就和乐器一样，有着明确的逻辑和可见的规则，不错呢，确实值得探究……不过指挥官一来，我的注意力就全——部到指挥官身上了呢。
main_1.captionEn: Race cars are like instruments – they have a clear logic to them, their physical framework is evident, and they warrant studying... Buuut, as soon as you arrived, all my attention went straight to you.

main_2.caption: 准备OK，这样就万无一失了，指挥官和我的默契越来越深了呢……就保持这个感觉继续吧！
main_2.captionEn: Everything's ready. Should be good to go... You know, we're starting to get REALLY synchronized, you and I. Let's keep this up.

main_3.caption: 好累……指挥官，不要动。现在指挥官乱动的话我可能就会因为劳累过度倒在地上最后动弹不得了哦？指挥官要负起责任来的吧？既然如此，就这样让我靠着吧~就我们两个人。
