main_3.captionEn: I'm so tired... Stay still, will you? Don't move so much or I might trip and get stuck. Heehee, you've made me like this – will you take responsibility for it? Come closer so our bodies may touch♡

touch_body.caption: 嗯～？是需要我了吗？
touch_body.captionEn: Oh? Need my help?

touch_head.caption: 啊！指、指挥官，别碰到耳机！
touch_head.captionEn: Hey! C-Commander! Leave my headphones alone.

touch_special.caption: 这么心急吗，指挥官？这样的话，去车里比较好呢♡
touch_special.captionEn: Are you THAT eager to do it? Alright, but let's continue this INSIDE the car♡

mission.caption: 有新的任务哦，真是忙碌呢——指挥官~
mission.captionEn: You have new missions. Seems you have your work cut out for you, no?

complete.caption: 委托组们带回来了这些……这是我整理好的物资清单，指挥官，请您过目。做、做得好？咳，这句夸奖我就勉为其难收下了……
complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned to us. The inventory list I made is right here. Do read it, Commander. G-good job, you say? W-well, I won't refuse a compliment...

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，如同完美演奏的乐曲一般完美无缺，真好呢~
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Wonderful – like a song played to perfection.

mail.caption: 有新的邮件，来——我放在这里了，您会准时看的，对吧？
mail.captionEn: There's a new letter for you. I've left it over here. You'll do the wise thing and read it at once, no?

wedding.caption: 我……是我吗？真的？为什么？明明还有别的女孩……指、指挥官，再说一次，拜托了！您选择了我，是这样的吧？您……你这样说的话，我是真的真的会当真，然后再也不放开你的，谁也别想在我面前把你夺走……有我们两个人就足够了。
wedding.captionEn: For... For me? Really? Why? You have no shortage of other admirers... Wait, let me just confirm this one last time! It's me – I'm the one you want, yes? Because if so, I will really stop holding back, embrace you tightly, and make sure nobody can ever take you from me.

home.caption: 比赛结束了呢，是指挥官，来一杯冰冰凉凉的饮料？想用冷水泼在身上好好冷静冷静？还是说~？
home.captionEn: The race is over, Commander. Want a cold drink? Or maybe a bucketful of cold water over your head? Or maybe you want...♡

main_2.captionEn: Everything's ready. Should be good to go... You know, we're starting to get REALLY synchronized, you and I. Let's keep this up.

touch_body.captionEn: Oh? Need my help?

touch_head.captionEn: Hey! C-Commander! Leave my headphones alone.

touch_special.captionEn: Are you THAT eager to do it? Alright, but let's continue this INSIDE the car♡

complete.captionEn: The commission team has returned to us. The inventory list I made is right here. Do read it, Commander. G-good job, you say? W-well, I won't refuse a compliment...

mail.captionEn: There's a new letter for you. I've left it over here. You'll do the wise thing and read it at once, no?

mission.caption: 有新的任务哦，真是忙碌呢——指挥官~
mission.captionEn: You have new missions. Seems you have your work cut out for you, no?

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成，如同完美演奏的乐曲一般完美无缺，真好呢~
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission complete. Wonderful – like a song played to perfection.

wedding.caption: 我……是我吗？真的？为什么？明明还有别的女孩……指、指挥官，再说一次，拜托了！您选择了我，是这样的吧？您……你这样说的话，我是真的真的会当真，然后再也不放开你的，谁也别想在我面前把你夺走……有我们两个人就足够了。
wedding.captionEn: For... For me? Really? Why? You have no shortage of other admirers... Wait, let me just confirm this one last time! It's me – I'm the one you want, yes? Because if so, I will really stop holding back, embrace you tightly, and make sure nobody can ever take you from me.

complete.caption: 吵吵闹闹的家伙们回来了……呵，正适合现在的氛围。
complete.captionEn: That rowdy bunch is back. Heheh. They're right at home with this holiday spirit.

home.caption: 回来了吗？那个，我今天到底怎么样？可不是非要向你寻求认可……我只是想做到最好而已。
home.captionEn: Look who's back. So, what should I do? It's not that I DON'T want your approval, I just want to do my best.

login.caption: 来了吗？怎么样，我这身打扮还算合格吗？……不，我只是随便问问。
login.captionEn: You're here. Well? Does this attire meet your standard? ...No, just asking out of curiosity.

mail.caption: 有你的信……我可没特意关注，只是恰好看到。
mail.captionEn: Got a letter for you here... No, I didn't go looking for it. I just happened to find it.

main_1.caption: 这种节日氛围比我想象中有趣，不过别指望我会像小孩子一样兴高采烈……你说像小孩子也没关系？……哼，我自己会考虑的。
main_1.captionEn: Sure, this is more fun than I thought, but I can't go 'round cheering like a little kid... You wouldn't mind it if I let my inner kid out? Well, I'll be the one to decide what I do.

main_2.caption: 红包？原来如此，是表达祝福的方式对吗？……那么……你的诚意呢？
main_2.captionEn: A red envelope? Oh, is that how you give blessings to someone? Heheh. Alright, then how 'bout showing me how sincere you are?

main_3.caption: 新年新气象……哼，但对我来说每一天都是新的开始，不过，有你在身边的话，或许今年会有更多不同。
main_3.captionEn: A new year and a new beginning... So they say, but every day's new to me. What makes it different from the past ones is the fact that I have you now.

mission.caption: 别忘了还有工作等着你，即使是节日也别太懈怠了。
mission.captionEn: Remember, you've got work waitin' for ya. It being a holiday ain't an excuse to slack off.

mission_complete.caption: 奖励已经准备好了，怎么？还要我亲自送到你手上吗？
mission_complete.captionEn: Looks like your rewards're ready. You're not gonna tell me to go and fetch 'em, are ya?

touch_body.caption: 别得寸进尺啊……
touch_body.captionEn: Don't get too ahead of yourself, now...

touch_head.caption: 你这家伙……算了，大过节的。
touch_head.captionEn: I swear, people like you... Ugh. It's a holiday. I'll pretend you didn't do that.

touch_special.caption: ……你这家伙是不是太得意忘形了？虽说是新年……算了，今天随你开心吧。
touch_special.captionEn: You sure you ain't getting carried away? It being the New Year isn't an excuse to... Actually, do whatever you want.

wedding.caption: 我所行走的道路，是条绝不会被赞许、看不见未来的泥泞之道，即便如此你也要与我一同前行吗？……哼，真是个愚蠢的家伙啊。那份愚蠢的信任——就让我用余下的生命来回报吧。
wedding.captionEn: The path I walk is an unforgiving, dirt-ridden path where you can't even see the future lying ahead of you. But ya still wanna go with me? ... Hmph, your stupidity amazes me. And for your foolishness, I offer you the rest of my days.

complete.caption: 委托组好像回来了。我去让她们稍等片刻。
complete.captionEn: I hear the commission team is back. I'll tell them to give you a few minutes.

home.caption: 建议您先进一次维修站，对赛车进行一下整备。毕竟……不管是人还是物，持续过度使用的话，可是会招致不幸的哦？
home.captionEn: I suggest making a pitstop for quick maintenance. Continuous overuse can lead to misfortune – for people, and for machines.

login.caption: 欢迎回来，指挥官。在下场比赛开始之前，先确认一下赛车的状态如何？我也会协助您的。
login.captionEn: Welcome back, Commander. Would you like to check on your vehicle before the next race? I'm happy to assist.

main_1.caption: 看来您刷新了自己的记录呢。恭喜您。能取得这样的好成绩，一定是因为鸢尾的庇佑吧。
main_1.captionEn: Looks like you set a new record. Congratulations. I'm certain it was the blessing of the Iris that guided you.

main_2.caption: 呼（吹气）……给您的前窗吹雾气就到此为止了。嗯，愿您能像这样……获得“喜欢”的祝福
main_2.captionEn: *blow*... Okay, that's enough fogging up your windshield. Yes... May this give you the blessing of love.

main_3.caption: 炒热同伴们比赛的气氛，其志可嘉。但请务必牢记安全第一——霞飞也要注意安全？呵呵，谢谢您。
main_3.captionEn: I find it commendable how you liven up the competitive mood, but please remember to be safe... I should, too? Heehee, thanks for your concern.

mission.caption: 任务……嗯，可以推迟再做也没关系。因为霞飞已经做出了这样的“裁决”哦。
mission.captionEn: Your missions... Yes, they can be put off for now. That's the judgment I've given, after all.

touch_body.caption: 难道，您忘记了有玻璃这回事？
touch_body.captionEn: Forgetting that there's glass between us, I see?

touch_special.caption: ……唔。应该不用对霞飞进行清洁吧……？
touch_special.captionEn: ..Hmm. I don't think you need to clean me, really...

mission_complete.caption: 任务奖励下发了。接受吧，不要贪心。
mission_complete.captionEn: The rewards for your missions are here. Take them without succumbing to greed.

mail.caption: 看来是新邮件。确认下吧。
mail.captionEn: It seems there's some new mail for you. Let's go check on it.

wedding.caption: 以鸢尾之名，与你立下永远的誓约……这下我就失去制裁你的资格了呢。不过这也没什么。我会充分用好这份刚获得的，爱你的资格的。
wedding.captionEn: I swear upon the name of the Holy Iris that our vows shall hold us together evermore. ...And with that, I am no longer fit to pass judgment upon you, but that's just fine with me. I'll just have to make good use of my newly-acquired qualification to love you instead. Hehehe.

home.caption: 哎呀呀，别跑嘛～洗澡有什么好怕的～快来我的怀里，让我帮您把身上的灰尘都洗掉～
home.captionEn: Easy now, don't run away~ We're just taking a bath together, see~? Come right into my arms, would you please? I'll clean you until you're spotless~

login.caption: 呵呵呵呵~您的目光怎么躲开了？但心跳声可是响到藏不住呢……听起来就像在邀请我进来，与您一同沐浴~♡
login.captionEn: Heheh~ Why so bashful? Looking away won't hide your pounding heartbeats from me... It's practically begging for us to melt in this bath together♥

main_1.caption: 浴缸和浴帘都有点小，真是影响发挥呢。不过把浴帘当浴巾用，包住指挥官大人的话……是不是刚好呢~
main_1.captionEn: It's rather tight inside the shower, is it not? But maybe, if I wrap you up nicely with the curtains, it'll feel just right~

main_2.caption: 触手们正在努力帮指挥官大人擦拭身体~感觉很舒服吧？不过~好像越洗越黏了……？
main_2.captionEn: My tentacles are simply trying to clean you, Commander~ Don't they feel nice? But, it seems like you're only getting stickier and stickier, heehee~

main_3.caption: 指挥官大人，您看起来对我的洗浴服务依依不舍呢……是不是担心只要离开这个浴缸，您就会变成我的美餐呢~♡
main_3.captionEn: You seem rather reluctant to step away from my "cleaning services"... Or, perhaps, are you simply worried that you might become my next meal?♥

touch_body.caption: 指挥官大人想要反过来为我清洁身体吗？那我就不客气了~
touch_body.captionEn: Oh my, you'd like to help me wash up? I'd be glad to accept that offer~

touch_head.caption: 为什么沐浴时不摘掉帽子？在等您亲手来摘哦~
touch_head.captionEn: Why is my hat still on? I'm waiting for you to do the honors, of course~

touch_special.caption: 想不到您居然对身为妖怪的我有着这样的渴求……真可爱~来吧，我会好好接纳您，用我的全部♡
touch_special.captionEn: To think you'd lust over a being like me... How adorable♥ I'll use my everything to return the favor and accept all of you♥

complete.caption: 委托完成了呢，不知道她们有没有带敌人的残骸回来？
complete.captionEn: A commission's been completed. Would the team mind bringing me the enemy's remains?

mission_complete.caption: 作为完成任务的额外奖励，来我的怀抱里吧，指挥官大人~♡
mission_complete.captionEn: As a reward for completing your mission, I invite you to my bosom♡

mail.caption: 指挥官大人，寄给您的信到了……黏黏的？哎呀~那些是独属于您的热情哦~♡
mail.captionEn: Here's your letter, darling~ *squish* ...It's sticky? Heehee, think of it as my liquid passion for you~♡

mission.caption: 嗯哼~在订立契约前，要全部约定清楚才行哦，指挥官大人。
mission.captionEn: Heehee, my darling~ You must read the fine print carefully before you sign the pact♡

wedding.caption: 这是……呵呵，我明白了，是关于归宿的承诺呢，指挥官大人……真没想过，习惯无拘无束、随心所欲的那个我，也会找到毫无保留地接纳我的归宿。那么，您还在等什么呢，指挥官大人？今后，让我们一起放纵吧~♡
wedding.captionEn: Is this...? Heehee, I see now~ It's a promise about a home, isn't it, my darling? Heehee... I've roamed freely up to this point, going wherever my whims dictated, but now I have a place that accepts me. Well, Commander, what are you waiting for? It's time we indulged in each other, forever and ever♡

home.caption: 真是厉害的仪器啊……嗯？我正想邀请你来试试呢。在你看透我所有的秘密之后，该轮到我知晓你的一切了吧~
home.captionEn: This machine is amazing... Oh, Commander, you should try it, too. I've let you look inside me, so it's only fair that I get to know all about you~

login.caption: 唔……身体好像有些不舒服呢，能帮我把问题的根源找出来吗？对对，就这样为我“深度”检查一下吧。
login.captionEn: Hmm... I'm not feeling so well. Can you help me find out what's wrong? Yes, take a veeery close look♪

main_1.caption: 仪器上显现出来的这个轮廓……你觉得，这是否就是我真实的模样呢？想要探索一下吗？
main_1.captionEn: Do you think the silhouette onscreen is my true self? Don't you wanna know more?

main_2.caption: 如果你想的话，检查结束后我可以带你了解下这座医院哦。不过探索的过程中……一定要好好牵着我的手，千万别松开哦。
main_2.captionEn: Commander, I can show you around the hospital after this exam. But when I do... don't you dare let go of my hand~

main_3.caption: 仪器所展现出来的这份真实，与直接的触碰所带来的真实，会有什么不同的地方呢……指挥官，想试试看吗~
main_3.captionEn: The truth as viewed through the machine, and the truth as felt through direct touch... Want to find out how they differ, Commander?

touch_body.caption: 想距离更近，看得更清楚些吗？呵呵，那就把这个碍事的仪器拿开吧？
touch_body.captionEn: Don't you wanna get closer and see things more clearly? Heheh, then let's get this machine out of the way~

touch_head.caption: 被你这样摸着……感觉心里有什么东西要被你发现了呢……
touch_head.captionEn: When you touch me... it feels like you're seeing something deep inside me.

touch_special.caption: 扑通、扑通、扑通……心跳加速中……欸，你能看到吗……
touch_special.captionEn: Thump, thump, thump... My heart is racing... Huh? Can you see it?

mail.caption: 指挥官，信件我都给你拿过来了，慢慢看吧~我就在这里等你。
mail.captionEn: I've brought all your letters, Commander. Read them at your leisure. I'll be waiting right here.

complete.caption: 这就是指挥官的商队么？大家看起来都很可爱呢~
complete.captionEn: Are those girls your entourage? My, they're so cute!

mission.caption: 指挥官，赶紧开始今天的工作吧，可不能偷懒哦~
mission.captionEn: Shall we begin on the day's work, Commander? Delaying won't do you any good.

mission_complete.caption: 任务的报酬？……在哪里？嗯？这些就是报酬……？我还以为只是随手放在这里的杂物……？抱歉抱歉，不要生气~
mission_complete.captionEn: Mission rewards? Where? Oh, you mean these? I thought they were random things just left there... You must forgive me. Please don't be mad!

wedding.caption: 指挥官，我已经开始畅想我们的未来了……一起随风远航、或是住进自建的不可思议大建筑、或是载歌载舞地度过每一天……无论是怎样的光景，只要想到我的未来中有你，我便无比期待~！
wedding.captionEn: I've already started picturing our future together! We'll hoist sails and embark on far-flung voyages, we'll sleep in a curious and magnificent building we built ourselves, and we'll sing and we'll dance... Regardless of what the future has in store, I'm excited to be experiencing it with you!

home.caption: 你已无处可逃……信徒啊，就用你的辛勤劳动，来践行你我之间永恒而古老的契约吧……
home.captionEn: There is nowhere left to run. Faithful one, fulfill our eternal contract with your labour and devotion.

login.caption: 仪式的准备工作，都完成了吗……欸……神明可没法处理这些微不足道的事务。
login.captionEn: All is in order for the ritual to proceed? ...Eh? A god doesn't involve oneself with such faff.

main_1.caption: 虔诚的眷族啊，我赐予你一项神圣的使命——清理我这尊贵的身躯……每根触须都要好好洗干净哦？
main_1.captionEn: I have a sacred task for you, my devoted retainer – clean my noble body. Thoroughly. Down to every last tentacle.

main_2.caption: 妆点触手的首饰，都准备妥当了？很好，赏心悦目多了……别多想，这也是仪式的一部分。
main_2.captionEn: Is the jewelry for my tentacles ready? Cracking. They're quite a bit prettier now. And don't get the wrong idea – it's all a part of the ritual.

main_3.caption: 勤勉的眷族啊，你表现得极为出色。留下来，继续侍奉伟大的古神吧……敢拒绝的话，就把你当祭品吃了，呵呵……
main_3.captionEn: You're doing some marvellous work, my diligent retainer. Remain here and continue serving this grand, ancient one. Refusal will be met with being devoured as an offering. Heheh.

mission_complete.caption: 任务完成了，仪式也近乎圆满……眷族，你真的很擅长侍奉。
mission_complete.captionEn: Your missions are done, and the ritual nears its completion... You know, you're an excellent worker, my retainer.

touch_body.caption: 你究竟对神明怀有何等渴望？我说不定会满足你呢，呵呵……
touch_body.captionEn: What do you seek from your god? Go on, say it. I might just make your wish come true. Heh.

touch_special.caption: 竟然妄想献身于不可名状的至高存在么……我赞许你的勇气。
touch_special.captionEn: Offering up your body to an indescribable supreme being? Heehee. You're brave, I'll give you that much.

mail.caption: 刚刚好像在哪里看到一封你的邮件……再不去找的话，就找不到了。
mail.captionEn: Saw a letter addressed to you just a minute ago. If you don't go looking for it now, you may never find it again.

complete.caption: 你该去迎接委托队了，要是有漂亮的珠宝……都带来给我。
complete.captionEn: Time to go and greet the commission team. If they found any glittering treasure, bring it all to me.

mission.caption: 任务没完成就想休息？财宝可不会自己从地里长出来。
mission.captionEn: Hankering for a break when you've not even finished your missions? Go on. Treasure doesn't grow on trees.

touch_head.caption: 你最好没有弄乱我的发饰……别担心，在海里和章鱼作伴没什么不好。
touch_head.captionEn: As long as you don't mess up my hair ornament. *sigh*... Don't worry. There's nothing naff about making friends with octopuses in the sea.

wedding.caption: 令我魂牵梦绕的这颗璀钻，终于得手了……呵呵，倒也与我的美貌相配。在我戴上它之前，是你活着反悔的最后机会……绝不后悔？很好，很好。
wedding.captionEn: I've finally got it... The glittering oath ring I've seen in my dreams. Heehee. It goes perfectly with my beauty, doesn't it? Once you put it on, you'll never get to regret it for the rest of your life... You wouldn't dream of regretting it? Heh. Good.

home.caption: 温柔的勇者大人啊，你又回来救我了……呵呵，就这么离不开我吗？
home.captionEn: Back again, are you? Oh, sweet hero... Heehee, do you long for me so?

login.caption: 勇者大人想救我出去？想让我乖乖听你的话……需要付出不小的代价呢。
login.captionEn: Do you want to save me, brave hero? If you want my obedience... then it's going to cost you.

main_1.caption: 邪恶的魔堡，被锁链禁锢的堕天使……勇者大人会喜欢这种设定吗？
main_1.captionEn: A dark castle, a fallen angel bound in chains... Do you like this situation, brave hero?

main_2.caption: 不小心把魔药洒到身上了呢，勇者大人能帮我收集起来吗？呵呵~直接尝尝也没关系的哦？
main_2.captionEn: Oh no, I've spilled this potion all over me! Brave hero, would you mind... cleaning it off of me? Heehee! You can even taste a little, if you want.

main_3.caption: 抛开无关紧要的使命，遵循内心的指引……到我身边来吧~
main_3.captionEn: Set aside that silly mission of yours and follow your heart... right to my side.

touch_body.caption: 堕入黑暗的天使，羽翼依然不染纤尘……很奇妙吧~？
touch_body.captionEn: I'm a fallen angel, but my wings haven't turned black... How odd.

touch_head.caption: 嗯……啊……勇者大人，还像往常那样温柔地抚摸着我呢~
touch_head.captionEn: Mmm... Ah... Sweet hero, you still caress me as gently as you used to...

touch_special.caption: 嗯~勇者大人，让我用这羽翼将你包裹吧，与我一同沦陷在这纯白之下……♡
touch_special.captionEn: Mmm... Sweet hero, let me wrap you up in my wings... so the white can shield us from prying eyes as we fall into depravity together.

mail.caption: 指挥官，有你的新邮件哦，要去看看吗？
mail.captionEn: Commander, you just got a delivery. Should we check on it?

complete.caption: 委托舰队满载而归了哦。希望大家都没受伤……
complete.captionEn: The commission fleet has returned with a bountiful harvest. I hope nobody got hurt...

mission.caption: 指挥官的任务真不少呢，就让我来协助你吧~
mission.captionEn: Your workload is... troubling, to say the least. Allow me to help you!

mission_complete.caption: 任务的报酬都有什么呢……会有珍奇的珠宝嘛？
mission_complete.captionEn: What kinds of rewards did you get? Any rare jewels, maybe?

wedding.caption: 这枚信物……就是爱的具象吗？与之相比，我身边的一切都黯然失色了——我会好好珍惜它、养护它，无论过去多久，都会让它依旧光明而美好~
wedding.captionEn: Is this the physical embodiment of love? Everything else pales in comparison to it. I'll treasure it and protect it forever, so that it shines eternally.
